items.title: Soomaaliya iyo Sucuudiga oo ka wada-hadlay hormarinta iskaashiga dhaqaalaha iyo Maalgashiga
items.description: Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Xukuumadda Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya Mudane Xamsa Cabdi Barre, ayaa xafiiskiisa ku qaabilay Danjiraha Boqortooyada Sacuudiga u fadhiya Soomaaliya Mudane Axmed Bin Maxammed Al-Muwalad, waxa ayna ka wada hadleen xoojinta xiriirka walaaltinimo ee ka dhexeeya labada dal. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta xiriirka istiraatiijiga ah ee ka dhexeeya Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo Boqortooyada Sacuudiga, iyo horumarinta iskaashiga dhaqaalaha iyo Maalgashiga. Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamsa Cabdi Barre, ayaa uga mahadceliyay Dowladda Boqortooyada Sacuudiga taageeradeeda joogta ah ee ay siiso shacabka Soomaaliyeed iyo garab istaagga midnimada iyo madax-bannaanida Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Dhankiisa, Danjire Axmed Bin Maxammed, ayaa la-wadaagay Ra’iisul Wasaaraha, sida ay uga go’antahay xoojinta iskaashiga iyo garab istaagga shacabka iyo dowladda Soomaaliyeed kala dhexeeya Boqortooyada Sacuudiga isaga oo ku ammaanay dowladda sugidda amniga iyo dardargelinta horumarrada balaaran ee ka socda guud ahaan dalka.

items.title: Maxay daarrantahay booqashada kaaliyaha Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Masar oo ku yimid Soomaaliya?
items.description: Kaaliyaha Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Masar ee Arrimaha Afrika, Danjire Maxamed Kariim Shariif, ayaa booqasho rasmi ah ku yimid magaalada Muqdisho, halkaas oo uu kulamo kula yeeshay masuuliyiin sare oo ka tirsan Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Danjiraha ayaa, isaga oo uu wehelinayo Safiirka Masar ee Soomaaliya Maxamed Salaax, la kulmay Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda, Wasiirrada Kalluumeysiga iyo Dhaqaalaha Buluugga ah, Batroolka iyo Macdanta, Maalgashiga iyo Warshadaha, Guddoomiyaha Hay’adda Maalgashiga Soomaaliyeed, Ergayga Gaarka ah ee La-dagaallanka Argagixisada iyo Xagjirnimada, iyo Ku-simaha Madaxa Hawlgalka Qaramada Midoobay ee Taageerada Soomaaliya. Sidoo kale, Kaaliyaha Wasiirka ayaa kulan la yeeshay Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya Mudane Macallin Fiqi, iyadoo uu kulanka ka qayb galay erayga difaaca Masar ee Muqdisho. Kulamada ayaa lagu adkeeyay mowqifka joogtada ah ee Masar ee taageerada midnimada, xasilloonida iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Soomaaliya, iyo sidoo kale taageerada dadaallada lagu dhisayo hay’adaha dowladda Soomaaliyeed. Dhanka kale dowladda Masar ayaa cambaareysay tallaabo kasta oo hal dhinac ah oo lagu wiiqayo madaxbannaanida iyo midnimada Soomaaliya. Labada dhinac ayaa sidoo kale ka wada hadlay muhiimadda xoojinta iskaashiga amniga Badda Cas, iyagoo taageeray dadaallada lagu horumarinayo Golaha Dalalka Carabta iyo Afrika ee ku teedsan Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed, iyo hindisaha horumarinta dhaqaalaha iyo marin-biyoodka ee loo yaqaan (StREAM). Masar iyo Soomaaliya waxay isku raaceen in mas’uuliyadda ilaalinta amniga iyo xasilloonida Badda Cas ay gaar u tahay dalalka xeebaha ku leh, iyadoo la muujiyay baahida loo qabo iskaashi dhow oo looga hortagayo isku dayada lagu hurinayo qalalaasaha iyo xasillooni darrada gobolka. Kulamada ayaa sidoo kale lagu falanqeeyay ka qaybgalka ciidamada Masar ee Hawlgalka Midowga Afrika ee Taageerada iyo Xasilinta Soomaaliya (AUSSOM), iyo sidii loo sii xoojin lahaa xiriirka labada dal ee dhinacyada amniga, difaaca, la-dagaallanka argagixisada, kalluumeysiga, batroolka iyo macdanta, maalgashiga, warshadaha, gaadiidka badda iyo cirka. Ugu dambeyn, waxaa la isla soo qaaday baahiyaha Soomaaliya ee dhinacyada tababarrada, kor u qaadista xirfadaha iyo dhismaha awoodaha shaqaalaha, si loogu waafajiyo barnaamijyada iyo koorsooyinka ay bixiso Hay’adda Masar ee Iskaashiga Horumarinta iyo hay’adaha kale ee dowladda Masar.

items.title: Army Commander Removed Amid Reports of Refusal to Join Operation Against Opposition Figures
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) – Former President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud has reportedly dismissed Colonel Adan Jeele, commander of the 23rd Military Police Brigade, in a move that is fueling fresh controversy over the government’s handling of Somalia’s deepening political crisis. According to emerging reports, Colonel Adan Jeele was removed from his position after allegedly refusing to participate in a security operation targeting prominent opposition leaders critical of the president’s political agenda and proposed electoral process. Col Adan jeele Sources familiar with the matter claim that the dismissed commander declined to take part in an operation directed against former President Sharif Sheikh Ahmed and former Prime Minister Hassan Ali Khaire, both of whom have emerged as leading critics of what they describe as an attempt to extend political control without broad national consensus. The two opposition figures have been vocal opponents of the current administration’s electoral plans and have repeatedly called for an inclusive political agreement before any national vote is held. Loyalist Officer Takes Command ; Military sources indicate that Colonel Adan Jeele has been replaced by Abdullahi Osman Jimale, an officer widely regarded as being closely aligned with President Hassan Sheikh. The appointment is expected to intensify concerns among opposition groups and political observers who have increasingly accused the government of politicizing state institutions and using security agencies to manage political disputes. While the Federal Government has not publicly explained the reasons behind the command change, reports circulating within security circles suggest that Adan Jeele’s refusal to participate in the controversial operation was a decisive factor in his dismissal. The development comes at a time of escalating tensions between the federal government and opposition leaders over the future of Somalia’s electoral process. The administration continues to push forward with its proposed one-person, one-vote electoral model, a plan that critics argue lacks sufficient political consensus and institutional preparation. Opposition leaders have warned that attempts to impose major electoral changes without broad agreement could deepen instability and undermine confidence in national institutions. Political analysts say the reported removal of a senior military officer for refusing to engage in a politically sensitive operation, if confirmed, would mark another sign of the widening divide between the government and its opponents. The controversy has also revived longstanding concerns about the role of Somalia’s security forces in political disputes. The Military Police Brigade has traditionally been tasked with maintaining military discipline and enforcing security regulations within the armed forces. Any perception that such units are being drawn into partisan political conflicts risks further eroding public confidence in the neutrality of state institutions. Observers note that Somalia’s fragile political environment requires security forces to remain above political competition and focused on their constitutional responsibilities rather than becoming instruments in disputes between rival political camps. Pressure on Opposition Continues;The reported dismissal comes amid broader allegations that the government is increasing pressure on opposition figures who reject the president’s electoral roadmap. With political negotiations largely stalled and trust between the government and opposition at one of its lowest points in recent years, the latest development is likely to add further strain to an already volatile political landscape. As Somalia moves closer to a critical period of political transition, questions continue to mount over whether the country’s leaders can find a consensual path forward—or whether the confrontation between the government and opposition will deepen further in the months ahead. items.title: Wararkii ugu dambeeyay dagaalka Gobolka Jubbada Hoose
items.description: Militariga Somaliya oo garabsanaya Daraawiishta Jubbaland ayaa meelo ka mid ah Gobolka Jubbada Hoose kula dagaalamaya maleeshiyada Al Shabaab. Dagaalka ayaa dhowrkii maalmood ee u dambeeyay si xiriir ah uga socday dhulka ku teedsan deegaanada Biibi, Qumbi, Miido, Harboole, Weel-maarow iyo Dhasheeg Waamo oo hoostaga Degmada Afmadow. Afhayeenka Ciidanka Jubbaland, G/dhexe Maxamed Faarax Daahir ayaa Arbacadan sheegay in ciidamadu ay haatan hawlgal sifayn ah ka wadaan dhulka u dhaxeeya Degmada Afmadow iyo deegaanka Janaay Cabdalla. “Culeyska ugu badan wuxuu hadda ka jiraa Afmadow iyo Janaay Cabdalla inta u dhaxeyso oo 60km oo isku wareeg ah. Marka hawlgalka sidaas ayuu u jiraa.” Ayuu yiri Afhayeenka. Afhayeenka ayaa tilmaamay in hawlgalka xooggiisu uu xilligan ka socdo aagga deegaanka Dhasheeg Waamo, halkaas oo uu ku sheegay xudunta hawlgalka. “Xudunta hawlgalka waa Dhasheeg Waamo meesha la yiraahdo, yacni Dhasheeg Waamo ayay isugu soo uruursaneysaa culeyska ugu weyn.” Ayuu yiri Afhayeenka. Hawlgalkan ayaa waxaa iska kaashanaya Kumaandooska Danab, Ciidanka Guutada 11aad, Qaybta 43aad ee Xoogga Dalka iyo Daraawiishta Jubbaland. Afhayeenka Ciidanka Jubbaland ayaa sheegaya in hawlgalka ay ka qayb qaadanayaan diyaaradaha dagaalka ee saaxiibada caalamiga ah ee Ciidamada Qalabka Sida ka taageera weerarada xagga cirka. “Dagaalka waxaa qayb ka ah saaxiibada caalamiga ah oo duqayn cirka ah ka sameynaya.” Ayuu yiri G/dhexe Maxamed Faarax Daahir, Afhayeenka Ciidanka Jubbaland. “Khasaaraha dhankooda inta aan aniga hubo oo Warbaahinta la wadaagi karno, illaa 10 xubnood oo meydkooda ah way ka carareen, waana qabanay, laakiin sida ay dadku noo sheegayaan ama aan cabirayno dhaawac fara-badan iyo meyd fara-badanba way qaateen, howshuna weli ma soo geba-gaboobin oo gacantaa la isku la jiraa.” Ayuu yiri Afhayeenka. Afhayeenka ayaa waxa uu xusay inaanu jirin khasaare uu sheegi karo oo illaa iyo hadda ciidamada ka soo gaaray dagaalka. Deegaanka Dhasheeg Waamo oo dhaca goob istiraatiiji ah ayaa ah dhul daaqsiimeed oo qayb ahaan hawd ah, wuxuuna ku yaallaa inta u dhaxeyso Afmadow iyo Kismaayo, waana deegaan dhinaca kalena saaran waddada laamiga ee isku xirto Kismaayo iyo Jilib. Dhasheeg Waamo ayaa xilliyada roobka uruursada oo fariista biyo ballaaran, kuwaas oo ka sameysma balliyo waaweyn oo si dabiici ah ugu kaydsama biyaha roobka. Haddii ciidamadu ay la wareegaan deegaankan ayaa ka dhigan in la jebiyay mid ka mid ah gidaarada difaaca Al Shabaab ee Degmada Jilib ee Gobolka Jubbada Dhexe. Shabaabka ayaa Jilib ku leh xaruntooda ugu weyn ee dalka, taas oo si weyn ay ammaankeeda u ilaaliyaan.

Dhasheeg Waamo ayaa xilliyada roobka uruursada oo fariista biyo ballaaran, kuwaas oo ka sameysma balliyo waaweyn oo si dabiici ah ugu kaydsama biyaha roobka. Haddii ciidamadu ay la wareegaan deegaankan ayaa ka dhigan in la jebiyay mid ka mid ah gidaarada difaaca Al Shabaab ee Degmada Jilib ee Gobolka Jubbada Dhexe. Shabaabka ayaa Jilib ku leh xaruntooda ugu weyn ee dalka, taas oo si weyn ay ammaankeeda u ilaaliyaan.

items.title: Sawirro: Sacuudiga oo hal arrin oo muhiim ah u xaqiijiyay dowladda Xasan Sheekh
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xamza Cabdi Barre ayaa maanta xafiiskiisa ku qaabilay Danjiraha Boqortooyada Sacuudiga u fadhiya Soomaaliya, Axmed Bin Maxamed Al-Muwallad, iyadoo kulankooda looga hadlay xoojinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga u dhexeeya labada dal. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray horumarinta xiriirka istiraatiijiga ah ee ka dhexeeya Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo Boqortooyada Sacuudiga, iyo sidii loo sii ballaarin lahaa wada-shaqeynta dhinacyada dhaqaalaha, ganacsiga iyo maalgashiga. Labada mas’uul ayaa sidoo kale ka wada-hadlay fursadaha cusub ee lagu kobcin karo xiriirka labada dowladood, iyagoo carrabka ku adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay in la xoojiyo iskaashiga ku saleysan danaha wadajirka ah ee labada shacab iyo dowladood. Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamza Cabdi Barre ayaa uga mahadceliyay Boqortooyada Sacuudiga taageerada joogtada ah ee ay siiso Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan dhinacyada horumarinta, gargaarka bani’aadannimada iyo taageerada shacabka Soomaaliyeed. Waxa uu sidoo kale bogaadiyay mowqifka Sacuudiga ee ku aaddan taageerada midnimada, madax-bannaanida iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, isaga oo tilmaamay in xiriirka labada dal uu yahay mid taariikhi ah oo ku dhisan walaaltinimo iyo iskaashi dhow. Dhankiisa, Danjire Axmed Bin Maxamed Al-Muwallad ayaa xaqiijiyay sida ay Boqortooyada Sacuudigu uga go’an tahay sii xoojinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga kala dhexeeya dowladda uu hoggaamiyo Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh iyo shacabka Soomaaliyeed, isaga oo xusay in dalkiisu sii wadi doono taageerada uu siiyo Soomaaliya. Danjiraha ayaa sidoo kale ku ammaanay Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya dadaallada ay ku xaqiijinayso amniga dalka iyo horumarrada la taaban karo ee ka socda qaybaha kala duwan ee dalka, kuwaas oo uu sheegay inay ka tarjumayaan horumarka ay Soomqaaliya ku tallaabsanayso. Si kastaba, dowladda Soomaaliya iyo Sacuudiga ayaa si weyn kor ugu qaaday xiriirkooda, iyagoo qalinka ku duugay heshiisyo iskaashi oo ku saabsan dhanka difaaca, dekedaha iyo gaadiidka badda. The post Sawirro: Sacuudiga oo hal arrin oo muhiim ah u xaqiijiyay dowladda Xasan Sheekh appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Maamulka Jubaland oo DF dusha u saaray mas’uuliyadda…
items.description: Kismaayo (Caasimada Online) – Maamul-goboleedka Jubaland ayaa shaaciyay in garoonka diyaaradaha ee degmada Doolow uu si toos ah ugu xiran yahay Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya. War-saxaafadeed kasoo baxay Wasaaradda Gaadiidka iyo Duulista Hawada Jubaland ayaa lagu caddeeyay in xirnaanshaha Garoonka Doolow uusan salka ku hayn sababo farsamo, amni ama kuwo la xiriira badqabka duulimaadyada. “Dowladda Jubaland waxay shacabka Jubaland, shacabka Soomaaliyeed guud ahaan iyo beesha caalamkaba si rasmi ah ugu caddaynaysaa in garoonka diyaaradaha degmada Doolow uu si toos ah ugu xiran yahay Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, isla markaana xirnaanshaha garoonka uusan salka ku hayn sababo farsamo, amni ama kuwo la xiriira badqabka duulimaadyada,” ayaa lagu yiri war-saxaafadeedka Jubaland. Wasaaradda ayaa sheegtay in dhammaan dadaalladii, codsiyadii iyo xiriirradii rasmiga ahaa ee lagu doonayay dib-u-furista garoonka Doolow ay guul-darraysteen, isla markaana hay’adda duulista rayidka Soomaaliyeed ay xaqiijisay in aysan awood u lahayn qaadashada go’aan madax-bannaan oo lagu furayo garoonka. Xirnaanshaha garoonka diyaaradaha Doolow ayay wasaaraddu sheegtay inuu sababay dhibaato ballaaran oo ku dhacday adeegyada caafimaadka, dhaqaalaha, ganacsiga, isu-socodka bulshada iyo howlaha gargaarka bani’aadannimo ee degmada Doolow iyo deegaannada ku xeeran. “Wasaaradda Gaadiidka iyo Duulista Hawada Dowladda Jubbaland waxay si adag u cambaaraynaysaa ku-takri-falka awoodeed ee Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, taas oo maamulka hawada Soomaaliya u adeegsanaysa dano siyaasadeed. Xannibaadda lagu hayo garoonka Doolow waxay noqotay tusaale muuqda oo muujinaya sida awoodaha farsamo ee maamulka hawada loogu adeegsanayo cadaadis siyaasadeed,” ayaa sidoo kale lagu yiri war-saxaafadeedka. Wasaaraddu waxay intaas ku dartay in xirnaanshaha garoonka Doolow uu ka hor imaanayo xeerarka duulista rayidka Soomaaliyeed iyo halbeegyada hay’adda duulista rayidka adduunka, iyadoo Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ku eedeysay inay mas’uul ka tahay dhibaatooyinka ka dhashay xirnaanshaha muddada dheer socday. Hoos ka aqriso war-saxaafadeedka oo dhameystiran: Dowladda Jubbaland, waxay shacabka Jubbaland, shacabka Soomaaliyeed guud ahaan iyo beesha caalamkaba si rasmi ah ugu caddaynaysaa in Garoonka Diyaaradaha Degmada Doolow uu si toos ah ugu xiran yahay Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, isla markaana xirnaanshaha garoonka uusan salka ku hayn sababo farsamo, amni ama kuwo la xiriira badqabka duulimaadyada. Dowladda Jubbaland waxay si cad u sheegaysaa in dhammaan dadaalladii, codsiyadii iyo xiriirradii rasmiga ahaa ee lagu doonayay dib-u-furista Garoonka Doolow ay guul-darraysteen, iyadoo Hay’adda Duulista Rayidka Soomaaliyeed (SCAA) ay xaqiijisay in aysan awood u lahayn qaadashada go’aan madax-bannaan oo lagu furayo garoonka. Garoonka Diyaaradaha Doolow ayaa xirnaa tan iyo 19-kii Luulyo 2025. Xirnaanshaha muddada dheer socday ayaa sababay dhibaato ballaaran oo ku dhacday adeegyada caafimaadka, dhaqaalaha, ganacsiga, isu-socodka bulshada iyo hawlaha gargaarka bini’aadantinimo ee degmada Doolow iyo deegaannada ku xeeran. Wasaaradda Gaadiidka iyo Duulista Hawada Dowladda Jubbaland waxay si adag u cambaaraynaysaa ku-takri-falka awoodeed ee Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, taas oo maamulka hawada Soomaaliya u adeegsanaysa dano siyaasadeed. Xannibaadda lagu hayo Garoonka Doolow waxay noqotay tusaale muuqda oo muujinaya sida awoodaha farsamo ee maamulka hawada loogu adeegsanayo cadaadis siyaasadeed. Arrintani waxay si cad uga hor imaanaysaa xeerarka duulista rayidka Soomaaliyeed iyo halbeegyada ay dejisay Hay’adda Duulista Rayidka Adduunka (ICAO), kuwaas oo dhigaya in maamulka hawada iyo adeegyada duulista rayidka lagu saleeyo dhexdhexaadnimo, madax-bannaani farsamo iyo xaqiijinta badqabka duulista hawada. Dowladda Jubbaland waxay markale daaha ka qaadaysaa in xirnaanshaha Garoonka Diyaaradaha Doolow uu yahay go’aan ka yimid Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, isla markaana mas’uuliyadda dhammaan dhibaatooyinka ka dhasha xirnaanshaha muddada dheer socday ay si toos ah u qaadayso Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya. ==DHAMMAAD== The post Maamulka Jubaland oo DF dusha u saaray mas’uuliyadda… appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Beeraley ku nool Galgaduud oo wajahaya nolol xumo markii gubay beero ay ku tiirsanaayeen
items.description: (ERGO) – Cali Xasan Maalin mid ka mid ah xaasaskiisa iyo gabar uu dhalay oo sanad jir ah ayaa u geeriyooday bishii Maarso nafaqo-darro, markii uu u awoodi waayay cunno qoyskiisa oo 18 qof ka kooban tan iyo dhamaadkii sanadkii hore. Sidoo kale wuxuu kari waayay in uu xilli hore geeyo xarun caafimaad dhaqaale xumo darteed. Reerka ninkaan ayaa ka mid ah in konton qoys oo beeralay ahaa oo galay xaalad nolol xumo ah oo aad u liidata. Bishii labaad ayaa laga gubay beero ay ku lahaayeen deegaanada Dab-dheer iyo Wabarka oo hoos taga magaalada Dhuusamareeb ee gobolka Galgadaduud, kuwaas oo noloshoodu ku tiirsanayd. Arrintan ayaa timid kaddib markii odayaasha dhaqanka ee deegaannadan ay dawladda ka codsadeen in beeraha la gubo. Waxay u arkeen xalka is qabqabsi dhul oo marar badan soo laalabtay. Ninkaan ayaa sheegay in beertiisa oo labo hektar ah uu bishii Diseembar ee sanadkii hore ku abuuray Dallagyo isku jiray raashin iyo khudaar, kuwaas oo dhamaan bas-beelay. Xilliga la gubayay ayuu sheegay in ay iib gayn u diyaarsanaayeen dalagyada. Xaaladdaas ayaa keentay nolol xumo aysan abid mudan. “Waxaan ku tiirsanahay koonbo baris ah iyo koonbo sonkor ah oo ay xaaskayga reeraha dariska ah ka soo dawarsato. Xaalada adag ayaan ku suganahay. Oday 77 jir ah ayaan ahay. Illahey mooye meel kale wax kama sugayno. Wixii na caawin kara waa u bahanahay.” Cali ayaa sheegay in uu cabsi ka qabo in dad kale ay kaga geeriyoodaan nafaqo darrada. Wuxuu tilmaamayin in xilligaan ay weli ka sii darayso xaaladda qoysaskiisa. Labo carruurtiisa ugu yar ayuu sheegay in hadda ay jirran yihiin muddo labo todobaad ah uusanna gayn goob caafimaad si xaaladdooda loo baxnaaniyo. Ganacsato ay qaraabo yihiin oo uu horay uga dayntay $230 oo uu isbitaalka ku geeyay dadkii geeriyooday ayay xusay in ay mid kale u diideen. Xaaladdaas darteed wuxuu sheegay in hadda uu ka rajo dhigay in uu dawo la raadiyo. Wuxuu sheegay in deeganka aysan ka jirin wax xarun caafimaad ah. Meesha ugu soo sokeysa waa magaalada Dhusamareeb oo deeganka Wabarka oo uu jooga u jirta qiyaastii in ka badan 30 km. Wuxuu xusay in lagu tago $50. Xaaladaha kale ee haysta qoyskiisa waxaa ka mid ah biyo yari. Waxay ku tiirsan yihiin hal jirgaan oo ay ka helaan dadka dariska la ah, kaas oo aan ku filnayn reerkiisa badan. Booyado biyaha ka keena deeganka lowrkii oo fustaadii iibiya $2 ayuu xusay in uusan awoodin. Wuxuu hadda gocanaya inuusan dib u tacbi karin beertiisa. “Deeganka Wabarka beer igu taalay ayaa la iga gubay. Waxaa amarka lagu gubay bixiyay rag odayaal ah. codsanayaa in raggii beertayda gubay shareecadda islaamka iyo calaadda in la ii hor keeno.” Wuxuu xusay in uu filayay in tacabkiisa uu ka faa’iido $800 haddii uu goosan laha, balse rajadaas ayuu ku hungoobay. Ninkaan oo sidoo kale ahaa xoolodhaqato ayaa roob la’aanta soo laalabatay ku wayay 65 arri ah oo uu dhaqanayay. Dhamaan beeralaydan oo ka siman saamaynta ayaa sheegay in aysan dib u yagleeli karin beerahoodi. Dayib Cali Axmed wuxuu tilmaamay in saddexdii bil ee la soo dhaafay ay qoyskiisa oo 10 qof ah wajahayaan nolol xumo liidato. Beer saddex hiktar ah oo ay noloshoodu ku tiirsanayd ayuu xusay in ay noqotay meel banaan. Dallagyo iskugu jiray galey, digir, masago, qaro iyo sinsin oo uu beertiisa bishii Janaayo ku galiyay $350 ayuu xusay in aysan waxbo uga babaadin, taas oo nolol xumo u horsedday reerkiisa. “Wax ii kaydsamay malahan wixii dhaw waa la iga gubay. Waxaan noqday qof isaga oo xoola leh inta laga qaatay meel cidlo ah ku soo dhacay oo gacan maran.” Dayib ayaa sheegay in reerkiisu ay dabka ku shitaan raashin ay u soo dhiibaan dad ay ehel yihiin oo jooga magaalada Dhusamareeb, kuwaas oo uu u dan sheegtay. Dhanka kale qoyskiisa waxaa ku adag helida biyaha. Booyado 30 fuusta qaada ayaa deeganka Dab-dheer oo uu ku nool yahay ku keena $50, taas oo uusan awodin. Waxay ka soo dhaamiyaan magaalada Dhusamareeb oo u jirta qiyaastii in ka badan 20 km. Sido kale waxaa saamaynta ku sii kordhasay bac uu biyaha ku kaysdan jiray oo u dhex taallay beerta oo dabku qabsaday. Arrintaas ayaa ku qasabtay in uu mutaan baco ay leeyihiin reero daris la ah oo biyaha ku caawiya, kuwaas oo ay garabka uga soo qaataan Bishii saddexaad ayuu xusay in laga soo eryay iskuul hoose iyo dhexe oo ay dhiganayeen, markii uu awoodi waayay $25 oo wax lagu barayaay. Taclin la’aanta soo wajahday ayuu walwal ka muujiyay. “Waxyaaba badan oo ay beerta iga aadanayd ayaa banaanka ku soo dhacay. Xilliga la gubayay ayuu sheegay in ay iib gayn u diyaarsanaayeen dalagyada. items.title: Madaxweynaha Faransiiska oo sheegay in xabad joojinta Lubnaan ay khasab tahay inay noqoto mid buuxda
items.description: Madaxweynaha Faransiiska, Emmanuel Macron ayaa sheegay in ay lama huraan tahay in xabad joojinta Lubnaan ay noqoto mid buuxda oo degdeg ah. Madaxweynaha oo ka hadlay xaaladda Lubnaan ayaa sheegay in Hoggaamiyeyaasha G7 ay aaminsan yihiin in xabad joojinta dalkaasi ay lagama maarmaan tahay inay noqoto mid buuxda oo degdeg ah. “Heshiiska Mareykanka iyo Iran waa inuu xaqiijiyaa madaxbannaanida iyo midnimada dhuleed ee Lubnaan.” Ayuu yiri Madaxweynaha Faransiiska. Madaxweyne Macron oo sii hadlayay ayaa sheegay in xabad joojintu ay muhiim u tahay ilaalinta madaxbannaanida dhuleed ee Lubnaan, iyada oo la taageerayo Ciidamada Qalabka Sida ee dalkaasi, si ay ula wareegaan maamulka dalka oo dhan. Macron oo galabta ka hadlayay munaasabadda xiritaanka ee Shirka G7 ayaa ku celiyay in ay khasab tahay in la ixtiraamo xabad joojinta Lubnaan. Macron ayaa mabda’ ahaan taageeray heshiiska Mareykanka iyo Iran ee lagu wado in labada dowladood ay saxiixaan Jimcaha soo socda. Macron ayaa ku nuux-nuuxsaday in heshiisku uu yahay mid aad u wanaagsan, sababtoo ah buu yiri waa heshiis joojinaya xaalad xasillooni darro ah oo cawaaqib xun ku yeelatay dhaqaalaheenna. Hoggaamiyeyaasha G7 ayaa si wadajir ah u dalbaday in si degdeg ah loo joojiyo dagaalka Lubnaan. Ciidamada Israel ayaa maanta sii waday weerarada xagga cirka ee ay ka gaysanayaan Koonfurta Lubnaan, xilli Iran ay ka digtay sii socoshada gardarrada Israel ee ka dhanka ah dalkaasi, isla-markaana uu Madaxweyne Donald Trump ugu baaqay Raysal Wasaare Benjamin Netanyahu inuu masuuliyad dheeraad ah ka yeesho arrinta Lubnaan. Israel ayay u cuntami la’dahay inay aqbasho xabad joojin dhameystiran oo laga dhaqangeliyo Lubnaan, iyadoo aan Xisbullah hubka laga dhigin. Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Iran, Abbas Araghchi ayaa caddeeyay in hirgelinta iyo guusha heshiiska lagu soo afjarayo colaadda ay shuruud uga dhigeen joojinta dagaalka Lubnaan iyo in Ciidamada Israel ay si buuxda uga baxaan dhulka ay ka joogaan dalkaasi.

items.title: Israel oo banaanka keentay arrin uu qarinayay maamulka Somaliland
items.description: Qudus (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Israa’iil ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in muddo dheer xiriir iyo iskaashi dhinaca amniga iyo milateriga ah si qarsoodi ah ula lahaa maamulka Somaliland. Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Israa’iil, Israel Katz oo arrintan qiray ayaa sheegay in labada dhinac ay haatan doonayaan inay iskaashiga gaarsiiyaan heer cusub. Hadalka Katz ayaa yimid kaddib kulan uu magaalada Qudus kula yeeshay Madaxweynaha Somaliland, Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi (Cirro) oo booqasho rasmi ah ku jooga Israa’iil. Kulanka ayaa qeyb ka ah dadaallada lagu xoojinayo xiriirka sii kobcaya ee u dhexeeya labada dhinac. War-saxaafadeed kasoo baxay xafiiska wasiirka gaashaandhigga Israa’iil ayaa lagu sheegay in kulanka looga hadlay arrimo la xiriira amniga, xasilloonida gobolka, iskaashiga istaraatiijiga ah iyo sidii loo ballaarin lahaa wada-shaqeynta labada dhinac. “Israa’iil iyo Somaliland waxay leeyihiin saaxiibtinimo soo jireen ah oo ku dhisan dano wadaag, qiyam dimuqraadi ah iyo ka go’naanshaha amniga iyo xasilloonida. Muddo dheer ayaan si qarsoodi ah uga wada shaqeynaynay hawlo kala duwan,” ayuu yiri Katz, isaga oo xusay in Israa’iil ay ka go’an tahay inay iskaashiga amniga gaarsiiso heerar cusub. Dhankiisa, Afhayeenka Madaxweynaha Somaliland, Xuseen Aadan Cige (Deyr) ayaa sheegay in madaxweyne Cirro iyo wasiirka gaashaandhigga Israa’iil ay ka wada-hadleen arrimo istaraatiiji ah oo ay ka mid yihiin amniga, xasilloonida gobolka, iskaashiga hay’adaha amniga iyo xoojinta xiriirka labada dhinac. Qiraalkan kasoo baxay Israa’iil ayaa ku soo beegmaya xilli warbaahinta Mareykanka qaarkeed ay daabaceen warbixino sheegaya in Israa’iil ay Somaliland ka fulisay hawl-gallo amni iyo milatari oo qarsoodi ah intii uu socday dagaalkii u dhexeeyay Israa’iil iyo Iran, inkastoo aan si madax-bannaan loo xaqiijin faah-faahinta wararkaas. Sidoo kale, Israa’iil ayaa la sheegay in Somaliland ay ka taageerto dhinacyada tababarka ciidamada iyo hay’adaha amniga. Si kastaba, hadalka wasiirka gaashaandhigga Israa’iil ayaa loo arkaa xaqiijintii ugu horeysay ee muujinaysa inuu jiray iskaashi amni oo qarsoodi ah oo u dhexeeyay labada dhinac, iyadoo la filayo in wada-shaqeyntaas mustaqbalka noqoto mid si rasmi ah loo shaaciyo. items.title: Safiirka Israel ee QM oo wax xun ku tilmaamay heshiiska lagu soo afjarayo dagaalka Iran
items.description: Safiirka Israel u jooga Qaramada Midoobey, Danny Danon ayaa wax xun ku tilmaamay heshiiska ay dhawaan gaareen Mareykanka iyo Iran ee lagu soo afjarayo dagaalka Gobolka Bariga Dhexe. Safiirka ayaa sheegaya in heshiiskan uu aad ugu xun yahay, isla-markaana aanu u wanaagsaneyn Israel, Mareykanka iyo dalalka Khaliijka. Safiirka ayaa wareysi uu siiyay Telefishinka Channel 14 ee Israel ku sheegay in dadaalka degdegga ah ee Madaxweyne Donald Trump ku doonayo in lagu soo afjaro dagaalka uu u ogolaaday Iran inay horumariso buu yiri mowqifkeeda. Wuxuu sheegay in heshiisku uu khatar ku yahay amniga Israel, Mareykanka qudhiisa iyo weliba dalalka Khaliijka ee xulafada la ah Mareykanka. Danon ayaa xusay inaanan weli la gaarin go’aan kama dambeys, isla-markaana heshiiska xilligan uu yahay oo keliya qaab dhismeed lagu sii ambaqaadayo wada hadalada. “Laakiin waa inaan sugno. Ma jiro go’aan rasmi ah, keliya qaab dhismeedka heshiiska waa mid lagu sii wadaayo wada hadalada.” Ayuu yiri Danon. Israel ayaan fileynin in Trump uu aqbali doono heshiis si buuxda loogu soo afjarayo dagaalka oo Lubnaan ay ku jirto, iyadoo aan la xaqiijin yoolashii ay 28-kii bishii February u weerareen Iran. Mareykanka iyo Israel ayaa ugu duulay dalkaasi in la bedelo nidaamka ka arrimiya Iran, in la wiiqo awoodda militari ee ciidamada dalkaasi, in la joojiyo taageerada Iran ee ururada hubeysan ee gobolka iyo in Tehran lagu khasbo inay ka tanaasusho sameysashada nuclear oo dhan, mid militari iyo rayidba. Madaxweyne Trump ayaa aqbalay heshiiska hadda lala galay Iran oo lagu wado in Jimcaha la saxiixo, xilli adkeysiga Iran uu ka hortagey inay is dhiibto.

Safiirka ayaa wareysi uu siiyay Telefishinka Channel 14 ee Israel ku sheegay in dadaalka degdegga ah ee Madaxweyne Donald Trump ku doonayo in lagu soo afjaro dagaalka uu u ogolaaday Iran inay horumariso buu yiri mowqifkeeda. Wuxuu sheegay in heshiisku uu khatar ku yahay amniga Israel, Mareykanka qudhiisa iyo weliba dalalka Khaliijka ee xulafada la ah Mareykanka. Danon ayaa xusay inaanan weli la gaarin go’aan kama dambeys, isla-markaana heshiiska xilligan uu yahay oo keliya qaab dhismeed lagu sii ambaqaadayo wada hadalada. “Laakiin waa inaan sugno. Ma jiro go’aan rasmi ah, keliya qaab dhismeedka heshiiska waa mid lagu sii wadaayo wada hadalada.” Ayuu yiri Danon. Israel ayaan fileynin in Trump uu aqbali doono heshiis si buuxda loogu soo afjarayo dagaalka oo Lubnaan ay ku jirto, iyadoo aan la xaqiijin yoolashii ay 28-kii bishii February u weerareen Iran. Mareykanka iyo Israel ayaa ugu duulay dalkaasi in la bedelo nidaamka ka arrimiya Iran, in la wiiqo awoodda militari ee ciidamada dalkaasi, in la joojiyo taageerada Iran ee ururada hubeysan ee gobolka iyo in Tehran lagu khasbo inay ka tanaasusho sameysashada nuclear oo dhan, mid militari iyo rayidba. Madaxweyne Trump ayaa aqbalay heshiiska hadda lala galay Iran oo lagu wado in Jimcaha la saxiixo, xilli adkeysiga Iran uu ka hortagey inay is dhiibto.

items.title: Wasaarada arimha dibada ee Somaliland oo daadafaysay qoraal ka soo baxay Somalia
items.description: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah ee Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland ayaa soo saartay bayaan ay ku diidday qoraal ka soo baxay Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya oo ku saabsanaa xidhiidhada diblomaasiyadeed iyo booqashooyinka caalamiga ah ee Somaliland. Bayaanka ayaa lagu sheegay in booqashada heer qaran ee Madaxweynaha Somaliland, Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi (Cirro), uu ku joogo Israel ay muujinayso xaqa Somaliland u leedahay inay si madax-bannaan u maamusho arrimaheeda dibadda iyo xidhiidhadeeda caalamiga ah. Wasaaraddu waxay sheegtay in booqashadani ay caddeyn u tahay sii ballaadhinta xidhiidhada caalamiga ah ee Somaliland, iyadoo ku adkaysatay inay sii wadi doonto difaaca madaxbannaanideeda, qaranimadeeda iyo karaamadeeda. Bayaanka ayaa sidoo kale lagu xusay in Somaliland ay xaq u leedahay inay la yeelato xidhiidho diblomaasiyadeed iyo iskaashi caalami ah dalalka ay danaha wadaagaan, iyadoo aan cid kale faragelin ku yeelan karin go’aannadeeda madaxbannaan.

items.title: Somalia U-17 Women’s Team Beats Sudan 8-2 in Historic CECAFA Victory
items.description: Somalia has written history after their team won their first International match in Women’s Football. After losing the first two matches to Tanzania and Kenya, the Somalia team registered an 8-2 victory against Sudan in a Group A match of the CECAFA U-17 Women’s Championship played on Wednesday. Nagma Mohamed netted a hat-trick, while Sundus Mohamaed picked a brace in the huge win for Somalia at the KMC Stadium in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania. Hibo Salad, Halimo Isse and Maryan Osoble also got their names on the score sheet. The Sudan team which is also playing in the regional tournament for the first time scored through Nashwa Abbas and Fatin Fadol. It was all celebration for the Somalia team that wrote their own history that should ignite more positivity in women’s Football back at home. “I am very happy that I scored three goals today. This will motivate me to keep working hard,” said Nagma Mohamed who netted a hat-trick and was voted player of the match. Somalia’s head coach Maha Mohamed Hagi said he was very impressed with the effort of the team and picking their first win at International level. “We came for this tournament to learn and I am glad we have also collected a win. We shall keep improving as we participate in many more tournaments,” added the coach. Somalia lost their opening match 4-0 to hosts Tanzania, and lost 6-0 to Kenya in the second match. They completed the tournament in style with an 8-2 victory against Sudan. CECAFA.

items.title: Duqa Muqdisho oo soo saaray xeer cusub iyo maareeynta Qashinka iyo Lo’da waddooyinka
items.description: Muqdisho ( Raxanreeb Online) Guddoomiyaha Maamulka Gobolka Banaadir ahna Duqa Magaalada Muqdisho, Dr. Xasan Maxamed Xuseen (Muungaab), ayaa maanta si rasmi ah qalinka ugu duugay Xeerka Nadaafadda Gobolka Banaadir, kaas oo noqonaya xeerkii ugu horreeyay ee si gaar ah loogu nidaaminayo arrimaha nadaafadda, maaraynta qashinka iyo ilaalinta deegaanka ee caasimadda Muqdisho. Guddoomiye Muungaab, ayaa sheegay in xeerkan uu saldhig u noqon doono dadaallada lagu xoojinayo nadaafadda caasimadda, korna loogu qaadayo bilicda iyo caafimaadka bulshada, isagoo ugu baaqay shacabka iyo hay’adaha kala duwan inay ka wada shaqeeyaan dhaqangelinta iyo ku-dhaqanka qodobbada xeerkan. Wasiirka Wasaaradda deegaanka iyo Isbedelka Cimilada XFS Bashiir Maxamed Jaamac ayaa hoosta ka xariiqay in xeerkaan uu waxbadan ka qabanayo ilaalinta deegaanka, asigoona xusay in wasaaradda deegaanka ay si dhaw ula shaqeyn doonto Maamulka Gobolka Banaadir iyo Dowladda Hoose ee Xamar. Munaasabadda saxiixa xeerkan waxaa goob-joog ka ahaa; Guddoomiye Ku-xigeenada Maamulka Gobolka Banaadir, Xoghayaha Guud ee Maamulka G/Banaadir, Guddoomiyeyaasha Degmooyinka, Agaasimeyaal, mas’uuliyiin ka socday hay’addaha garsoorka, Odayaasha Dhaqanka, Culimaa’uddiin, Bulshada Rayidka, Haweenka, mas’uuliyiinta shirkadda IFI iyo daneeyeyaal ka socday arrimaha deegaanka. items.title: DF Soomaaliya oo diyaarinaysa ciidamo fara badan iyo arrinta ka dambeysa
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa dardar-gelisay qorshe ay mas’uuliyadda amniga dalka si tartiib-tartiib ah ugala wareegayso ciidamada howl-galka Midowga Afrika ee AUSSOM, kuwaas oo Soomaaliya ku sugnaa tan iyo sanadkii 2007, iyagoo ka qeyb qaadanayay sugidda amniga iyo la-dagaallanka kooxda Al-Shabaab. Xogo ay heshay Caasimada Online ayaa tilmaamaya in dowladda ay haatan diyaarinayso cutubyo ka tirsan ciidanka xoogga oo soo maray tababaro heer sare ah, kuwaas oo loo qorsheeyay inay la wareegaan waajibaadka ay hayaan ciidamada AUSSOM. Ciidamadan cusub ayaa la sheegay in lagu qalabeynayo gaadiid, hub iyo agab ciidan oo casri ah, si ay u yeeshaan awoodda lagama maarmaanka u ah sugidda amniga iyo fulinta howlgallada ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab ee ka socda gobollada dalka. Maalmihii la soo dhaafay, Taliyaha ciidanka xoogga dalka ayaa kulamo la yeeshay saraakiisha kala duwan ee ciidamada, isagoo kala hadlay qorshaha dowladda ee la xiriira dardar-gelinta la wareegista mas’uuliyadda amniga dalka iyo diyaar-garowga ciidamada qaranka. Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa hore ugu guuleysatay in ciidamada Midowga Afrika laga saaro howlaha ilaalinta madaxda sare ee dowladda iyo xarumaha Madaxtooyada Qaranka, iyadoo mas’uuliyaddaas si buuxda loogu wareejiyay ciidamada Soomaaliyeed. Tallaabadaas ayaa loo arkaa mid horseed u noqotay qorshaha ballaaran ee dowladda ku dooneyso in ciidamada qaranku si buuxda ula wareegaan amniga dalka, iyadoo taageero dhinaca tababarka, qalabaynta iyo tayeynta ciidamada laga helayo dalal saaxiib la ah Soomaaliya. Sida ay xaqiijiyeen ilo kala duwan, Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa bixineysa mushaaraadka ciidamada la diyaarinayo, halka dalalka taageeraya Soomaaliya ay ka qeyb qaadanayaan tababarrada iyo qalabayntooda. Qorshahan cusub ayaa ku soo aadaya xilli ay sii kordhayaan doodaha ku saabsan waqtiga ku habboon ee ciidamada AUSSOM ay si rasmi ah mas’uuliyadda amniga dalka ugu wareejin lahaayeen ciidanka xoogga dalka Soomaaliyeed. items.title: Gabadhaha xulka Qaranka oo guul weyn ka gaaray dhiggooda dalka Sudan
items.description: Gabdhaha Xulka Qaranka Soomaaliyeed ee da’doodu ka hooseyso 17-jirada ayaa guul taariikhi ah ka gaaray dhiggooda dalka Sudan, kadib markii ay 8-2 ku garaaceen kulan ka tirsanaa tartanka Bariga iyo Bartamaha Afrika CECAFA ee ka socda magaalada Dar es Salaam ee wadanka Tanzania. Guushan ayaa bog cusub u furtay taariikhda kubadda cagta haweenka Soomaaliyeed, maadaama ay tahay markii ugu horreysay ee xul qaran oo gabdho ah ay guul ka gaaraan tartan kubadda cagta ah. Inkasta oo Ocean Queens ay ka hareen tartanka, kadib guuldarrooyin ay kala kulmeen xulalka Tanzania iyo Kenya oo ay ku wada jireen Group A, haddana ciyaartoydu waxay soo bandhigeen dadaal, karti iyo isku-duubni aad loogu amaanay. Ka qeybgalka tartankan ma ahayn oo keliya tartan ciyaareed, balse wuxuu astaan u yahay horumarka kubadda cagta haweenka Soomaaliya, isagoo muujinaya adkaysi, rajo iyo dadaal dheer oo looga soo gudbay caqabado badan. items.title: United States Announces More Than $1 Billion in Assistance to UNICEF and World Food Program to Address Global Humanitarian Needs
items.description: United States Announces More Than $1 Billion in Assistance to UNICEF and World Food Program to Address Global Humanitarian Needs Office of the Spokesperson Today, the United States announced more than $1 billion in humanitarian and disaster response assistance to UNICEF and the World Food Program (WFP) through new global macro awards, which cover life-saving support in more than 40 countries. This announcement builds directly on the tremendous success of the Trump Administration’s landmark December 2025 “Humanitarian Reset” memorandum of understanding (MOU) with the UN Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA). That MOU has already led to historic reforms to the bloated UN humanitarian bureaucracy, bringing activities under a single local Humanitarian/Resident coordinator, enhancing efficiency and delivering measurable impact, improving accountability and eliminating waste, fraud and abuse, and slashing bureaucracy to spend more on life-saving frontline work and less on overhead. The more than $218 million in assistance to UNICEF and more than $800 million to WFP announced today are the second and third in a series of global State Department awards to trusted and vetted implementing organizations. These awards replace the previous model of fragmented, duplicative individual grants that generated excessive overhead, created unpredictability for implementers, and diluted impact across many competing priorities. These awards reflect a new model of humanitarian assistance built on speed, accountability, measurable impact, and the elimination of bureaucratic waste. Implementers can mobilize quickly, in some cases within 24 hours, ensuring that U.S. taxpayer dollars reach those in need without delay. Somaliland rejects Somali federal government’s criticism of Israel ties
items.description: Somaliland on Tuesday rejected Somali federal government’s condemnation of its relations with Israel, accusing Mogadishu of misleading the international community and denying what it called Somaliland’s political reality. In a statement, Somaliland’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs said the Federal Government of Somalia had no authority to determine Somaliland’s foreign relations or object to its international engagements. “The statement from Mogadishu is another attempt to distort history, deny reality, and mislead the international community,” the ministry said. The statement came after Somalia’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs expressed concern over Israeli engagement with Somaliland, saying any contact with the breakaway administration outside the framework of the federal government violated Somalia’s sovereignty, unity and territorial integrity. Somaliland said it attained independence on June 26, 1960, and restored its sovereignty on May 18, 1991, after the collapse of its union with Somalia and what it described as massacres and injustices committed against its people. “Somaliland is not, and has never been, administered from Mogadishu since restoring its sovereignty,” the ministry said. The statement said President Abdirahman Mohamed Abdullahi Irro’s state visit to Israel demonstrated Somaliland’s growing diplomatic reach and its right to engage with international partners. Somaliland said no statement from federal government could reverse its diplomatic progress or obstruct the aspirations of its people. The ministry said Somaliland has governed itself for more than three decades with its own institutions, security forces, laws, elections and international partnerships. It rejected Somalia’s claim that Somaliland’s international engagements violate international law, saying its diplomacy is based on self-determination, democratic legitimacy, peaceful coexistence and the will of its people. “Somaliland’s engagement with the State of Israel, and with any other international partner, is a sovereign decision based on national interest, mutual respect, regional security, and economic cooperation,” the statement said. The ministry said Somaliland would not seek permission from Mogadishu or allow threats, propaganda or diplomatic pressure to dictate its foreign relations. Somaliland also said it would reject any attempt to undermine its sovereignty, territorial integrity or peace, while reserving the right to defend what it described as its independence and national dignity. The statement underlined that Somaliland remains committed to peace, stability and responsible diplomacy but would firmly defend its sovereignty, democratic achievements, international partnerships and the will of its people. Somali federal government rejects Somaliland’s claim to sovereignty and says the region remains part of the Federal Republic of Somalia. Somaliland declared independence in 1991 and has operated with its own government, security forces and election institutions, but it has not received broad international recognition.

items.title: Somaliland Denies Reports of Israeli Military Presence and Base Talks
items.description: Somaliland’s Defence Minister, Mohamed Yusuf Ali, has denied reports that Israel has a military presence in Somaliland or that talks are under way over the establishment of an Israeli military base in the territory. Speaking to Reuters on Wednesday while attending a business conference in Tel Aviv, Ali said Israel provides training to Somaliland’s military and police forces, but rejected claims that discussions were taking place over a possible Israeli military base. “There is no Israeli military presence in Somaliland, and there are no talks regarding the establishment of an Israeli military base,” Ali said, describing recent reports on the matter as “rumours” and “unfounded claims.” Israel’s ambassador to Somaliland, Michael Lotem, declined to comment. Somaliland, strategically located in the Horn of Africa, has governed itself since 1991, when it declared independence from Somalia following the collapse of the Somali state and the outbreak of civil war. Its independence, however, has not been widely recognised internationally. In December last year, Israel became the first country to formally recognise Somaliland, a move strongly rejected by Somalia’s Federal Government, which described it as a violation of Somalia’s sovereignty, unity and territorial integrity. In February, Somaliland President Abdirahman Mohamed Abdullahi, also known as Irro, told Reuters that his administration hoped to develop future military cooperation with Israel, but said no discussions had taken place over the establishment of Israeli military bases in Somaliland. Recent international media reports claimed that Israel had opened an intelligence facility in Somaliland and had held talks over a possible military base. Somaliland’s defence minister has now firmly denied those reports, insisting that no such arrangements are in place or under discussion. items.title: Madaxa NATO oo amaanay heshiiska Mareykanka iyo Iran
items.description: Xoghayaha Guud ee Gaashaanbuurta NATO, Mark Rutte ayaa amaanay heshiiska Mareykanka iyo Iran ee lagu soo afjarayo dagaalka Bariga Dhexe, isagoo dhinaca kalena sheegay in qorshaha dib-u-furista marin biyoodka Hormuz uu noqon doono tallaabo weyn oo hore loo qaaday. “Dib-u-soo celinta Marinka Hormuz oo xor ah ayaa waxay noqon doontaa tallaabo weyn oo hore loo qaaday.” Ayuu yiri Xoghayaha Guud ee NATO. Xoghayaha oo maanta shir jaraa’id ku qabtay Magaalada Brussels ayaa sheegay in Dowladaha Faransiiska iyo Ingiriiska ay diyaar u yihiin inay hoggaamiyaan dadaalada ay tahay in miinooyinka looga saaro marinkaasi. “Waxaan ogahay in xulafooyin badan, iyada oo loo marayo hindisaha ay hoggaaminayaan Faransiiska iyo Boqortooyada Ingiriiska ay diyaar u yihiin inay taageeraan.” Ayuu yiri Mark Rutte. Ciidamada Iran ayaa xanibay isu socodka marinka maraakiibta ganacsiga caalamiga ah ee Hormuz, iyaga oo ka jawaabaya duulaankii wadajirka ahaa ee Mareykanka iyo Israel ay 28-kii bishii February ku qaadeen dalkaasi. Heshiiska ay Mareykanka iyo Iran gaareen Isniintii ee lagu wado in Jimcaha la saxiixo ayaa la rajeynayaa in uu wax ka taro ciriiriga ka jira Hormuz. Madaxweyne Donald Trump ayaa goor sii horreysay sheegay in heshiiska uu suurtagelinayo in la soo celiyo xorriyaddii socdaalka maraakiibta ee marinkaasi. Marinka Hormuz ayaa ah isha ugu weyn ee gobolka iyo caalamkaba ay adeegsadaan maraakiibta shixnadaha saliidda, kaas oo uu ka gudbo shan meelood oo meel (20%) ee sahayda tamarta adduunka.

items.title: Cirro oo la guddoonsiiyay billadda ugu sarreysa ee Israa’iil + Sawirro
items.description: Tell Aviv (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Somaliland, Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdullaahi (Cirro) iyo wafdigiisa oo weli ku sugan Israa’iil ayaa xalay casho-sharaf loogu sameeyey xarunta Matxafka Friends of Zion ee magaalada Jerusalem, halkaas oo lagu guddoonsiiyey Billad Sharafta Qaran ee Friends of Zion Award. Billad Sharafta Qaran ee FOZ Award ee lagu maamuusay Madaxweynaha Somaliland ayaa waxa lagu sharfaa shaqsiyaadka ay dadka reer Israa’iil u hayaan abaal gaar ah. Sidoo kale, Billad Sharafta Qaran ee Friends of Zion Award ayaa ah tan ugu sarreysa Israa’iil ee la siiyo hogggaamiye dal kale oo saaxiib la ah Israa’iil, iyada oo Cirro uu ku muteystay xiriirka cusub ee uu la yeeshay Tel Aviv. War-saxaafadeed kasoo baxay Madaxtooyada Somaliland ayaa si weyn loogu mahadceliyay sida loo maamusay Madaxweynaha iyo wafdigiisa. Sidoo kale Madaxtooyada ayaa ka hadashay muhiimadda ay leedahay Billada Friends of Zion Award “Waa maamuus heer Caalami ah oo hore loo guddoonsiiyey Madaxweyneyaal, Boqorro, Amiirro, Ra’iisal Wasaareyaal iyo Hoggaamiyeyaal caan ka ah dunida, kuwaasi oo ay ka mid yihiin Madaxweynihii hore ee dalka Maraykanka George W. Bush iyo Madaxweynaha haatan Donald J Trump, Muxammed Bin Salman, Yoweri Museveni, George Weah, Muxammed Bin Rahed Al Maktoum, Amiirka Monaco Prince Albert II, iyo kuwo kale.,” ayaa lagu yiri warsaxaafadeedja. Waxaa kale oo lasii raaciyay “Guddoonsiinta Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland ee Billad Sharafta Qaran ee Friends of Zion ayaa waxa ay ka tarjumaysaa miisaanka uu leeyahay xidhiidhka saaxiibtinimo iyo iskaashiga istaraatiijiga ah ee u dhexeeya Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland iyo Israa’iil”. “Sida oo kale, waxa ay qiraal u tahay doorka Somaliland ee nabadda, dimuqraadiyadda, wada-noolaanshaha iyo xasilloonida gobolka, iyada oo xoojinaysa kalsoonida iyo iskaashiga labada dhinac ee dhinacyada diblomaasiyadda, dhaqaalaha, horumarka iyo is-dhaafsiga aqoonta”. Si kastaba, Dhacdadan ayaa sare u qaadeyso xiriirka labada dhinac ee sii xoogeysanaya, tan iyo markii ay Israa’iil ku dhawaaqay aqoonsiga Somaliland. items.title: Ciidamada Israel oo weeraro cusub ka gaystay Koonfurta Lubnaan
items.description: Ciidamada Israel ayaa lagu soo waramayaa inay duqaymo cusub ka fuliyeen Koonfurta Lubnaan saacado ka dib, markii Iran ay ka digtay sii socoshada weerarada Israel ee ka dhanka ah Ururka Xisbullah. Wakaaladda Wararka Lubnaan ee NNA ayaa ku warantay in Ciidanka Cirka Israel ay Arbacadan garaacaan deegaanka Nabatieh Al-Fowqa iyo deegaanka kale ee u dhow ee Kfar Tebnit. Wakaaladda Wararka NNA ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in diyaarad dagaal ay duqayn la beegsatay goob ku taala magaalada istiraatiijiga ah ee Bint Jbeil ee Gobolka Nabatieh (Nabatiyeh) ee ku dhow xuduudda. NNA waxay kaloo sheegtay in duqayn cusub laga soo wariyay magaalada shanaad ee dalka ugu weyn ee Tyre ee ku taala Koonfurta Lubnaan. Taliska Militariga Israel ayaan weli ka hadlin weeraradan ugu dambeeyay ee ay ka gaysteen dalka ay deriska yihiin ee Lubnaan, balse waxa ay horey u sheegeen inay sii wadi doonaan weerarada ay ku beegsanayaan ururka hubeysan ee Xisbullah ee ay Iran taageerto. Taliska Dhexe ee Ciidamada Iran (Khatam Al-Anbiya) ayaa mar sii horreysay ku hanjabay jawaab adag oo ka dhan ah Israel, haddii ay ciidamadeedu sii wadaan gardarrada Koonfurta Lubnaan. Weeraradan laga soo sheegay Lubnaan ayaa u muuqdo kuwo xitaa ka carreysiinaya Madaxweyne Donald Trump, kaas oo Talaadadii dhalleeceeyay ficilada Israel ee Lubnaan. Dowladaha Mareykanka iyo Iran ayaa Isniintii ku heshiiyay in la soo afjaro dagaalka Bariga Dhexe, oo uu ku jiro midka Lubnaan. Weerarada Israel ee Lubnaan ayaa xadgudub ku ah heshiiska lagu wado in Jimcaha ay Mareykanka iyo Iran ku saxiixaan Magaalada Geneva, waana sababta uu Trump isugu dayaayo inuu xakameeyo Israel. Trump oo shalay ka hadlayay Shirka G7 ee ka socdo Faransiiska ayaa sheegay in Raysal Wasaaraha Israel, Benjamin Netanyahu uu u baahan yahay inuu masuuliyad iska saaro Lubnaan. Trump ayaa sheegay in Israel ay muddo dheer la dagaalameysay Xisbullah, isla-markaana ay dishay dad aad u badan oo shacabka Lubnaan ah. “Mareykanka la’aantiis ma jirteen Israel. Aniga la’aantee ma jirteen Israel, sababtoo ah ma jiro Madaxweyne kale oo diyaar u ah inuu sameeyo, waxaan u sameeyay.” Ayuu yiri Trump. Israel ayaa tan iyo 2-dii bishii March dagaal kula jirta Xoogaga Xisbullah, iyadoo ay ku dhinteen, kuna dhaawacmeen kumanaan qof, halka in ka badan hal milyan oo kalena ay ku barakaceen dagaalka muddadaasi ka socdo Koonfurta Lubnaan.

Wakaaladda Wararka NNA ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in diyaarad dagaal ay duqayn la beegsatay goob ku taala magaalada istiraatiijiga ah ee Bint Jbeil ee Gobolka Nabatieh (Nabatiyeh) ee ku dhow xuduudda. NNA waxay kaloo sheegtay in duqayn cusub laga soo wariyay magaalada shanaad ee dalka ugu weyn ee Tyre ee ku taala Koonfurta Lubnaan. Taliska Militariga Israel ayaan weli ka hadlin weeraradan ugu dambeeyay ee ay ka gaysteen dalka ay deriska yihiin ee Lubnaan, balse waxa ay horey u sheegeen inay sii wadi doonaan weerarada ay ku beegsanayaan ururka hubeysan ee Xisbullah ee ay Iran taageerto. Taliska Dhexe ee Ciidamada Iran (Khatam Al-Anbiya) ayaa mar sii horreysay ku hanjabay jawaab adag oo ka dhan ah Israel, haddii ay ciidamadeedu sii wadaan gardarrada Koonfurta Lubnaan. Weeraradan laga soo sheegay Lubnaan ayaa u muuqdo kuwo xitaa ka carreysiinaya Madaxweyne Donald Trump, kaas oo Talaadadii dhalleeceeyay ficilada Israel ee Lubnaan. Dowladaha Mareykanka iyo Iran ayaa Isniintii ku heshiiyay in la soo afjaro dagaalka Bariga Dhexe, oo uu ku jiro midka Lubnaan. Weerarada Israel ee Lubnaan ayaa xadgudub ku ah heshiiska lagu wado in Jimcaha ay Mareykanka iyo Iran ku saxiixaan Magaalada Geneva, waana sababta uu Trump isugu dayaayo inuu xakameeyo Israel. Trump oo shalay ka hadlayay Shirka G7 ee ka socdo Faransiiska ayaa sheegay in Raysal Wasaaraha Israel, Benjamin Netanyahu uu u baahan yahay inuu masuuliyad iska saaro Lubnaan. Trump ayaa sheegay in Israel ay muddo dheer la dagaalameysay Xisbullah, isla-markaana ay dishay dad aad u badan oo shacabka Lubnaan ah. “Mareykanka la’aantiis ma jirteen Israel. Aniga la’aantee ma jirteen Israel, sababtoo ah ma jiro Madaxweyne kale oo diyaar u ah inuu sameeyo, waxaan u sameeyay.” Ayuu yiri Trump. Israel ayaa tan iyo 2-dii bishii March dagaal kula jirta Xoogaga Xisbullah, iyadoo ay ku dhinteen, kuna dhaawacmeen kumanaan qof, halka in ka badan hal milyan oo kalena ay ku barakaceen dagaalka muddadaasi ka socdo Koonfurta Lubnaan.

items.title: Kooxaha burcadbadeeda oo laba markab ku weeraray xeebaha Puntand
items.description: Boosaaso (Caasimada Online) – Wararka naga soo gaaraya xeebaha bari ee maamulka Puntland ayaa sheegaya in maanta kooxaha burcadbeedda ay weerarro ka gaysteen halkaas, iyaga oo beegsaday laba markab oo ganacsi, balse ugu dambeyn ka badbaaday isku dayga weerarrada hubeysan ee lagu qaaday. Labada markab oo ah kuwa xamuulka qaada ayaa xilliga la weerarayay ku socday aagga marin-biyoodka Gacanka Cadmeed iyo xeebaha Bari ee Puntland, sida ay innoo sheegeen ilo wareedyo lagu kalsoonyahay. Isku deyga weerarka koowaad ayaa lagu beegsaday markabka xamuulka qaada ee Greta Star oo watay calanka Panama, kaas oo 15-kii bishan June ay u soo dhawaadeen burcadbadeed saarnaa doon yar, xilli uu marayay koonfurta xeebaha dalka Yemen, balse si dirqi ah ayuu kaga badbaaday weerarkaas. Sida ay sheegtay shirkadda ammaanka badaha ee Vanguard Tech, ragga hubeysan ayaa rasaas huwiyay markabka, balse shaqaalaha saarnaa markabka ayaa kordhiyay xawaaraha, kana cararay goobta lagu weraray. Sidoo kale, weerarka labaad oo isna dhacay saacadihii lasoo dhaafay ayaa lagu beegsaday markab kale oo xamuul siday, kuna socdaalayay calanka Palau, kaas oo burcadbadeeda ku heleen meel qiyaastii 32 mayl koonfur kaga beegan degmada Xaafuun ee gobolka Bari, iyada oo la sheegay in markabkaas ay weerareen labo doomood oo ay saarnaayeen ilaa 12 nin oo hubeysan, kuwaas oo rasaaseeyay markabka, kuna amray in uu istaago, blase ilaalada markabka la socotay ayaa iska difaacay ragga soo weeraray. Wararka ayaa intaasi ku daraya in dagaal kooban uu dhex-maray labada dhinac, isla markaana is rasaaseyntu ay socotay muddo ku dhow 30 daqiiqo, iyada oo kadib la cayriyay labada doomood iyo raggii hubeysnaa ee la socday. Weerarradan waxaa ka horreeyay kuwa kale oo ay horay u fuliyeen kooxaha burcadbadeeda, kuna qabsadeen illaa saddex markab oo illaa iyo hadda ay ku haystaan xeebaha Puntland, taasoo kordhisay falalka burcad-badeeda Soomaalida. Qiyaastii saddex sano ka hor, falalka burcad-badeednimada ayaa u muuqday kuwo gabi ahaanba ka ciribtirmay biyaha Badweynta Hindiya oo horay ugu caan baxay afduubka, balse dib ayay arrintaas u soo laabatay iyadoo inta badan la beegsanayo doonyaha kalluumeysiga iyo maraakiibta xamuulka. The post Kooxaha burcadbadeeda oo laba markab ku weeraray xeebaha Puntand appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Deeq Jeesow oo isku dhiibay laamaha amniga kadib shilkii dhimashada lahaa ee uu galay
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Deeq Jeesow oo kamid ah dhalinyarada caan ka ka ah baraha bulshada, gaar ahaan Aaladda TikTok ayaa faah-faahiyay shil naxdin leh oo uu gelinkii dambe shalay ku galay waddada xiriirisa Muqdisho iyo Balcad, kaas oo sababay khasaare leh dhimasho iyo dhaawac. Shilka ayaa yimid, kadb markii ay isku dhaceen gaari Surf ah oo uu waday Deeq Jeesow iyo mooto Bajaaj waddada mareysay, waxaana ku dhintay ugu yaraan illaa 5 qof, halka ay ku dhaawacmeen tiro kale oo uu isagu ku jiro. Deeq oo qoraal soo saaray ayaa marka hore musiibo ku tilmaamay waxa dhacay, wuxuuna sheegay inuu aad uga xun yahay shilkaas, isaga oo sidoo kale tacsi u diray ehellada ay dadkooda ku dhinteen goobta. “Asc walalayaal marka ugu horreyso aan ku salino Rasuulkeenii suubanaa SCW iyo Allah ina abuurtay wixii dhacay shalay waxay ahaayeen musiibo ku cimri qaadasho mudan waxaa geeriyooday dad aan jeclaa inay noolaadan oo qaarna abtiyaashay ahaayeen qaarna ehel aan ahayn waxaan leeyahay waan ka xumahay geeridiina ee jannada Allah idinku kugu bishaareeyo,” ayuu yiri Deeq Jeesow. Sidoo kae, wuxuu sii sii raaciyay “Intaas kadib Ummada Soomaaliyeed meel kasto ay joogaan waxaan uga baahanahay iney noo soo duceeyaan aniga iyo intii halkaas ku waxyeeloowday dhimasho iyo dhaawac, kana qayb qaataan xal u helida musiibadii halkaas ka dhacday. Fariinta ugu horeyso waxaan ku bilaabayaa dadkii aan ehelka ahayn ee dadkoodii halkaas ku geeriyooday waxaan leeyahay sabar iyo iimaan allh idinka siiyo qalbiyada Allah idin qaboojiyo ma ahayn ugu talagal lkn qadarta qorneyd cidkasta oo dunidan kor saran waxa ka weyn qadarta Alle wixii dhici rabana kun sano ayey kaa weyn yihiin”. Dhanka kale, waxa uu beeniyay wararka lagu faafiyay baraha bulshada ee sheegayay inuu baxsaday, wuxuuna tilmaamay inuu isku dhiibay laamaha amniga, uuna tegay saldhigga degmada Kaaraan ee gobolka Banaadir. “Waxaan been abuur ku tilmaamayaa inan baxsaday anigo ka tax daraayo amaankeyga ayaan lugaheyga ku tegay gobaha amaanka oo ey ugu horeeyso saldhigga degmada Kaaraan wana uga mahadcelinayaa,” ayuu mar kale yiri. Ugu dambeyn wuxuu dalbaday in dadka Soomaaliyeed iyo madaxda sare ee ay ka gacan siiyan kiiskan, gaar ahaan sidii xal loogu heli lahaa dadka dhintay iyo kuwa dhaawacmay, maadaama ay waxyeelo kasoo gaartay shilka uu galay. “Cidkasto taqaan qadarta Alle madax iyo majo haka qayb qaadato xal u helida walaalahii halkaas ku naf waayay iyadoo ii muujinaysa garab istaag,” ayuu qoraalkiisa kusoo gabagabeeyay Deeqo Jeesow oo caan ka ah barta TikTok. The post Deeq Jeesow oo isku dhiibay laamaha amniga kadib shilkii dhimashada lahaa ee uu galay appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Hindiya oo Si KMG ah u Xannibtay Telegram Kadib Fadeexad La Xiriirta Imtixaanka ardayda Caafimaadka
items.description: Dowladda Hindiya ayaa si ku-meel-gaar ah u xannibtay adeegga fariimaha ee Telegram, kadib markii lagu eedeeyay in madashan in loo adeegsaday khiyaano iyo musuqmaasuq la xiriira imtixaanka qaran ee gelitaanka kulliyadaha caafimaadka (NEET). Wasaaradda Waxbarashada Hindiya ayaa sheegtay in tallaabadan oo socon doonta ilaa 22-ka Juun ay timid kadib markii la ogaaday in kooxo abaabulan ay Telegram u adeegsanayeen inay ardayda ka iibiyaan su’aalaha imtixaanka dib-u-galka ah ee la qorsheeyay 21-ka Juun. Go’aankan ayaa noqonaya mid aan horay uga dhicin Hindiya, iyadoo dowladda ay sheegtay in uu yahay tallaabo degdeg ah oo lagu ilaalinayo hufnaanta imtixaannada qaranka. Bishii hore, dowladda Hindiya ayaa baajisay natiijooyinkii imtixaanka NEET kadib markii ay soo baxeen eedeymo sheegaya in su’aalaha imtixaanka la sii daayay ka hor waqtigoodii, ayadoo arrintani ay saameysay in ka badan 2.3 milyan oo arday, waxaana ka dhashay dibadbaxyo ka dhacay qaybo kala duwan oo dalka ah. Aasaasaha Telegram, Pavel Durov, ayaa dhaleeceeyay xayiraadda, isagoo sheegay in tallaabadan ay ciqaabayso in ka badan 150 milyan oo isticmaale oo sharci ah oo ku nool Hindiya, halkii laga beegsan lahaa dadka ku lugta leh daadinta su’aalaha imtixaanka. “Xayiraaddu ma joojin dhibaatada, balse waxay ku qasabtay kooxihii ku lugta lahaa inay u wareegaan barnaamijyo kale,” ayuu Durov ku qoray bartiisa X. Dhanka kale, ururka u dooda xorriyadda internetka ee Internet Freedom Foundation ayaa sheegay in xannibaadda Telegram aysan xal waara u ahayn musuqmaasuqa imtixaannada, isla markaana ay dhaawacayso xorriyadda hadalka iyo helitaanka xogta. Dowladda Hindiya ayaa sheegtay inay ka xun tahay dhibaatada ka dhalatay tallaabadan, balse ay ahayd ikhtiyaarkii ugu dambeeyay kadib markii dadaalladii hore ee lagu doonayay in laga saaro waxyaabaha sharci darrada ah ee Telegram lagu baahinayay ay fashilmeen. Wararka ayaa sidoo kale sheegaya in shirkadaha Google iyo Apple lagu amray inay si ku-meel-gaar ah uga saaraan Telegram dukaamadooda barnaamijyada ee gudaha Hindiya, si loo dhaqan-geliyo go’aanka dowladda. Xannibaaddan ayaa sii hurisay doodaha ku saabsan isku dheelitirka u dhexeeya ilaalinta amniga iyo hufnaanta nidaamyada waxbarashada, iyo ilaalinta xorriyadda isticmaalayaasha internetka.

Shirkadda ammaanka badaha ee Vanguard Tech ayaa sheegtay in kooxda burcadbadeeda ah ay rasaas culus ku furtay markabka, balse shaqaaluhu ay kordhiyeen xawaaraha markabka, iyaga oo qaaday tallaabooyin amni oo sababay in weerarku fashilmo. Geesta kale saacadihii la soo dhaafay markab kale oo xamuul guud sida kuna socdaalayay calanka Palau isna lagu weeraray meel qiyaastii 32 mayl-badeed koonfur kaga beegan degmada Xaafuun ee gobolka Bari. Waxaa la sheegay in markabkaas ay weerareen labo doonyood oo ay saarnaayeen ilaa 12 nin oo hubeysan, kuwaas rasaas ku furay markabka, iyagoo ku amray in uu istaago. Kooxda ilaalada gaarka ah ee saarneyd markabka ayaa iyaguna rasaas ku faray kooxda weerarka soo qaaday, waxaana muddo ku dhow 30 daqiiqo socday rasaas, ka hor inta aan la eryin doonyihii weerarka waday. Dhacdooyinkan sii kordhaya ayaa ku soo aadaya, iyada oo ilaa saddex markab lagu haysto xeebaha Puntland, isla markaana ay kordheen weerarada falalka burcad-badeeda Soomaalida. The post Burcad badeed hubeysan oo xeebaha Puntland ku weeraray Maraakiib ganacsi appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Militariga Iran oo digniin adag u jeediyay Israel
items.description: Taliska Militariga Iran ayaa Israel ugu yeeray inay si degdeg ah u soo afjarto weerarada ay ka waddo Koonfurta Lubnaan ee ka dhanka ah Xoogaga Ururka Xisbullah. Taliska Dhexe ee Ciidamada Iran (Khatam Al-Anbiya) ayaa ka digay inaysan Israel joojin weerarada Koonfurta Lubnaan, haddii kalena ay jawaab adag ka dhalan doonto. Taliska ayaa bayaan ku sheegay in Ciidamada Israel ay 84 jeer jebiyeen heshiiska xabad joojinta labadii maalmood ee la soo dhaafay, iyagoo tixraacaya heshiiska dagaalka lagu soo afjarayo ee ay gaareen iyaga iyo Mareykanka. Mareykanka iyo Iran ayaa waaberigii hore ee Isniintii gaaray heshiis lagu soo afjarayo dagaalka Bariga Dhexe, oo ay ku jirto xabad joojin laga sameeyo Lubnaan. Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Iran, Abbas Araghchi ayaa sheegay in dhaqangalka heshiiska oo Jimcaha la filayo in la saxiixo uu ku xiran yahay in la joojiyo dagaalka Lubnaan. Taliska Dhexe ee Khatam Al-Anbiya ayaa ku hanjabay in Israel ay jawaab militari kala kulmi doonto dhinaca Iran, haddii aysan ciidamadeedu joojin weerarada Lubnaan. “Haddii aysan Cidamada Maamulka Sahyuuniyadda joojin gardarrada Koonfurta Lubnaan, waa inay fishaan jawaab adag oo kaga timaada Ciidamada Qalabka Sida ee Iran.” Ayaa lagu yiri bayaanka. Warka Militariga Iran ayaa imanaya, ka dib weeraro ay dad rayid ah ku dhinteen oo Talaadadii laga soo wariyay Koonfurta Lubnaan. Madaxweyne Donald Trump ayaa Talaadadii Raysal Wasaaraha Israel, Benjamin Netanyahu ku dhalleeceeyay inuu u dhaqmayo si masuuliyad darro ah, isagoona sheegay inay tahay in Netanyahu uu masuuliyad dheeraad ah ka yeesho arrinta Lubnaan.

items.title: Soomaaliya iyo UNFPA oo Dardargelinaya u Diyaargarowga Tirakoobka Dadweynaha iyo Guryaha
items.description: Hay’adda Tirakoobka Qaranka Soomaaliyeed (SNBS) iyo Sanduuqa Qaramada Midoobay ee Dadweynaha (UNFPA) ayaa markale adkeeyay iskaashigooda ku aaddan xoojinta nidaamka tirakoobka dalka, iyadoo ay socdaan diyaar-garowga tirakoobkii ugu horreeyay ee dadka iyo guryaha Soomaaliya muddo ka badan 50 sano. Ballanqaadkan ayaa yimid kadib booqasho ay xarunta SNBS ee Muqdisho ku tageen wafdi sare oo ka socday UNFPA, kuwaas oo uu hoggaaminayay Wakiilka Hay’adda ee Soomaaliya, Judicaël Elidje. Wafdiga waxaa halkaasi ku soo dhoweeyay Agaasimaha Guud ee SNBS, Dr. Cabdisalaam Maxamed, iyo mas’uuliyiin kale oo ka tirsan hay’adda. Kulanka ayaa dib loogu eegay horumarka laga gaaray iskaashiga labada dhinac oo socday in ka badan toban sano, kaas oo door weyn ka qaatay dib-u-dhiska kaabeyaasha tirakoobka Soomaaliya kadib sanado badan oo colaado iyo caqabado hay’adeed ay jireen. SNBS ayaa soo bandhigtay guulaha laga gaaray ururinta xogaha bulshada iyo dadka, gaar ahaan diyaarinta tirakoobka qaran ee la filayo inuu bixiyo xog sax ah oo muhiim u ah qorsheynta dowladda, adeegyada bulshada iyo barnaamijyada horumarinta. Mas’uuliyiintu waxay sidoo kale ka wada hadleen sahamin bulsho iyo demoqraafiyadeed oo dhowaan lagu soo gabagabeeyay shan degmo, taas oo taageero ka heshay UNFPA iyo Gates Foundation. Sahamintaasi waxay gaartay ku dhowaad 50,000 oo qoys, iyadoo la adeegsanayay farsamooyin casri ah iyo tiknoolajiyadda juqraafiyeed si loo helo qiyaaso sax ah oo ku saabsan tirada dadka, gaar ahaan meelaha fogfog. Soomaaliya ayaa muddo dheer la daalaa-dhacaysay helitaanka xog lagu kalsoonaan karo oo ku saabsan tirada dadka, sababo la xiriira amni darrada, barakaca iyo daciifnimada nidaamyada tirakoobka. Arrintan ayaa caqabad ku noqotay qorsheynta adeegyada iyo qaybinta kheyraadka dalka. Labada hay’adood ayaa sheegay inay sii xoojin doonaan wada-shaqeynta lagu kobcinayo awoodda farsamo ee nidaamka tirakoobka qaranka heer federaal iyo dowlad-goboleed, isla markaana la horumarinayo isticmaalka xogta ee dejinta siyaasadaha. Doodaha ayaa sidoo kale diiradda lagu saaray ka qeybgalka Soomaaliya ee Barnaamijka Qaramada Midoobay ee Tirakoobka Dadweynaha iyo Guryaha ee 2030-ka, kaas oo loogu talagalay in dalalku soo saaraan xog demoqraafiyadeed oo la isku halayn karo isla markaana la isbarbar dhigi karo. Tallaabadan ayaa kusoo beegmaysa xilli Soomaaliya ay dardargelinayso qorsheynta iyo maamulka ku saleysan xogta saxda ah, iyadoo bah-wadaagta caalamiga ah ay sii adkeynayaan muhiimadda xogta lagu kalsoonaan karo ee hagta horumarka iyo gaarista yoolalka qaran iyo kuwa caalami ah.

items.title: Al-Shabaab issues sharp rebuke over Somaliland’s new Jerusalem embassy
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Al-Shabaab on Tuesday condemned Somaliland President Abdirahman Mohamed Abdullahi Irro over the opening of Somaliland’s embassy in Jerusalem, saying he does not represent Muslim Somalis and urging residents of Somaliland to oppose his administration, as tensions over expanding Israel-Somaliland ties continue to draw reactions from both the militant group and Somalia’s federal government. In a lengthy Arabic-language statement circulated through affiliated online media channels, the militant group criticized Somaliland’s growing relationship with Israel following Israel’s recognition of the breakaway region late last year. Al-Shabaab said the agreements signed since then included security cooperation, joint coordination and acceptance of the Abraham Accords, which it described as bringing together “crusaders, Jews and apostates.” “Following the emergence of this issue, Harakat al-Shabaab al-Mujahideen explained the dangers surrounding this alleged recognition. At that time, we clarified the consequences it would have in violating the boundaries of Islamic law and the humiliation and disgrace it would bring,” the group said. Al-Shabaab said it had previously warned of what it viewed as the consequences of Somaliland’s engagement with Israel and accused Somaliland authorities of opening the door to Jewish influence in the region. The group reserved particular criticism for Irro’s decision to inaugurate Somaliland’s embassy in Jerusalem, saying it viewed the move as recognition of the city as Israel’s capital. “Today, six months after that disgraceful recognition – which was obtained at the price of abandoning Islam and the honor of loyalty to Muslims – we witness the leader of this apostate entity becoming the first person associated with Muslim Somalia to openly and shamelessly declare Jerusalem the capital of the occupying Jews, at a time when even some Crusader states have hesitated to take such a step, recognizing the gravity of the situation,” the statement said. Addressing Muslims worldwide, particularly Palestinians and residents of Gaza, Al-Shabaab said the actions of Somaliland’s leadership did not represent the Somali people. “We say to Muslims in the East and the West, and especially to our brothers in Palestine and our people in Gaza: this shameful act, this degraded conduct, and what this apostate entity and its leaders loyal to the disbelievers have done in openly violating our true religion and the rights of Muslims – through their alliance with the warring Jews, the opening of an embassy in the occupied holy city of Jerusalem, and their offering of obedience to the Zionists – does not, under any circumstances, represent the authentic Muslim Somali people,” the group said. The statement was notably less threatening than Al-Shabaab’s previous rhetoric following Israel’s recognition of Somaliland last year, when the group threatened attacks should Somaliland permit an Israeli military presence on its territory. Expressing support for the Palestinian cause, Al-Shabaab said Somalis would continue to stand alongside Palestinians in their struggle against Israel and reiterated its long-standing slogan: “Jerusalem Will Not Be Judaized.” The militant group also directed a message to the people of Somaliland, calling on them to oppose the Somaliland administration and asserting that President Irro had “abandoned the religion of Islam and has manifested clear disbelief.” “It is not permissible to obey him or submit to his administration. Rather, Muslims are obligated to struggle against him and defend their religion and dignity,” the statement said. Al-Shabaab further warned Somaliland residents against religious scholars whom it accused of attempting to justify cooperation with Jews and Christians, arguing that the Somaliland administration held no legitimate authority over Muslims living in the region. A substantial portion of the statement focused on Jerusalem’s religious significance in Islam. The group described the city as the first qiblah of Muslims, the location of the Prophet Muhammad’s Night Journey and home to Islam’s third-holiest mosque. The statement came a day after Somaliland President Abdirahman Mohamed Abdullahi Irro cut the ribbon on Somaliland’s embassy in Jerusalem , the territory’s first diplomatic mission abroad and the eighth foreign mission to be opened in the city. The development has intensified a growing dispute between Mogadishu and Tel Aviv over Israel’s engagement with Somaliland. Somalia’s federal government on Tuesday issued a statement saying it reserved the right to take all necessary measures against Israel over its dealings with Somaliland, which it said violated Somalia’s sovereignty, territorial integrity and unity. The government called on the United Nations, the African Union and the wider international community to condemn what it described as actions undermining Somalia’s internationally recognized borders. The latest developments follow remarks made last week by Somali President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud, who argued that Israel had not granted Somaliland genuine recognition but was instead pursuing its own security interests. Speaking in an interview, Hassan Sheikh said a major problem was emerging from the plans involving Somalia and warned that signs of the coming crisis were already visible. He added that Somalia was being drawn into a conflict that was neither in its national interest nor of its own making. The dispute over Israel-Somaliland relations has rapidly become one of the most contentious diplomatic issues in the Horn of Africa, drawing reactions from governments, militant groups and international observers as debate continues over the implications of Somaliland’s expanding international engagement and its relationship with Israel. items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo xilkii ka qaaday taliyihii amniga ka dhigay Muqdisho
items.description: Muqdisho ( Raxanreeb Online) Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, ayaa xilkii ka qaaday taliyihii guutada 23-aad ee ciidanka Boolis militaariyo Gaashaanle Aadan Jeele. Sida ay sheegayaan wararka soo baxaya taliye Aadan Jeele, ayaa la tilmaamay inuu diiday inuu ka qeyb galo howlgalkii lagu weeraray xubnaha mucaaradka ee dowladda. Aadan Jeele, ayaa la tilmaamay in lagu badalay Cabdullaahi Cismaan Jimcaale oo ah sarkaal aad ugu dhow madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh. Taliyaha guutada 23-aad ee ciidanka Boolis militaariyo, ayaa la sheegay inuu gabi ahaanba dhagaha ka fureystay qorshaha lagu weeraray madaxweynihii hore Shariif Sheekh  iyo Ra’iisul wasaarihii hore Xasan Cali Kheyre, kuwaasi oo diidan muddo kordhinta madaxweynaha. Ciidanka Boolis militaariyo, ayaa markii hore taageero ka heli jiray dowladda Imaaraatka, ka hor inta aysan dowladda federaalka xiriirka u jarin dalkaasi. Sikastaba, dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa la sheegay in weli ay sii xoojineyso cadaadis ay ku heyso xubnaha mucaaradka oo ka biyo diidan hannaanka doorashada Qof iyo Cod ee madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud doonayo. items.title: AUSSOM iyo UNMAS oo xoojinaya iskaashiga la dagaallanka walxaha qarxa ee Soomaaliya
items.description: Muqdisho – Taliyaha Ciidanka Hawlgalka Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya (AUSSOM), Sam Kavuma, ayaa shalay magaalada Muqdisho kulan muhiim ah kula yeeshay Madaxa Hay’adda Qaramada Midoobay u qaabilsan la dagaallanka miinooyinka (UNMAS), Fran O’Grady. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta iskaashiga labada dhinac si wax looga qabto halista sii kordheysa ee walxaha qarxa, kuwaas oo weli caqabad weyn ku ah amniga iyo xasilloonida Soomaaliya. Mas’uuliyiinta ayaa isla qaatay muhiimadda ay leedahay dardargelinta hawlaha la dagaallanka miinooyinka iyo walxaha qarxa, gaar ahaan kuwa ay adeegsadaan kooxaha hubeysan. Sidoo kale, waxaa la isla meel dhigay in la ballaariyo qorshaha “Tababarka Tababarayaasha” si loo dhiso awood qaran oo waarta, taas oo u suuragelin karta hay’adaha amniga Soomaaliya inay si madax-bannaan ula tacaalaan khataraha ka dhasha walxaha qarxa. Taliye Sam Kavuma ayaa carrabka ku adkeeyay baahida loo qabo in ciidamada AUSSOM iyo Ciidamada Ammaanka Soomaaliya lagu qalabeeyo aqoon iyo xirfado casri ah oo ay kaga hortagi karaan walxaha qarxa, kuwaas oo si joogto ah khatar ugu haya ciidamada iyo shacabka Soomaaliyeed. Dhankiisa, Madaxa UNMAS, Fran O’Grady, ayaa xaqiijiyay in hay’addu ay sii wadi doonto taageerada ay siiso Soomaaliya, isaga oo xusay in wada-shaqeynta la xiriirta la dagaallanka miinooyinka ay qayb muhiim ah ka tahay dadaallada lagu xaqiijinayo nabadda, amniga iyo xasilloonida dalka. Kulankan ayaa imanaya xilli Soomaaliya ay weli wajahaysay caqabado amni oo la xiriira walxaha qarxa, kuwaas oo si weyn u saameeya dhaqdhaqaaqa bulshada, horumarka adeegyada iyo dadaallada dib-u-dhiska dalka.

items.title: Kadib heshiiskii ay la gashay Iiraan, dowladda Mareykanka oo Israa’iil u diiday in aragto…
items.description: Washington (Caasimada Online) — Mareykanka ayaa diiday codsi rasmi ah oo Israel ay ku dooneysay in lagu siiyo fursad ay ku eegto faahfaahinta is-afgarad cusub oo dhexmaray Tehran iyo Washington, sida ay weriyeen warbaahinta Israel. Warbixinno ay baahiyeen Channel 12 iyo i24 ayaa sheegay in Tel Aviv ay Washington u gudbisay codsi rasmi ah oo ay ku dalbaneysay in loo oggolaado “dib-u-eegis” lagu sameeyo MoU-ga cusub ee Mareykanka iyo Iran, balse maamulka Mareykanka uu arrintaas ka hor istaagay. Sida uu sheegay weriyaha Channel 12 ee Yaron Avraham, Israel weli si buuxda uma oga qodobbada ku jira is-afgaradka, inkastoo heshiiska uu si toos ah u saameynayo xisaabta amni ee Tel Aviv, gaar ahaan dagaalka ay kula jirto Iran iyo kooxaha ay Tehran taageerto ee gobolka. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Israel Benjamin Netanyahu ayaa Isniintii shir jaraa’id ka sheegay in uusan si buuxda u hubin faahfaahinta heshiiska cusub, taas oo muujineysa heerka kala fogaanshaha ka dhex muuqda Washington iyo Tel Aviv xilli Mareykanku isku dayayo inuu soo afjaro xiisadda Iran. “Ma hubo faahfaahinta,” ayuu Netanyahu yiri, isaga oo ka hadlayay is-afgaradka cusub ee Iran iyo Mareykanka. Warbaahinta Cibraaniga ayaa sheegtay in madaxda Israel ay ka dhex jirto caro iyo niyad-jab xooggan oo ku saabsan heshiiska, iyadoo qaar ka mid ah saraakiisha Tel Aviv ay u arkaan tallaabo Mareykanku qaaday iyada oo aan si buuxda loola tashan Israel. Telefishinka i24 ayaa is-afgaradka ku tilmaamay “ceeb,” gaar ahaan qodobka la xiriira ka bixitaanka Lebanon iyo joojinta weerarrada lagu hayo dalkaas. Qodobkaas ayaa u muuqda mid si weyn uga caraysiiyay Israel, maadaama Tel Aviv ay muddooyinkii dambe kordhisay weerarrada ay ka fulineyso gudaha Lebanon, iyadoo ku doodaysa inay beegsaneyso xarumo iyo dagaalyahanno xiriir la leh Hezbollah. Sarkaal la hadlay warbaahinta Israel ayaa sheegay in heshiiska ay u badan tahay inuu fashilmo, isagoo intaas ku daray in weerarro kale oo Israel ay ku qaaddo xarumaha nukliyeerka iyo gantaallada Iran ay yihiin “arrin waqti uun ku xiran.” Hadalkaas ayaa muujinaya in Israel aysan u muuqan mid diyaar u ah inay si buuxda u aqbasho jihada diblomaasiyadeed ee Washington, gaar ahaan haddii ay u aragto in heshiiska uu xaddidayo awooddeeda militari ama uu fursad siinayo Iran. Xiisadda ayaa kasii dartay kadib markii taliyaha ciidamada cirka Israel, Omer Tischler, uu Talaadadii xaqiijiyay in Israel ay toddobaadkii hore baajisay duqeymo ballaaran oo ay qorsheyneysay inay ka fuliso gudaha Iran. “Weerarka waxaa la joojiyay annaga oo weli ku jirna warbixintii ugu dambeysay ee cutubyada duulimaadka, saacad kaliya ka hor intii aysan diyaaradaha kicin,” ayuu yiri Tischler. Hadalkan ayaa daaha ka rogay in Israel ay ku dhoweyd inay qaaddo weerar kale oo culus oo gudaha Iran ah, balse la hakiyay daqiiqadihii ugu dambeeyay. Lama caddeyn sababta rasmiga ah ee keentay joojinta howlgalkaas, balse wuxuu kusoo beegmay xilli Washington ay riixeysay is-afgaradka cusub ee Tehran. Israel ayaa dhanka kale u sheegtay Mareykanka inaysan ku xirneyn heshiiska cusub ee lala galay Iran. “Heshiiska Iran waxaa sameeyay Trump, waana go’aankiisa; annagu waxaan leenahay danaheena,” ayuu Netanyahu ku yiri shir jaraa’id oo uu qabtay 15-kii June. Wuxuu intaas ku daray in dagaalka ka dhanka ah Iran “uusan dhammaan.” Hadalka Netanyahu ayaa si cad u muujiyay in Israel ay dooneyso inay sii haysato xorriyadda ay u aragto mid militari, xitaa haddii Washington ay door bideyso in dagaalka lagu beddelo waddo diblomaasiyadeed. Wasiirka Difaaca Israel, Israel Katz, ayaa isna toddobaadkan sheegay in Tel Aviv ay Iran ku qaadi doonto weerarro “awood buuxda leh” haddii Tehran ay ka jawaabto weerarrada Israel ee Lebanon. Katz ayaa arrintaas barbar dhigay jawaabtii Israel ka bixisay weerarkii ka dhacay Beirut horaantii bishan. Hanjabaadda Katz ayaa sii kordhineysa walaaca laga qabo in is-afgaradka Mareykanka iyo Iran uusan si fudud u dejin doonin xiisadda gobolka, gaar ahaan haddii Israel ay sii waddo howlgallada militari ee Lebanon ama Iran ay go’aansato inay ka jawaabto. Heshiiska cusub ee Washington iyo Tehran ayaa u muuqda inuu abuuray khilaaf cusub oo siyaasadeed iyo mid amni oo u dhexeeya Mareykanka iyo Israel. Inkastoo labada dhinac ay weli yihiin xulafo dhow, haddana arrintan waxay muujineysaa in danaha Trump iyo Netanyahu aysan si buuxda isu waafaqsaneyn xilligan. Washington waxay u muuqataa inay dooneyso inay dagaalka Iran ku beddesho heshiis hoos u dhiga xiisadda, halka Israel ay weli ku adkeysaneyso in khatarta Iran aan weli la soo afjarin. Taasi waxay ka dhigeysaa is-afgaradka cusub mid wajihi kara tijaabo adag, gaar ahaan haddii Israel ay qaaddo weerarro cusub ama haddii Iran ay u aragto tallaabooyinka Tel Aviv kuwa burinaya jawiga xiisad yareynta ee Mareykanku isku dayayo inuu dhiso.
