items.title: Somaliland president lays wreath at tomb of Zionism’s founder during Israel visit
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Somaliland President Abdirahman Abdullahi Irro has paid tribute at two of Israel’s most significant historical sites on the opening day of his first state visit to the territory, as the two sides mark a deepening diplomatic relationship that has drawn sharp criticism from Somalia and many Muslim nations. Tributes at Mount Herzl and Yad Vashem Irro laid a wreath at the tomb of Theodor Herzl, the founder of modern political Zionism, on Mount Herzl on Sunday, before visiting Yad Vashem, Israel’s Holocaust memorial, his office said in a statement on Facebook . At Yad Vashem, officials briefed Irro on accounts of the Holocaust, walking him through the history of the atrocity and the events that shaped it. The Somaliland leader also visited the Grove of Nations, where he planted a tree described by his office as a symbol of friendship, cooperation and lasting relations between Somaliland and Israel. The tree, the statement said, represents a living and sustaining bond that will outlast the visit itself, marking a historic friendship that strengthens ties between the two sides. Somaliland President Irro and his wife at the Theodor Herzl tomb in Jerusalem during a historic state visit to Israel. Irro and Herzog hold joint press conference in Jerusalem Irro touched down in Jerusalem for his first state visit to Israel, where he held a joint press conference with Israeli President Isaac Herzog. “We are deeply appreciative that the State of Israel has chosen to receive us with such an honour on this historic occasion. By doing so, Israel has taken part in a moment that will be remembered in the diplomatic history of our nation, and we do not take that gesture lightly,” he said. “Somaliland has been talking, has been reaching out to world leaders for the last 35 years. They were asking only one question: to see us. Only one country desired to see us and recognise Somaliland, and that’s the government of Israel and its people,” Irro added. items.title: FIFA to pay Somali referee after US entry bar disrupted World Cup role
items.description: World football governing body FIFA has taken an exceptional decision regarding the compensation of referee Omar Abdulkadir Artan after his World Cup participation was disrupted by his denial of entry into the United States, sources familiar with the matter said. The 34-year-old was deported after an 11-hour interrogation by immigration officials in Miami, preventing him from taking part in the tournament, where he had been set to become the first referee from Somalia to officiate at a World Cup. FIFA customarily pays match officials at the conclusion of a World Cup based on their involvement, but Artan’s case is understood to have been treated as exceptional due to the circumstances surrounding his absence. Artan had been widely viewed as a landmark appointment for Somali football development after being selected for the tournament. Since the incident, he has received backing from across the football community. European football governing body UEFA has appointed him to officiate the Super Cup between Paris Saint-Germain and Aston Villa in August. Artan was named Africa’s best male referee in 2025, further raising expectations ahead of his World Cup debut. Somalia is among nearly 40 countries affected by expanded US travel restrictions introduced under former President Donald Trump’s immigration measures. The post FIFA to pay Somali referee after US entry bar disrupted World Cup role first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Galmudug demands consensus-led election amid tensions
items.description: Somalia’s Galmudug state has rejected any election model imposed without political agreement, distancing itself from the recent vote process held in Southwest State and calling for a consensus-based approach, officials said. Galmudug Information Minister Ali Mohamed Farah Seeko said on Saturday the regional administration would not accept an electoral process conducted without agreement among stakeholders, insisting elections must align with the constitution. Speaking to Universal Somali TV, Seeko said Galmudug opposed replicating the model used in Southwest State and urged local leaders and communities to jointly determine the electoral framework. “ Galmudug administration is still insisting on previous agreements regarding the three-tier elections, namely local government elections, Galmudug administration and the federal government,” he said. He accused the federal government of suspending earlier preparations for regional elections, saying committees and funding had already been put in place. Seeko said his remarks reflect the official position of the administration led by Galmudug President Ahmed Abdi Kariye Qoor Qoor. “ An election similar to the one that took place in Southwest will not happen in Galmudug, and we will not accept it,” he said. His comments follow the conclusion of regional elections in Southwest State, where lawmakers and a regional president were elected despite objections from some candidates and opposition figures who alleged federal interference. In that vote, former federal speaker Sheikh Aden Mohamed Nur Madobe was elected president after rival candidate Sharif Hassan Sheikh Aden withdrew, citing alleged violations of agreed electoral procedures. items.title: UN releases $10 mln to avert famine in Somalia as hunger crisis
items.description: The United Nations has released $10 million from its emergency fund to help avert famine in Somalia, where millions face acute food insecurity. The funding, announced Sunday by UN humanitarian chief Tom Fletcher, will support food, nutrition, health and water assistance for about 640,000 people, the United Nations said. “The window to prevent famine in Somalia is short,” Fletcher said. The United Nations said around 6 million people are experiencing severe hunger, including 1.9 million in emergency levels of food insecurity. “The situation has deteriorated due to increased food insecurity, widespread malnutrition, and reduced access to basic services,” Fletcher said in a separate statement. The UN warned that a “plausible risk of famine” has been identified in parts of Bay and Bakool regions in South West State, particularly in agropastoral areas. More than 500,000 people have been displaced since the start of 2026, according to the UN. Somalia is facing a severe drought following successive failed or below-average rainy seasons, compounded by conflict, displacement, disease outbreaks and rising food prices. Humanitarian agencies have warned that funding shortages are forcing cuts to critical aid programmes even as needs continue to rise across the country. The post UN releases $10 mln to avert famine in Somalia as hunger crisis first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Ciidanka Danab oo sheegay in ay dileen 14 katirsan kooxda AS
items.description: Shabeellaha Hoose ( Raxanreeb Online) Ciidanka Kumaandooska Danab ee Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed ayaa howlgal lagu bartilmaameedsaday maleeshiyaad katirsan Al-shabaab ka fuliyay degmada Kurtunwaarey ee gobolka Shabeellaha Hoose. Howlgalka ayaa lla sheegay in lagu beegsaday goobo ay ku sugnaayeen horjoogayaal iyo maleeshiyaad ka tirsan Al-Shabaab. Intii uu socday howlgalka, waxaana la tilmaamay in lagu dilay 14 ka tirsanaa Al-shabaab. Sidoo kale, Ciidanka ayaa sheegay in ay burburiyeen kayd hub, walxaha qarxa iyo agab kale oo Shabaab u adeegsan jirtay diyaarinta iyo fulinta falalka argagixisanimo ee lagu dhibaateeyo shacabka Soomaaliyeed. Saraakiisha ciidanka ayaa sheegay in Howlgalkan uu qayb ka yahay dadaallada joogtada ah ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed ay ugu jiraan ciribtirka Al-shabaab, kuwaas oo ay ku eedeeyeen in ay ku caan baxay cabburinta shacabka, dhaca hantidooda iyo falalka amni-darrada ah ee ay ka geystaan deegaannada dalka. Sidoo kale Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga iyo Taliska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, ayaa xusay in ay ka go’an tahay sii wadidda howlgalada lagu xaqiijinayo amniga, xasilloonida iyo nabadda dalka. The post Ciidanka Danab oo sheegay in ay dileen 14 katirsan kooxda AS appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: War cusub oo kasoo kordhay wada-hadallada DF iyo mucaaradka
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Xubnaha Beesha Caalamka ee fadhigoodu yahay magaalada Muqdisho ayaa weli sii wada dadaalladooda ku aadan dhex-dhexaadinta madaxda Dowadda Federaalka iyo kuwa mucaaradka, si loo bilaabo wada-hadallo toos ah oo xal loogu raadinayo khilaafka hareeyay hannaanka doorashooyinka dalka. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in labada dhinac ay muujiyeen dabacsanaan, kadib cadaadis aan kala joogsi lahayn oo ay saartay Beesha Caalamka, oo iyadu farogelin, billowday kadib dagaalkii dhawaan labada dhinac ku dhexmaray xaafado ka tirsan magaalada Muqdisho. Golaha Mustaqbalka Soomaaliyeed oo ka kooban Madasha Samatabixinta, Jubbaland iyo Puntland ayaa haatan soo magacaabay guddi farsamo oo loo xil saaray isku dubbaridka dadaallada lagu doonayo in lagu bilaabo wada-hadal u dhexeeya Villa Soomaaliya iyo mucaaradka, sida ay innoo xaqiijiyeen ilo wareedyo xilkas ah. Sida ay ogaatay Caasimada Online, guddigan ayaa ka kooban xubno kala metelaya Madasha Samatabixinta iyo labada maamul ee ku midoobay Golahan, waxayna kala yihiin;- 1- Wasiir hore Maxamed Dhabancad oo metelaya Madaxweynaha Puntland Saciid Cabdullahi Deni, 2-Cabdirashiid Jire oo isna metelaya Madaxweynaha Jubaland Axmed Maxamed Islaam (Axmed Madoobe) iyo saddex xubnood oo kale oo iyana metalaya mucaaradka Muqdisho, kuwaas oo kala ah Cabdiraxmaan Cabdishakuur Warsame, Cabdullaahi Maxamed Cali (Sanbaloolshe) iyo Cabdiraxmaan Ceynte. Wararka ayaa intaas kusii daraya in xubnahan ay diiradda saari doonaan sidii loo mideyn lahaa dadaallada kala duwan ee Beesha Caalamka ee ku aadan xal ka gaaridda khilaafka ka taagan dalka ee ka dhashay arrimaha doorashada iyo wax ka beddelka dastuurka kumeel gaarka ah. Dhinaca kale, Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa dhankeeda wadda diyaar garow ku aadan wada-hadallada bilaabanaya oo ay door weyn ku leeyihiin dalalka Turkiga, Mareykanka, Ingiriiska iyo Qaramada Midoobay, kuwaas oo qaaday tallaabooyin lagu qaboojinayo xiisadda taagan. Dadaalladan oo maalmo badan socda ayaa haatan uu muuqdo kuwa suuragelin kara in markale ay miiska wada-hadalka isugu yimaadaan dowladda iyo mucaaradka oo horay ugu kala kacay shirar kala duwan oo ay yeesheen. Si kastaba, Soomaaliya ayaa haatan ku jirto marxlad xasaasi ah oo ka dhalatay is mariwaaga siyaasadeed ee dhinacyadan, taas oo keentay in qalqal amni laga dareemo gudaha caasimada, inkastoo haatan xaaladdu ay dagan tahay. The post War cusub oo kasoo kordhay wada-hadallada DF iyo mucaaradka appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: DFS oo Magacowday Taliyaha Qaybta 54-aad iyo Puntland oo Si Adag uga Soo Horjeedda
items.description: Xog ay heshay Goobjoog ayaa muujinaysa in Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ay Jimcaale Jaamac Takar u magacowday Taliyaha Qaybta 54-aad ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, oo xarunteedu tahay magaalada Garoowe. Magacaabistan ayaa qeyb ka ah dadaallo ay dowladda federaalku ku ballaarinayso qaab-dhismeedka ciidanka qaranka, iyadoo dhawaan ciidanka Federaalka lagu daray askar hore uga tirsanaa ciidamada Puntland oo ku sugnaa Garoowe iyo Boosaaso. Ilo xog-ogaal ah ayaa sheegaya in ujeedada dowladda ay tahay dib u soo nooleynta taliskii Ciidanka Xoogga ee hore uga jiray deegaannada Puntland kahor burburkii dowladdii dhexe. Si kastaba, tallaabadan ayaa wajahaysa diidmo xooggan oo ka timid Puntland. Jimcaale Jaamac Takar ayaan hore uga tirsanaan jirin Ciidanka Federaalka, balse wuxuu caan ku yahay inuu hoggaamin jiray ciidamada Danab ee Puntland, kuwaas oo hoos taga maamulka Puntland kana madax-bannaan taliska Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, inkastoo saldhigyadoodu ku yaallaan Garoowe. Magacaabistan ayaa noqoneysa tii ugu horreysay ee Dowladda Federaalka ay taliye qaybeed si toos ah ugu magacowdo Puntland tan iyo sanadkii 1991-kii, iyadoo aan jirin wax oggolaansho ama wada-tashi rasmi ah oo lala yeeshay maamulka Puntland. Arrintan ayaa la filayaa inay sii xoojiso khilaafka siyaasadeed ee u dhexeeya Muqdisho iyo Garoowe, xilli labada dhinac ay hore ugu kala aragti duwanaayeen arrimo la xiriira awood-qaybsiga, dastuurka iyo maamulka ciidamada.

items.title: Puntland oo madaxweyne Xasan ku eedeeysay in uu abuuray burcad badeed hubeysan oo weerara Maraakiibta
items.description: Garoowe ( Raxanreeb Online) Maamulka Puntland ayaa ku eedeysay Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud abuurida burcad Badeed hubeysan oo weeraro ku qaaday gaadiid badeed isticmaalaya biyaha caalamiga ah iyo Xeebaha Soomaaliya. items.title: Maamulka Puntland oo ku dhawaaqay inuu sidii dawlad madax-bannaan u dhaqmi doono
items.description: Madaxweynaha maamulka Puntland, Siciid Cabdullahi Deni, ayaa sheegay in Puntland ay sii wadi doonto inay si madaxbannaan u maamulato arrimaheeda ilaa laga helayo dowlad Soomaaliyeed oo heshiis iyo wada-ogol lagu yahay, sida uu hadalka u dhigay. Madaxweyne Deni ayaa hadalkan ka jeediyay furitaanka kal-fadhiga 58-aad ee Golaha Wakiillada Puntland, halkaas oo uu kaga hadlay xaaladda siyaasadeed ee dalka iyo xiriirka u dhexeeya Puntland iyo Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Deni wuxuu ku eedeeyay Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya inay ku fashilantay ilaalinta nidaamka dowladnimada iyo wadajirka dalka, isaga oo sheegay in tallaabooyinka ay qaaday ay horseedeen khilaafyo siyaasadeed iyo amni darro. Waxa uu sidoo kale ku eedeeyay dowladda dhexe inay qayb ka tahay abuurista xaalado amni oo halis gelinaya xasilloonida dalka, asagoo sheegay in gudaha Puntland laga wado falal lagu carqaladaynayo jiritaanka maamulkaas. Madaxweynaha Puntland ayaa adkeeyay in maamulkiisu uu sii wadi doono difaaca danaha shacabka Puntland iyo ilaalinta nidaamka dowladnimo ee ay dhisteen, isagoo ku baaqay in la helo hannaan siyaasadeed oo ku dhisan wada-tashi, heshiis iyo kalsooni dhex marta dhinacyada Soomaaliyeed. Hadalka Madaxweynaha Puntland ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli ay jiraan khilaafyo siyaasadeed oo u dhexeeya Puntland iyo Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, kuwaas oo la xiriira arrimo ay ka mid yihiin dib-u-habeynta dastuurka, doorashooyinka iyo nidaamka awood-qaybsiga dalka.

items.title: Xuutiyiinta oo jawaab culus ka soo saaray booqashada uu C/raxmaan Cirro ku tegay Israel
items.description: Sanca (Caasimada Online) — Maamulka Xuutiyiinta Yemen ayaa si kulul u cambaareeyay safarka madaxweynaha maamulka Somaliland Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdullaahi Cirro uu shalay ku tagay Israel, xilli xiriirka sii xoogeysanaya ee Hargeysa iyo Tel Aviv uu weli abuurayo caro ballaaran oo ka taagan Soomaaliya, gobolka iyo dalal ka tirsan dunida Carabta. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee maamulka Xuutiyiinta ee fadhigoodu yahay magaalada Sanca ayaa bayaan ay soo saartay ku tilmaantay Cirro “madaxweynaha is-magacaabay ee Somaliland”, iyadoo sheegtay in booqashadiisa Israel ay tahay tallaabo ceeb ah oo sii fogeynaysa Hargeysa. Bayaanka, oo ay daabacday wakaaladda wararka Saba ee ay maamulaan Xuutiyiinta, ayaa lagu yiri: “Qof kasta oo booqda, gacan qaada ama aqoonsada dambiilayaasha dagaalka ee Sahyuuniyadda waa inuu dareemaa ceeb iyo hoos-u-dhac.” Wasaaradda ayaa Israel ku eedeysay in gacmaheedu “ku wasakhoobeen dhiigga Carabta” ee Falastiin, Lubnaan, Iran iyo Yemen, iyadoo ku tilmaantay Israel cadowga ummadda Islaamka iyo goobaha barakeysan. “Xiriirka sii kordhaya ee Hargeysa la sameyneyso Israel waxba kama tarayo danaha Somaliland, mana gaarsiinayo ujeeddooyinka ay raadineyso,” ayaa lagu yiri bayaanka. Maamulka Xuutiyiinta ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in xiriirka Hargeysa iyo Tel Aviv uu Somaliland ka sii fogeyn doono deegaanka Carabta iyo Islaamka, halkii uu u horseedi lahaa aqoonsi iyo taageero siyaasadeed oo ballaaran. Bayaanka ayaa intaas ku daray in dalalka Carabta looga baahan yahay in aysan ku ekaan cambaareyn afka ah, balse ay qaadaan “tallaabooyin muuqda” oo looga hortagayo waxa uu ku tilmaamay “tallaabooyinka ceebta ah” ee Hargeysa. Cambaareynta Xuutiyiinta ayaa imaneysa xilli Madaxweynaha Somaliland Cabdiraxmaan Cirro uu gaaray Israel, safar loo arko mid ka mid ah tallaabooyinkii ugu waaweynaa ee Hargeysa qaaddo tan iyo markii Israel ay noqotay dalkii ugu horreeyay ee xubin ka ah Qaramada Midoobay oo si rasmi ah u aqoonsada Somaliland. Warbaahinta Israel ayaa sheegtay in safarka Cirro uu qeyb ka yahay dadaal lagu xoojinayo xiriirka labada dhinac, islamarkaana lagu wado in lagu furo safaarad Somaliland ku yeelato magaalada Qudus, oo Hargeysa ay u aqoonsatay caasimadda Israel. Tallaabadaas ayaa si weyn uga careysiisay dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya. Sidoo kale, Midowga Afrika ayaa horey u diiday aqoonsiga Israel ee Somaliland, isagoo sheegay in tallaabadaas ay ka hor imaaneyso mabda’a ilaalinta midnimada, madaxbannaanida iyo dhuleed ee dalalka Afrika. Soomaaliya ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in xiriirka Israel iyo Somaliland uu qeyb ka yahay qorshe khatar ku ah gobolka Geeska Afrika, halka Hargeysa ay ku adkeysaneyso in ay xaq u leedahay sameysashada xiriir dibadeed oo u adeega danaheeda amni, dhaqaale iyo diblomaasiyadeed. Bayaanka Xuutiyiinta ayaa muranka Somaliland iyo Israel siinaya xagal cusub oo ku xiran Badda Cas iyo siyaasadda gobolka. Xuutiyiinta, oo taageero ka hela Iran, ayaa muddooyinkii dambe si weyn ugu lug lahaa xiisadaha ka taagan Badda Cas, iyagoo weeraro ku qaaday maraakiib ay ku sheegaan inay xiriir la leeyihiin Israel ama ay u socdaan dekedaha Israel. Maamulka Sanca ayaa sheegay in Israel aysan ku guuleysan doonin qorshayaasheeda ku wajahan Soomaaliya iyo Geeska Afrika, isagoo ballan qaaday in Yemen ay ka hor imaan doonto dadaalladaas. Bayaanka ayaa sidoo kale lagu sheegay in Xuutiyiintu ay si buuxda u taageerayaan Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, si ay uga hortagto waxa ay ku tilmaameen “mashruuc Sahyuuni ah” oo lagu beegsanayo Soomaaliya, Geeska Afrika iyo guud ahaan gobolka. The post Xuutiyiinta oo jawaab culus ka soo saaray booqashada uu C/raxmaan Cirro ku tegay Israel appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Mareykanka iyo Iran oo kala saxiixday heshiis buuxa oo aysan qeyb ka aheyn Israa’iil
items.description: Washington (Caasimada Online) — Mareykanka iyo Iran ayaa gaaray heshiis lagu soo afjarayo dagaalkii u dhaxeeyay labada dal, sida ay Axaddii shaaciyeen madaxweyne Donald Trump iyo ra’iisul wasaaraha Pakistan Shehbaz Sharif, oo dalkiisu door dhexdhexaadin ah ka ciyaaray wadahadallada. Trump ayaa qoraal uu soo dhigay bartiisa Truth Social ku sheegay in “heshiiska Jamhuuriyadda Islaamiga ah ee Iran uu hadda dhammeystiran yahay,” isagoo sidoo kale ku dhawaaqay in si degdeg ah loo furayo marinka muhiimka ah ee Strait of Hormuz. “Hambalyo dhammaan!” ayuu qoray Trump. “Waxaan si buuxda u oggolaaday furitaanka lacag la’aanta ah ee Strait of Hormuz, isla markaana waxaan oggolaaday in si degdeg ah loo qaado xayiraadda badeed ee Mareykanka saaray dekedaha Iran.” Trump ayaa hadalkiisa ku daray: “Maraakiibta caalamka, mishiinnadiinna shita. Saliidda ha socoto!” Ra’iisul wasaaraha Pakistan Shehbaz Sharif ayaa isna sheegay in Washington iyo Tehran ay gaareen heshiis nabadeed oo dhigaya in si degdeg ah oo joogto ah loo joojiyo howl-gallada militari ee dhammaan jihooyinka, oo ay ku jirto Lubnaan. Sharif ayaa sheegay in heshiiska si rasmi ah loogu saxiixi doono Jimcaha dalka Switzerland. Heshiiskan ayaa imanaya kadib ku dhowaad afar bilood oo dagaal ah, kaas oo sababay dhimashada kumannaan qof, inta badan Iran iyo Lubnaan, isla markaana gilgilay suuqyada tamarta caalamka. Dagaalka ayaa sidoo kale cadaadis weyn saaray dalalka Khaliijka ee martigeliya saldhigyada Mareykanka, kadib markii Iran ay weerarro ku qaadday Israel iyo qaar ka mid ah xarumaha Mareykanka ee gobolka. Marinka Hormuz oo dib loo furayo Qodobka ugu weyn ee heshiiska ayaa ah dib u furista Marinka Hormuz, oo ah marin biyood istiraatiiji ah oo muhiim u ah dhaqaalaha caalamka. Iran ayaa muddo bilo ah si wax ku ool ah u xirtay marinkan, taas oo hakad gelisay maraakiibta saliidda iyo gaaska qaada. Arrintaas ayaa sare u qaaday qiimaha tamarta, gaar ahaan shidaalka iyo saliidda cayriin, waxayna cabsi gelisay dalal badan oo ku tiirsan sahayda Khaliijka. Mareykanka ayaa dhankiisa xayiraad badeed saaray dekedaha Iran, taas oo sii kordhisay xiisadda labada dhinac. Sida ay ilo dhowr ah hore u sheegeen, qodobbada hordhaca ah ee heshiiska ayaa dhigaya in Iran ay dib u furto Marinka Hormuz, halka Mareykanku uu qaadayo xayiraadda badeed ee saaran dekedaha Iran. Marinkan ayaa isku xira Khaliijka Faaris, Gacanka Cumaan iyo Badda Carabta, waxaana mara qayb weyn oo ka mid ah saliidda iyo gaaska dunida. Wadahadallo nukliyeer oo xiga Inkasta oo heshiisku soo afjarayo dagaalka, haddana arrinta ugu adag ee barnaamijka nukliyeerka Iran ayaa loo dhaafay wadahadallo kale oo socon doona 60 maalmood. Qodobbada la sheegay ayaa dhigaya in Iran aysan soo saari doonin ama heli doonin hub nukliyeer, isla markaana aysan ballaarin doonin xarumaheeda nukliyeerka inta wadahadalladu socdaan. Mareykanka ayaa doonaya in heshiiska kama dambaysta ah uu horseedo in Iran ay si weyn u xaddiddo barnaamijkeeda nukliyeerka. Iran ayaa dhankeeda ku adkeysaneysa in aysan doonayn hub nukliyeer, balse ay xaq u leedahay barnaamij nukliyeer oo nabadeed. Heshiiska ayaa sidoo kale la sheegay inuu Iran siinayo fursad dhaqaale, oo ay ku jiraan ka dhaafis cunaqabateyn saliid, hakinta cunaqabateymo cusub inta wadahadalladu socdaan, iyo sii deynta lacago badan oo Iran uga xayiran dibadda. Israel oo ka baxsan heshiiska Israel ayaa sheegtay inaysan qeyb ka ahayn heshiiska Mareykanka iyo Iran, isla markaana ay sii wadan doonto waxa ay ku tilmaanto xorriyadda howl-galladeeda militari ee Lubnaan. Heshiiska ayaa yimid saacado kadib markii Israel ay duqeyn ku qaadday duleedka koonfureed ee Beirut, taas oo dhalisay caro ka timid Tehran iyo dhaliil uu jeediyay Trump. Trump ayaa sheegay in weerarkaas “uusan dhici lahayn,” maadaama Mareykanka uu ku dhowaa heshiis nabadeed oo uu la galo Iran. Haddii heshiisku hirgalo, wuxuu noqon karaa isbeddel weyn oo gobolka ka dhaca, isagoo yareyn kara xiisadda Khaliijka, dib u furi kara marin muhiim u ah saliidda caalamka, isla markaana bilaabi kara wadahadallo cusub oo ku saabsan mustaqbalka barnaamijka nukliyeerka Iran. Saliidda ha socoto!” Ra’iisul wasaaraha Pakistan Shehbaz Sharif ayaa isna sheegay in Washington iyo Tehran ay gaareen heshiis nabadeed oo dhigaya in si degdeg ah oo joogto ah loo joojiyo howl-gallada militari ee dhammaan jihooyinka, oo ay ku jirto Lubnaan. Sharif ayaa sheegay in heshiiska si rasmi ah loogu saxiixi doono Jimcaha dalka Switzerland. Heshiiskan ayaa imanaya kadib ku dhowaad afar bilood oo dagaal ah, kaas oo sababay dhimashada kumannaan qof, inta badan Iran iyo Lubnaan, isla markaana gilgilay suuqyada tamarta caalamka. Dagaalka ayaa sidoo kale cadaadis weyn saaray dalalka Khaliijka ee martigeliya saldhigyada Mareykanka, kadib markii Iran ay weerarro ku qaadday Israel iyo qaar ka mid ah xarumaha Mareykanka ee gobolka. Marinka Hormuz oo dib loo furayo Qodobka ugu weyn ee heshiiska ayaa ah dib u furista Marinka Hormuz, oo ah marin biyood istiraatiiji ah oo muhiim u ah dhaqaalaha caalamka. Iran ayaa muddo bilo ah si wax ku ool ah u xirtay marinkan, taas oo hakad gelisay maraakiibta saliidda iyo gaaska qaada. Arrintaas ayaa sare u qaaday qiimaha tamarta, gaar ahaan shidaalka iyo saliidda cayriin, waxayna cabsi gelisay dalal badan oo ku tiirsan sahayda Khaliijka. Mareykanka ayaa dhankiisa xayiraad badeed saaray dekedaha Iran, taas oo sii kordhisay xiisadda labada dhinac. Sida ay ilo dhowr ah hore u sheegeen, qodobbada hordhaca ah ee heshiiska ayaa dhigaya in Iran ay dib u furto Marinka Hormuz, halka Mareykanku uu qaadayo xayiraadda badeed ee saaran dekedaha Iran. Marinkan ayaa isku xira Khaliijka Faaris, Gacanka Cumaan iyo Badda Carabta, waxaana mara qayb weyn oo ka mid ah saliidda iyo gaaska dunida. Wadahadallo nukliyeer oo xiga Inkasta oo heshiisku soo afjarayo dagaalka, haddana arrinta ugu adag ee barnaamijka nukliyeerka Iran ayaa loo dhaafay wadahadallo kale oo socon doona 60 maalmood. Qodobbada la sheegay ayaa dhigaya in Iran aysan soo saari doonin ama heli doonin hub nukliyeer, isla markaana aysan ballaarin doonin xarumaheeda nukliyeerka inta wadahadalladu socdaan. Mareykanka ayaa doonaya in heshiiska kama dambaysta ah uu horseedo in Iran ay si weyn u xaddiddo barnaamijkeeda nukliyeerka. Iran ayaa dhankeeda ku adkeysaneysa in aysan doonayn hub nukliyeer, balse ay xaq u leedahay barnaamij nukliyeer oo nabadeed. Heshiiska ayaa sidoo kale la sheegay inuu Iran siinayo fursad dhaqaale, oo ay ku jiraan ka dhaafis cunaqabateyn saliid, hakinta cunaqabateymo cusub inta wadahadalladu socdaan, iyo sii deynta lacago badan oo Iran uga xayiran dibadda. Israel oo ka baxsan heshiiska Israel ayaa sheegtay inaysan qeyb ka ahayn heshiiska Mareykanka iyo Iran, isla markaana ay sii wadan doonto waxa ay ku tilmaanto xorriyadda howl-galladeeda militari ee Lubnaan. Heshiiska ayaa yimid saacado kadib markii Israel ay duqeyn ku qaadday duleedka koonfureed ee Beirut, taas oo dhalisay caro ka timid Tehran iyo dhaliil uu jeediyay Trump. Trump ayaa sheegay in weerarkaas “uusan dhici lahayn,” maadaama Mareykanka uu ku dhowaa heshiis nabadeed oo uu la galo Iran. Haddii heshiisku hirgalo, wuxuu noqon karaa isbeddel weyn oo gobolka ka dhaca, isagoo yareyn kara xiisadda Khaliijka, dib u furi kara marin muhiim u ah saliidda caalamka, isla markaana bilaabi kara wadahadallo cusub oo ku saabsan mustaqbalka barnaamijka nukliyeerka Iran. items.title: Madaxda adduunka oo soo dhaweysay heshiiska Mareykanka iyo Iran
items.description: Hoggaamiyeyaasha caalamka qaarkood ayaa soo dhaweeyay ku dhawaaqista Mareykanka iyo Iran ee ku saabsan in ay gaareen heshiis nabadeed. Xoghayaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobey, António Guterres ayaa soo dhaweeyay heshiiska nabadeed ee labada dal ee lagu soo afjarayo dagaalka Bariga Dhexe. Xoghaye Guterres ayaa heshiiska ku tilmaamay tallaabo keeneysa in wada hadal lagu xaliyo colaadda. Hoggaamiyeyaasha Midowga Yurub iyo Ingiriiska ayaa soo dhaweeyay heshiiska lagu dhameynayo ku dhawaad afar bilood oo dagaal iyo xiisado ay ka jireen Gobolka Bariga Dhexe. Raysal Wasaaraha Ingiriiska, Keir Starmer ayaa heshiiska ku sheegay tallaabo aad muhiim u ah oo hore loo qaaday, laguna soo afjarayo dagaalka. Raysal Wasaaraha Australia, Anthony Albanese oo heshiiska bogaadiyay ayaa sheegay inuu rajeynayo in heshiisku uu horseedo nabad waarta. Raysal Wasaaraha Japan, Sanae Takaichi ayaa ka mid noqotay hoggaamiyeyaashii ugu dambeeyay ee amaanay heshiiska. Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda New Zealand, Winston Peters ayaa dhankiisa heshiiska ku qeexay mid wax ku ool ah iyo tallaabo loo qaaday dhismista xiisadaha iyo horumarinta xasilloonida gobolka, oo muhiim u ah buu yiri amniga dhaqaalaha adduunka. Hoggaamiyeyaasha dunida ayaa si isku mid ah u taageeray dadaalada socda ee dib loogu furayo marin biyoodka Hormuz, kaas oo wax ka taraya hubanti la’aanta sahayda tamarta adduunka iyo sicirka bararka baahsan ee ka jira suuqyada caalamiga ah. Madaxweyne Donald Trump ayaa sheegay in heshiiska lala galay Iran uu ogolanaayo in maraakiibta ganacsiga caalamiga ah ay si lacag ah ku maraan Marinka Hormuz. Marinka Hormuz ayaa laf dhabar u ah dhaqaalaha adduunka, waana isha ugu weyn ee uu ka gudbo batroolka iyo gaaska Bariga Dhexe.

items.title: Warbaahinta dawladda Iran oo baahisay 14 qodob oo ay sheegtya in lagau heshiiyay
items.description: Warbaahinta dawladda Iran oo baahisay 14 qodob oo ay sheegtya in lagau heshiiyay Warbaahinta dowladda Iiraan ayaa baahinaysa waxa ay ku sheegtay faahfaahinta qabyo-qoraal heshiis 14 qodob ah oo u dhexeeya Maraykanka iyo Iiraan. Qodobadan si rasmi ah looma xaqiijin labada dhinac midkoodna. Mehr News Agency ayaa sheegtay in qodobada ay ka mid yihiin: Xabbad-joojin joogto ah oo ka hirgasha dhammaan jihooyinka, oo ay ku jirto Lubnaan Ballanqaad Maraykanka uu ku galay inuusan faragelin arrimaha gudaha ee Iiraan In 30 maalmood gudahood la qaado go’doominta badda ee Maraykanka In ciidamada Maraykanka laga saaro Iiraan In marinka Hormuz dib loo furo 30 maalmood gudahood “iyadoo lagu maamulayo habka Iiraan” Maraykanka iyo xulafadiisa oo soo bandhigaya qorshe dib-u-dhis Iiraan ah oo ugu yaraan gaaraya $300 bilyan In la joojiyo cunaqabateynta saliidda iyo tamarta Iiraan Iiraan oo mar kale xaqiijinaysa inayan soo saari doonin hub nukliyeer ah Maraykanka oo ballanqaadaya inuusan kordhin doonin ciidamadiisa gobolka isla markaana uusan soo rogi doonin cunaqabatayn cusub Mehr News Agency ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in:“Wada-hadallada kama dambaysta ah aysan bilaaban doonin ilaa qayb ka mid ah lacagaha Iiraan ee la xannibay la sii daayo, cunaqabataynta saliidda la hakiyo, isla markaana go’doominta badda la qaado.” Waxay intaas ku dartay in heshiiska ugu dambeeya lagu ansixin doono qaraar ka soo baxa Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada midoobey

items.title: Saciid Deni oo arrimo xasaasi ah ku eedeeyay Xasan Sheekh
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Maamul-goboleedka Puntland, Mudane Saciid Cabdullaahi Deni oo maanta furay kalfadhigga 58-aad ee Baarlamaanka maamulkaas ayaa weerar culus oo dhanka afka ah ku qaaday Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, isaga oo u jeediyay eedeymo culus. Saciid Deni ayaa Madaxweynaha ku eedeeyay in xeebaha Puntland, gaar ahaan deegaannada Xaafuun, Eyl iyo Jariiban uu ku abuuray burcadbadeed hubeysan oo weerarro ku qaaday maraakiib iyo doonyo isticmaala xeebaha bari ee Soomaaliya iyo sidoo kale biyaha caalamiga ah, sida uu hadalka u dhigay. Sidoo kale, wuxuu Xasan Sheekh oo ay si wayn isugu hayaan arrimaha siyaasadda uu ku eedeeyey inuu isku dayay inuu colaad ka huriyo deegaannada Puntland, gaar ahaan dadka reee Sool iyo maamulka Puntland. “Madaxweynihii hore ee DFS wuxuu ku dadaaley inuu colaad ka dhex abuuro dadka walaala ah ee Reer Sool iyo Puntland, laakiin dadka reer Sool oo aad u garasho badan way diideen ina colaadaasi dhacdo,” ayuu yiri Madaxweyne Saciid Deni. Dhanka kale, wuxuu soo hadal qaaday xaaladda siyaasadeed ee dalka, isaga oo sheegay in Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud uu kala diray Soomaaliya, Isla markaana uu ku xadgudbay nidaamkii Federaalka ee heshiiska lagu lahaa, laguna duulay maamul goboleedyada dalka. Waxaa kale oo uu intaas ku daray in Puntland ay si cad uga hortimid afduub siyaasadeed iyo mid sharci oo dalka loo geysto, ayna ka dagaalamayso, sida uu ku dooday, Saciid Cabdullaahi Deni. “Puntland waxay ka hortimid afduub siyaasadeed iyo mid sharci oo uu Madaxweynihii hore ee dalka ku sameeyey hannaankii heshiiska lagu ahaa, wuxuuna duullaan toos ah ku hayaa hannaankii federaalka iyo maamullada ka jira dalka, wuxuu horay duullaan hubeysan ugu qaaday Raaskambooni oo uu ku dilay muwaadiniin Soomaaliyeed, wuxuu sidooo kale khalkhal siyaasadeed iyo afgambi ka sameeyey magaalada Baydhaba, isagoo meesha ka saaray hannaankii maamul ee ka jirey Koonfur Galbeed, “ayuu yiri markale yiri Madaxweynaha maamulka Puntland. Hadalkan ayaa kusoo aadayo, iyada oo haatan dowladda Soomaaliya ay kordhisay dhaqdhaqaaqeeda gudaha Puntland, isla markaana ay ka wado qorista ciidamo federaal ah oo ka howlgala deegaannada maamulkaas, si ay saameyn ugu yeelato halkaasi. The post Saciid Deni oo arrimo xasaasi ah ku eedeeyay Xasan Sheekh appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Somalia famine risk: UN releases $10M in urgent aid to save millions
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – The United Nations has unlocked an urgent $10 million emergency allocation to stave off a burgeoning catastrophe in Somalia, where the delicate balance between survival and starvation is fracturing under the weight of a deepening humanitarian crisis. Tom Fletcher, the UN’s humanitarian chief, issued a stark warning this Sunday: the window to avert a full-scale famine is closing with chilling speed. As a protracted cycle of drought and conflict ravages the Horn of Africa, the international body is scrambling to reach the most vulnerable before the situation reaches a point of no return. The Human Toll The scale of the emergency is immense. Current data paints a harrowing picture: 6 million people —nearly one-third of the nation’s population—are grappling with acute food insecurity. Of these, 1.9 million are already teetering on the edge of survival, classified as living in emergency conditions. “The situation has deteriorated due to increased food insecurity, widespread malnutrition, and reduced access to basic services,” Mr. Fletcher stated, emphasizing the urgency of the intervention. The $10 million injection is designed as a lifeline, aiming to deliver essential nutrition, emergency healthcare, clean water, and food supplies to 640,000 individuals who have been hardest hit by the systemic collapse of local support structures. Geography of Despair While the crisis is national in scope, the UN has identified specific “red zones” where the risk of famine is no longer a distant threat, but a plausible reality. The Bay and Bakool regions within South West state, particularly the agropastoral communities, are currently the frontline of this battle for survival. The misery is further compounded by a massive displacement crisis. Since the dawn of 2026, more than 500,000 people have been forced from their homes, joining a vast population of internally displaced persons who have already exhausted their meager resources. A Perfect Storm Somalia’s current fragility is the result of a “perfect storm” of converging factors: Climate Collapse: Successive failed or significantly below-average rainy seasons have turned once-fertile lands into dust, decimating livestock and harvests. Persistent Conflict: Ongoing instability has crippled trade routes and hampered the ability of humanitarian agencies to reach those trapped in isolated enclaves. Economic Strain: Surging global commodity prices have rendered basic staples unaffordable for families already struggling with plummeting purchasing power. Public Health: Reduced access to clean water and sanitation has triggered localized disease outbreaks, which strike hardest at malnourished children and the elderly. As the international community watches, the focus shifts to whether this latest emergency funding can act as a sufficient firewall. For the 1.9 million people currently in emergency conditions, the next few weeks are not merely a calendar entry—they represent a desperate, daily struggle to outpace the threat of total collapse. items.title: The Rhetoric of “Civilizational Erasure”: Historical Distortion and Hyperbole in Contemporary Transatlantic Politics
items.description: By Buraale Xiniin Abstract This essay examines the growing intersection of right-wing populism, xenophobic rhetoric, and the manipulation of historical memory within the contemporary transatlantic alliance. Focusing on recent actions by European leaders, specifically the newly appointed Slovenian Prime Minister Janez Janša, and controversial rhetoric from high-ranking American officials like Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth and President Donald Trump, this essay explores how the weaponization of history serves to justify exclusionary immigration and foreign policies. By juxtaposing the symbolic removal of the Palestinian flag in Ljubljana with Hegseth’s 2026 D-Day anniversary speech, which compared migrant arrivals to the Allied invasion of Nazi-occupied Europe, this study analyzes the structural distortion of international law and human rights framework. It argues that while comparisons to a “Fourth Reich” may be hyperbole, the systemic dehumanization of global-south refugees and the uncritical defense of military occupation represent a profound fracturing of the post-WWII international order. Introduction: The Re-Writing of European Sovereignty The foundational mythos of the post-World War II liberal international order rests on two pillars: the absolute rejection of fascism and a professed commitment to universal human rights, enshrined in international humanitarian law. However, the contemporary geopolitical landscape reveals a stark fracturing of these ideals. The rise of nationalist, right-wing populist leaders across the United States and Europe has increasingly shifted the parameters of mainstream political discourse, normalizing rhetoric that historically belonged to the fringes of the far-right. This ideological realignment is characterized by a dual phenomenon: an obsession with demographic shifts, frequently framed through the lens of a migrant “invasion,” and a simultaneous erosion of solidarity with colonized or occupied populations. The immediate decision by Slovenia’s newly re-elected Prime Minister, Janez Janša, to order the removal of the Palestinian flag from government headquarters stands as an acute manifestation of this shift. This act, coupled with U.S. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth’s unprecedented deployment of anti-immigrant rhetoric during the 82nd anniversary of D-Day in Normandy, illustrates a dangerous convergence. Rather than viewing the refugee crisis as a direct consequence of decades of Western-led military interventions and asymmetric global wealth distribution, these leaders frame dispossessed migrants as an existential, civilizational threat. This essay interrogates the psychological and structural framework driving these policies, analyzing how the historical memory of liberating Europe from Nazism is being inverted to justify a new era of ethno-nationalist exclusion and the systematic bypass of international law. A- Symbolic Violence and Foreign Policy Pivot:  “The Slovenian Case “ In June 2026, within hours of assuming his fourth term as Prime Minister of Slovenia, Janez Janša ordered the immediate removal of the Palestinian flag from the main government building in Ljubljana. The flag had been hoisted under his predecessor, Robert Golob, whose administration had officially recognized Palestinian statehood in 2024 and vocalized intense criticism of Israeli military actions in Gaza, labeling them violations of international law. Janša’s swift reversal was not merely an administrative shift; it was a potent act of symbolic violence. From an academic perspective, Janša’s policy can be understood through the framework of ideological alignment with the Trump administration’s transactional foreign policy. By framing the removal of the flag as part of a “responsible” foreign policy “based on facts,” the Slovenian executive sought to delegitimize the humanitarian and legal obligations codified under the Geneva Conventions regarding occupied territories. The immediate diplomatic response, Israel’s announcement to open an embassy in Ljubljana, underscores the transactional nature of this governance style. The psychological underpinnings of such actions rely on a reductionist logic: the belief that complex, systemic crises can be solved by erasing the visual symbols of the oppressed. This “ostrich policy” assumes that by removing a flag, a state can insulated itself from the moral and legal implications of ongoing global conflicts. This ideological pivot is shared by a broader network of European right-wing leaders who treat international solidarity not as a legal obligation under the United Nations framework, but as an optional ideological ornament that can be discarded to signal loyalty to Western hegemony. B- Historical Inversion at Normandy:  The Weaponization of D-Day Perhaps the most glaring and dangerous manifestation of this ideological drift occurred on June 6, 2026, at the Normandy American Cemetery in Colleville-sur-Mer. Speaking on the 82nd anniversary of the Allied landings, the very operation that initiated the dismantling of Nazi totalitarianism, U.S. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth declared: “Sadly, today, different European beaches are stormed by different dangerous ideologies. Beaches in Spain, in Italy, in Greece, and Bulgaria, boats and men arrive. When will European capitals do something about that invasion, or is it too late?” This rhetorical maneuver represents a profound distortion of historical reality. The Normandy landings were a highly organized, heavily armed industrial military assault launched by sovereign nations to crush a genocidal fascist empire. To compare desperate, unarmed refugees fleeing conflict zones in rubber dinghies to the Allied forces of 1944 is a severe category error. The danger of this rhetoric lies in its pedagogical effect. By utilizing the sacred memory of D-Day, Hegseth explicitly reframed the victims of global instability as the perpetrators of a military invasion. This satisfies the criteria of what sociologist Stanley Cohen termed a “moral panic”, wherein a displaced group is cast as a folk devil threatening societal values. The relative silence or tepid pushback from mainstream Western media apparatuses regarding this speech indicates the degree to which dehumanizing frameworks have been normalized within transatlantic defense discourse. It suggests that the contemporary state apparatus is increasingly willing to abandon the very values of anti-fascism celebrated at Normandy in order to defend a fortified “Fortress Europe.” C- Causality and Decontextualization :  The Roots of Global Migration Central to the ideology of both the Trump administration and its European counterparts is a structural blindness to causality. The prevailing right-wing narrative treats mass migration as an unprovoked, spontaneous cultural assault on Western civilization, entirely disconnected from historical and contemporary Western foreign policy. In reality, the flows of refugees from the Middle East, North Africa, and South Asia are directly linked to decades of asymmetrical interventions, illegal wars, and economic destabilization orchestrated by the United States, NATO allies, and regional partners. The destruction of state infrastructures in Iraq, Libya, and Afghanistan, alongside the unchecked bombardment and displacement of populations in Gaza and Lebanon, has rendered vast swathes of the global South unlivable. The psychological coping mechanism of Western leadership requires a complete decoupling of action from consequence. To acknowledge that Western policy created the material conditions for the migration crisis would require an admission of systemic legal and moral accountability. Instead, these leaders engage in a collective amnesia, projecting the image of Western nations as innocent, pristine sanctuaries being arbitrarily invaded by populations who, prior to the destruction of their homes, had no inherent desire to leave their native lands. D- The Selective Application of International Law and the “Fourth Reich” Question. The starkest contradiction in contemporary international relations is the selective application, and blatant abandonment, of international humanitarian law. While Western powers frequently invoke the “rules-based international order” to sanction geopolitical adversaries, they offer near-total diplomatic, economic, and military immunity to allies like Israel, even amidst documented campaigns of ethnic cleansing, illegal settlement expansion, and the targeting of sovereign state infrastructures in Lebanon and Syria. T his systemic hypocrisy prompts the urgent question: “Are we witnessing the rise of a “Fourth Reich” in Europe?” While the historical specificity of Nazi Germany, characterized by total state-directed industrial genocide, totalitarian mobilization, and overt biological racism, differs from the fragmented, neoliberal populism of today, the structural parallels are deeply alarming. If a “Fourth Reich” is understood not as a literal carbon copy of the 1930s Nazi state, but as the emergence of a Western consensus that treats international law as a tool for the powerful and human rights as a selective privilege based on nationality and ethnicity, then the comparison gains analytical weight. When a superpower’s Defense Secretary can stand on the graves of anti-fascist soldiers to demand the militarized exclusion of refugees, and when European states willingly comply with policies that prioritize geopolitical alignment over the prevention of genocide, the moral framework that separated the post-war West from its fascist past faces a profound and dangerous collapse. Conclusion: The Crisis of Post-Colonial Compliance The tragedy of the current global crisis is compounded by the compliance of certain regional leaderships within the global south. Rather than forming independent, multipolar security and economic alliances, such as pursuing robust strategic agreements with rising global powers like China, or regional actors like Turkey and Pakistan, many leaders remain trapped within the paradigms of Western dependency. This compliance perpetuates a system of asymmetric sovereignty where global south nations are expected to endure bombardment, occupation, and economic deprivation, while simultaneously being barred from seeking safety or asserting diplomatic autonomy. Ultimately, the collective mental state and political philosophy of leaders like Trump, Hegseth, and Janša are not aberrations; they are the logical conclusion of a western-centric order that has refused to decolonize its conceptions of power and human value. The fixation on flags and borders is a desperate attempt to maintain hegemony through exclusion. If international law and human rights are to survive as meaningful concepts, they must be rescued from the selective custody of Western capitals and reasserted as universal truths that apply equally to the powerful and the dispossessed. Buraale Xiniin Email: eastafridac@gmail.com The post The Rhetoric of “Civilizational Erasure”: Historical Distortion and Hyperbole in Contemporary Transatlantic Politics appeared first on WardheerNews .

items.title: Muungaab oo furay imtixaan laga qaadayo 46,000 oo arday + Sawirro
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Guddoomiyaha Gobolka Banaadir ahna Duqa Muqdisho, Xasan Maxamed Xuseen (Muungaab), ayaa maanta daah-furay Imtixaanka Shahaadiga ah ee Dugsiyada Dhexe ee Gobolka Banaadir, kaas oo ay sanadkan u fariisteen in ka badan illaa 46,000 oo arday. Warsaxaafadeed kasoo baxay maamulka gobolka ayaa waxaa lagu sheegay in imtixaanka oo lagu galayo 125 xarumood oo ku kala yaalla degmooyinka gobolka Banaadir loo sameeyay diyaar-garow dhammaystiran oo lagu xaqiijinayo habsami-u-socodka imtixaanka, amniga xarumaha iyo ilaalinta tayada maamulka imtixaanaadka. Sidoo kale, imtixaanka sanadkan ayaa lagu daray adeegyo iyo duruufo u gaar ah dadka baahiyaha gaarka ah qaba, si’ loo xaqiijiyo helitaanka fursad loo siman yahay. Ugu horreyn munaasabadda daah-furka imtixaanka waxaa ka hadlay Agaasimaha Guud ee Agaasinka Waxbarashada Gobolka Banaadir, Mudane Cabdiraxmaan Cali Maxamed oo sheegay in ay si weyn ugu diyaar garoobeen imtixaanka, isla markaana ay diyaariyeen wax kasta oo ay u baahan yihiin ardayda. “Xarun kasta oo imtixaan lagu galayo waxaa la geeyay kooxo caafimaad, gaadiidka gurmadka degdegga ah iyo ciidamada dab-damiska, si loogu diyaargaroobo xaalad kasta oo soo derista inta uu socdo imtixaanka.” ayuu yiri, agaasime Cabdiraxmaan Cali Maxamed. Intaas kadib Duqa Magaalada Muqdisho oo hadalka qaatay aya ardayda guul u rajeeyay, isaga oo ballan qaaday in maamulka gobolka uu sanadkan sii wadi doono dhiirrigelinta iyo abaalmarinta ardayda kaalmaha hore ka gala imtixaanka, sida uu soo-jireenka ka dhigay sanadkii hore. Si kastaba, ha’ahaatee, Waxaa xusid mudan in sanadkan markii ugu horreysay ay imtixaanka ka qaybgalayaan arday muwaadiniin reer Suudaan ah oo waxbarasho ka dhigta magaalada Muqdisho, arrintaas oo muujinaysa kaalinta ay caasimaddu ka qaadanayso taageeridda waxbarashada iyo adeegyada bulshada ee walaalaha soo magansaday. Munaasabadda daah-furka imtixaanka waxaa goobjoog ka ahaa Guddoomiye Ku-xigeenka Arrimaha Bulshada Maamulka Gobolka Banaadir, Mudane Cabdicasiis Cismaan Maxamed, Taliyaha Qaybta Guud ee Booliska Gobolka Banaadir, Gaashaanle Sare Mahdi Cumar Muumin (Macallin Mahdi) iyo mas’uuliyiin kale oo ka tirsan Maamulka Gobolka Banaadir. The post Muungaab oo furay imtixaan laga qaadayo 46,000 oo arday + Sawirro appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: FIFA to pay Somali referee Omar Artan despite U.S. entry ban
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Somali referee Omar Artan will receive his full FIFA World Cup officiating fee despite being denied entry into the United States and missing football’s biggest tournament, according to sources familiar with the matter. The decision means Artan will receive the full fee attached to his FIFA World Cup appointment even though he was unable to officiate at the competition. Artan, widely regarded as one of Africa’s leading match officials, had been selected to officiate at the World Cup in what would have been a historic milestone for Somali football. His appointment was set to make him the first Somali referee to officiate at the sport’s most prestigious tournament. The opportunity ended abruptly when U.S. authorities denied him entry before the competition. The Trump administration said the decision was based on what it described as links to “suspected members of terror organizations.” Despite his absence from the tournament, FIFA has committed to paying Artan the full fee associated with his World Cup assignment. The episode attracted widespread attention across Somalia, where Artan’s rise from domestic football to the highest levels of international officiating has become a source of national pride. Named Africa’s Referee of the Year in 2025, Artan has built a reputation as one of the continent’s most respected officials. His selection for the World Cup was viewed as a landmark achievement not only for his career but also for Somali football, which has long sought greater representation on the global stage. News of his exclusion from the tournament sparked disappointment among many Somalis, who had hoped to see one of their own participate in football’s premier event. Yet the setback has done little to slow his ascent within the game. In a major boost to his international standing, UEFA has appointed Artan to officiate the UEFA Super Cup in August between Paris Saint-Germain and Aston Villa. The annual match, which pits the winners of Europe’s two major club competitions against each other, is among the continent’s most prestigious officiating assignments. The appointment is widely seen as a strong endorsement of Artan’s abilities and professionalism, reinforcing his status among football’s elite referees despite the controversy surrounding his World Cup absence. For many observers, the UEFA assignment marks a remarkable turnaround. A referee who was unable to take part in the World Cup will now oversee one of the biggest fixtures in European football just weeks later. Artan returned to Somalia to a warm welcome from supporters , sports officials and members of the public, many of whom hailed him as a trailblazer for a new generation of Somali athletes and officials seeking international recognition. His journey from Somali football to the global stage continues to resonate across the Horn of Africa, where his achievements are viewed as evidence that talent from Somalia can compete and excel at the highest levels of world sport. As preparations begin for the UEFA Super Cup, attention is once again focused on Omar Artan – not because of the opportunity he missed at the FIFA World Cup, but because of the historic role he is set to play in the next chapter of his career. Contact us: info@somaliguardian.com

items.title: Iran iyo Mareykanka oo gaaray heshiis cusub
items.description: Dowladaha Mareykanka iyo Iran ayaa gaaray heshiis qabyo, kaas oo lagu soo afjarayo dagaalka Bariga Dhexe, oo ay ku jirto xabad joojin laga sameeyo Lubnaan. Raysal Wasaaraha Pakistan, Shehbaz Sharif ayaa sheegay in labada dal ay gaareen heshiis nabadeed, oo lagu soo afjarayo buu yiri howlaha militari ee dhinac walba ah, oo ay qayb ka tahay Lubnaan. Heshiiska ayaa waxaa ku jira in la qaado cunaqabateynta caalamiga ah ee muddada dheer saaran Iran iyo dib-u-furista marin biyoodka Hormuz, oo ku xirmay duulaankii Mareykanka iyo Israel ay 28-kii bishii February ku qaadeen dalkaasi. items.title: Wax ka Ogaw Qodobada Ku Jira Is-afgaradka Mareykanka iyo Iiraan
items.description: Wakaaladda wararka ee Reuters ayaa soo xigatay sarkaal sare oo Iiraani ah, kaas oo sheegay in nuqulka ugu dambeeya ee heshiis is-afgarad ah oo ay ka wada xaajoonayaan Mareykanka iyo Iiraan uu ka kooban yahay qodobbo dhowr ah oo la xiriira arrimaha nukliyeerka, cunaqabataymaha iyo amniga marin-biyoodka gobolka. Sida xogta la baahiyay lagu sheegay, Iiraan ayaa oggolaaneysa inay si degdeg ah dib ugu furto marin-biyoodka Hormuz dhammaan maraakiibta ganacsiga, halka Mareykankuna uu bilaabi doono qaadista go’doominta dhinaca badda ee dekedaha Iiraan, iyadoo tallaabadaasi ay dhaqan geli doonto marka la saxiixo heshiiska is-afgaradka, isla markaana si buuxda loogu dhammeystiri doono muddo 30 maalmood gudahood ah. Qoraalka la sheegay ayaa sidoo kale tilmaamaya in Iiraan ay aqbali doonto inaanay soo saarin ama haysan hub nukliyeer ah, ayadoo inta laga gaarayo heshiis kama dambeys ahna, Tehran ay ilaalin doonto xaaladda hadda jirta ee barnaamijkeeda nukliyeerka, iyadoo ka fogaan doonta kobcinta uranium-ka iyo ballaarinta xarumaha nukliyeerka. Dhanka kale, Mareykanka ayaa la sheegay inuu oggolaanayo in mustaqbalka laga wada xaajoodo qaab lagu dhimayo kaydka uranium-ka aadka loo kobciyay ee Iiraan ku jira, taas oo qayb ka noqon doonta heshiis dhammaystiran oo dambe. Labada dhinac ayaa lagu wadaa inay muddo 60 maalmood gudahood ah ku dhammeystiraan wada-xaajoodyada la xiriira barnaamijka nukliyeerka iyo hawlaha kobcinta uranium-ka, iyadoo qodobadaasi lagu dari doono heshiiska kama dambaysta ah. Warbixintu waxay sidoo kale sheegtay in Mareykanku uu ka waantoobi doono saarista cunaqabatayn cusub inta ay wadaxaajoodyadu socdaan,haddii heshiis rasmi ah la gaarona, waxaa si tartiib tartiib ah loo qaadi doonaa dhammaan cunaqabataymaha ay Mareykanka iyo Qaramada Midoobay saareen Iiraan, iyadoo lagu salaynayo jadwal ay labada dhinac ku heshiiyaan. Qodobada kale ee la xusay waxaa ka mid ah in Mareykanku muddo cayiman ka qaadi doono Iiraan cunaqabataymaha dhinaca saliidda, taas oo u oggolaanaysa Tehran inay dhoofiso saliiddeeda isla markaana hesho dakhliga ka soo xarooda, ayadoo Sidoo kale, Mareykanka lagu wadaa inuu sii daayo hanti Iiraani ah oo la xayiray, taas oo lagu qiyaasay 25 bilyan oo doollar. Ilaa hadda ma jiraan warar rasmi ah oo ka soo baxay Washington ama Tehran oo si buuxda u xaqiijinaya qodobadan, hase yeeshee warbixinta Reuters ayaa muujinaysa in dadaallo diblomaasiyadeed oo xooggan ay socdaan si loo gaaro heshiis cusub oo dhex mara labada dal.

Hay’adda Isgaarsiinta Qaranka oo Qabatay Shirweynaha Labaad ee Garaad Gacmeedka Soomaaliya
items.description: Hay’adda Isgaarsiinta Qaranka oo Qabatay Shirweynaha Labaad ee Garaad Gacmeedka Soomaaliya Muqdisho, Soomaaliya – 14 Juun 2026 – Hay’adda Isgaarsiinta Qaranka (HIQ) ayaa maanta qabatay Shirweynaha Labaad ee Garaad Gacmeedka Soomaaliya (The AI Summit Somalia 2026), oo ah madal heer qaran ah oo lagu gorfeynayo doorka Garaad Gacmeedku (Artificial Intelligence – AI) ku yeelan karo horumarinta adeegyada bulshada, kobcinta hal-abuurka, dardargelinta isbeddelka dhijitaalka ah, iyo horumarka dhaqan-dhaqaale ee Soomaaliya. Shirkan oo soconaya muddo laba maalmood ah ayaa waxaa soo qabanqaabisay Hay’adda Isgaarsiinta Qaranka (HIQ), iyadoo kaashanaysa Bulshada Garaad Gacmeedka Soomaaliya (AI Somalia Community), isla markaana si dhow ula shaqeysay Jaamacadda Zamzam iyo Jaamacadda Ummadda Soomaaliyeed (SNU), kuwaas oo si wadajir ah qeyb uga ahaa qabanqaabada shirkan. Shirweynaha ayaa waxaa si rasmi ah u furay Mudane Faarax Sheekh Cabdulqaadir Maxamed, Wasiirka Wasaaradda Waxbarashada, Hiddaha iyo Tacliinta Sare ee Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, kaas oo khudbaddiisa ku xusay muhiimadda ay leedahay in Soomaaliya ay si istaraatiiji ah uga faa’iidaysato fursadaha uu bixinayo Garaad Gacmeedka si loo horumariyo waxbarashada, cilmi-baarista, hal-abuurka, iyo koboca dhaqaalaha aqoonta ku dhisan. Munaasabadda furitaanka waxaa sidoo kale khudbado ka jeediyay Dr. Maxamuud Maxamed Xasan (Harbi), Guddoomiyaha Jaamacadda Zamzam ee Culuumta iyo Teknoolojiyadda; Prof. Dr. Maxamed Maxamuud Maxamed, Guddoomiyaha Jaamacadda Ummadda Soomaaliyeed; Mudane Mustafa Yaasiin Sheekh, Maareeyaha Guud ee Hay’adda Isgaarsiinta Qaranka; iyo Mudane Axmed Ismaaciil Diiriye, Wasiiru Dowlaha Wasaaradda Isgaarsiinta iyo Teknoolojiyadda ee Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, kuwaas oo si gaar ah u iftiimiyay fursadaha iyo muhiimadda uu Garaad Gacmeedku u leeyahay horumarka iyo mustaqbalka Soomaaliya. Shirka waxaa goobjoog ka ahaa masuuliyiin ka socday Dowladda, jaamacadaha iyo xarumaha tacliinta sare, cilmi-baarayaal, khubaro teknoolojiyadeed, hal-abuurayaal, ganacsato, ururrada bulshada rayidka ah, arday, iyo daneeyayaal kale oo ka kala yimid qaybaha kala duwan ee bulshada. Labada maalmood ee shirku socdo waxaa lagu falanqeynayaa maamulka iyo nidaaminta Garaad Gacmeedka, iyo sidoo kale doorka uu ku leeyahay horumarinta adeegyada dowladda, waxbarashada, caafimaadka, beeraha, amniga saaybarka, ilaalinta xogta, xuquuqda dhijitaalka ah, Garaad Gacmeedka Af-Soomaaliga, hal-abuurka, iyo dhaqaalaha dhijitaalka ah. Shirweynahan ayaa ujeeddadiisu tahay in la abuuro madal mideysa dowladda, bahda tacliinta sare, cilmi-baarayaasha, ardeyda, hal-abuurayaasha, shirkadaha gaarka loo leeyahay si loo dhiirrigeliyo wada-shaqeyn wax ku ool ah iyo xalal ku dhisan Garaad Gacmeed oo ka jawaaba baahiyaha dhabta ah ee Soomaaliya. Shirkan waxaa taageeraya oo maalgeliyey Bangiga Adduunka (World Bank Group) iyada oo loo marayo Mashruuca SCALE-UP. The post Hay’adda Isgaarsiinta Qaranka oo Qabatay Shirweynaha Labaad ee Garaad Gacmeedka Soomaaliya first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Ciidanka Danab oo Howlgal Ka Fuliyay Kurtunwaarey
items.description: Muqdisho, 14 Juun 2026 – Ciidanka Kumaandooska Danab ee Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed ayaa howlgal qorsheysan ka fuliyay degmada Kurtunwaarey ee gobolka Shabeellaha Hoose, sida lagu sheegay war-saxaafadeed ay soo saartay Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga. Howlgalka ayaa lagu bartilmaameedsaday xubno ka tirsan Al-Shabaab oo ku sugnaa fariisimo ay ku lahaayeen deegaanka. Dowladda ayaa sheegtay in intii uu socday howlgalka la dilay 14 dagaalyahan oo ka tirsanaa kooxdaasi. Sidoo kale, ciidamadu waxay burburiyeen goobo lagu keydin jiray hub, walxaha qarxa iyo agab kale oo sida warbixintu xustay loo adeegsan jiray qorsheynta iyo fulinta weerarro ka dhan ah shacabka Soomaaliyeed. Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga ayaa sheegtay in howlgalka uu qayb ka yahay dadaallada joogtada ah ee lagu wiiqayo awoodda Al-Shabaab, laguna xoojinayo amniga iyo xasilloonida deegaannada laga saaray kooxda. Dowladdu waxay mar kale xaqiijisay inay sii wadi doonto howlgallada ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab ilaa laga ciribtiro khatarta ay ku hayaan shacabka iyo dowladda Soomaaliya.

items.title: Xasan oo maalgashadayaal waa wayn ku qaabilay Madaxtooyada + Sawirro
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa galabta Xarunta Madaxtooyada Qaranka ku qaabilay wafdi ganacsato iyo maalgashadayaal ah oo ka socday dalka Talyaaniga, kuwaasi oo soo gaaray magaalada Muqdisho. Xubnahah ayaa caasimada uga qayb galay shir ku saabsanaa iskaashiga ganacsiga iyo maalgashiga u dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Talyaaniga, kadibna waxaa maanta si weyn Madaxtooyada ugu soo dhaweeyay Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud. Sidoo kale waxaa kulan ay yeesheen labada dhinac goobjoog ahaa Danjiraha dowladda Talyaaniga ee Soomaaliya, kaas oo diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta xiriirka dhaqaale iyo kobcinta iskaashiga ganacsi ee labada dal, iyada oo wafdiga Talyaaniga ay ka mid ahaayeen maamulayaasha shirkado ganacsi, warshado waaweyn iyo maalqabeenno daneynaya in ay ka faa’iideystaan fursadaha maalgashi ee ka jira Soomaaliya. Madaxweynaha oo ganacsatada ku boggaadiyey booqashadooda Muqdisho ayaa tilmaamay in Soomaaliya ay maanta ku tallaabsanayso isbeddel ballaaran oo dhanka amniga, dib u dhiska dhaqaalaha iyo abuurista jawi dhiirrigelinaya maalgashiga caalamiga ah. items.title: FIFA to pay Somali referee full World Cup fee after US entry denial
items.description: Somali referee Omar Abdulkadir Artan, who was denied entry to the US to officiate at the 2026 FIFA World Cup, will still receive his full tournament fee, multiple sources reported. FIFA has committed to paying Artan’s full salary for the tournament, even though he will take no part in the competition. Referees selected for the World Cup do not know the exact fee they will receive, as payment is made after the tournament ends. Artan, 34, was selected by FIFA to officiate at the World Cup, becoming the first Somali referee appointed for the tournament. He was questioned for 11 hours by US immigration authorities at Miami International Airport on Monday before being told he would not be allowed to enter the country. His diplomatic passport and single-entry US visa were rejected. After being placed on a flight to Türkiye, Artan received assistance from FIFA officials in Istanbul before traveling on to the Somali capital Mogadishu. A US government official said Artan was denied entry because of an alleged “association with suspected members of terror organizations.” Artan said he was questioned by border officials about alleged links to the Somali militant group Al-Shabaab, but told them he knew nothing about the organization. “I had the right papers and everything. I had the right visa,” Artan was quoted as saying. “I’m just simply a referee who’s trying to live his dream, the biggest dream of my life, to come to the World Cup,” he added. Anadolu.

items.title: Ciidamada Danab oo Shabaab badan ku laayay Kurtunwaarey
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Ciidamada sida gaarka ah u tababaran ee Kumaandooska Danab ayaa maanta howlgal culus ka fuliyay degmada Kurtunwaarey ee gobolka Shabeellaha Hoose, kaas oo lagu beegsaday maleeshiyaad ka tirsan kooxda Al-Shabaab. Warsaxaafadeed kasoo baxay Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya ayaa waxaa lagu sheegay in howlgalka lagu beegsaday goob ay ku sugnaayeen horjoogayaal iyo maleeshiyaad ka tirsan Khawaarijta, isla markaana khasaare culus la gaarsiiyay. Sida lagu caddeeyay bayaanka waxaa goobta lagu dilay ugu yaraan illaa 14 dhagarqabe, isla markaana uu howlgalka uu u dhacay sidii loo qorsheeyay. “Ciidanka Kumaandooska Danab ee Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed ayaa howlgal lagu bartilmaameedsaday maleeshiyaadka Khawaarijta ka fuliyay degmada Kurtunwaarey ee gobolka Shabeellaha Hoose. Howlgalka ayaa lagu beegsaday goobo ay ku sugnaayeen horjoogayaal iyo maleeshiyaad ka tirsan Khawaarijta Al-Shabaab. Intii uu socday howlgalka, waxaa lagu dilay 14 dhagarqabe oo ka tirsanaa Khawaarijta”. ayaa lagu yiri warsaxaafadeedka.   Sidoo kal, Ciidanka ayaa inta uu socday howlgalka burburiyay kayd hub, walxaha qarxa iyo agab kale oo Shabaab u adeegsan jirtay diyaarinta iyo fulinta falalka argagixisanimo ee lagu dhibaateeyo shacabka Soomaaliyeed. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in howlgalkan lagu naafeeyay argagixisada uu qayb ka yahay dadaallada lagu doonayo in dalka oo dhan looga xoreeyo, isla markaana uu sii socon doono. “Howlgalkan ayaa qayb ka ah dadaallada joogtada ah ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed ay ugu jiraan ciribtirka Khawaarijta, kuwaas oo ku caan baxay cabburinta shacabka, dhaca hantidooda iyo falalka amni-darrada ah ee ay ka geystaan deegaannada dalka,” ayaa mar kale lagu yiri qoraalka Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya. Waxaa kale oo lagu sii daray “Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga iyo Taliska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed waxaa ka go’an sii wadidda howlgalada lagu xaqiijinayo amniga, xasilloonida iyo nabadda dalka”. Si kastaba, Muddooyinkii ugu dambeeyay ciidamada dowladda iyo kuwa deegaanka ayaa xoojiyay howlgalllada lagu beegsanayo Al-Shabaab ee ka socda koonfurta iyo bartamaha Soomaaliya. The post Ciidamada Danab oo Shabaab badan ku laayay Kurtunwaarey appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: National Communications Authority Holds the Second AI Summit Somalia 2026
items.description: Mogadishu, Somalia – 14 June 2026 – The National Communications Authority (NCA) today convened the Second AI Summit Somalia 2026, a national platform dedicated to exploring the role of artificial intelligence (AI) in advancing public service delivery, fostering innovation, accelerating digital transformation, and driving Somalia’s socio-economic development. The two-day summit is organized by the National Communications Authority (NCA) in collaboration with the AI Somalia Community and in close coordination with the Zamzam University of Science and Technology (ZUST) and the Somali National University (SNU), both of which have jointly contributed to organizing the event. The summit was officially inaugurated by H.E. Farah Sheikh Abdulkadir Mohamed, minister of education, culture, and higher education of the Federal Government of Somalia, who underscored the importance of strategically harnessing the opportunities presented by artificial intelligence to strengthen education, research, innovation, and the country’s knowledge-based economy. The opening ceremony also featured remarks from Dr. Mohamud Mohamed Hassan (Harbi), Rector of Zamzam University of Science and Technology; Prof. Dr. Mohamed Mohamud Mohamed, Rector of the Somali National University; Mr. Mustafa Yasin Sheikh, Director General of the National Communications Authority; and H.E. Ahmed Ismail Dirie, State Minister of the Ministry of Communications and Technology, all of whom highlighted the opportunities and significance of artificial intelligence in shaping Somalia’s future and advancing national development. The summit was attended by senior officials from the Federal Government of Somalia, heads of government institutions, representatives of universities and other higher education institutions, researchers, technology experts, innovators, entrepreneurs, civil society organizations, students, and other stakeholders. Throughout the two-day summit, participants will engage in discussions on AI governance and regulation, the application of AI across public services, education, healthcare, agriculture, cybersecurity, data protection, digital rights, Somali-language AI, innovation, and the digital economy. The summit aims to provide a collaborative platform that brings together government institutions, academia, researchers, innovators, the private sector, and development partners to promote practical, AI-driven solutions that address Somalia’s development priorities and support inclusive, sustainable growth. The summit is supported by the World Bank Group through the SCALE-UP Project. The post National Communications Authority Holds the Second AI Summit Somalia 2026 first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Another Foreign Police Unit Arrives Under AUSSOM as Somalia’s Greatest Threat Shifts from Security to Politics
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) – At a time when Somalia is grappling with one of its most serious political crises in recent years, the arrival of another foreign police contingent under the African Union mission has raised fresh questions about the effectiveness of international stabilization efforts that have now spanned nearly two decades. The African Union Support and Stabilization Mission in Somalia (AUSSOM) formally welcomed a new Ghanaian police contingent, known as GFPU-5, which has been deployed to Mogadishu, Baidoa, and Beledweyne to support the Somali Police Force. According to AUSSOM, the unit will participate in joint security operations, specialized training programs, and advisory initiatives aimed at strengthening the capacity of Somali police institutions. The Ghanaian contingent replaces the outgoing GFPU-4 unit, which completed its deployment after working alongside Somali security forces. On paper, the deployment appears routine. In reality, however, it arrives of a country facing profound political uncertainty, constitutional disputes, and growing concerns over state legitimacy. For many observers, the question is becoming increasingly difficult to ignore: What difference can another foreign police unit make when Somalia’s crisis is no longer primarily a security problem, but a political one? Mogadishu today is not merely confronting threats from insurgents. The capital has become the center of an escalating confrontation over constitutional amendments, election models, power-sharing arrangements, and the future structure of the Somali state. Opposition leaders continue to challenge the federal government’s political direction, while disputes over electoral processes and constitutional changes have created deep divisions between Villa Somalia and key political stakeholders. Somalia’s most urgent challenge is not the absence of foreign security advisers or additional police trainers. Rather, they contend that the country lacks a broad political consensus capable of restoring confidence in state institutions and preventing further fragmentation. The arrival of the Ghanaian unit has therefore generated a degree of skepticism among many Somalis and political analysts. For nearly twenty years, Somalia has hosted multiple international military and police missions under different names and mandates—from African Union Mission in Somalia (AMISOM) to African Union Transition Mission in Somalia (ATMIS) and now AUSSOM. Thousands of foreign troops, police officers, advisers, trainers, and consultants have rotated through the country. Yet despite these efforts, Somalia remains mired in recurring political crises. Supporters of the mission argue that foreign police units continue to play a vital role in professionalizing Somali security institutions and preventing a complete collapse of public order. They point to training programs, mentoring initiatives, and operational support as important contributions to long-term stability. However, critics counter that no amount of police training can resolve disputes over governance, constitutional legitimacy, or political power. “Security forces can maintain order,” one political observer noted, “but they cannot manufacture political consensus.” Indeed, the challenge facing Somalia today appears far more complex than the traditional security threats that originally justified large-scale international intervention. The country’s political elite remain sharply divided over the constitutional framework, electoral arrangements, and the balance of power between the federal government and regional administrations. These disagreements have repeatedly stalled national reconciliation efforts and fueled cycles of political confrontation. Against this backdrop, the deployment of another foreign police contingent risks appearing less like a solution and more like a reminder of how long Somalia’s stabilization project has remained unfinished. AUSSOM Police Coordinator ACP Dr. Samuel Asiedu Okanta urged the newly deployed officers to uphold the highest standards of professionalism and conduct while supporting Somalia’s peace and stabilization efforts. Yet the broader reality remains difficult to escape. While international missions continue to rotate personnel and renew mandates, Somalia’s underlying political disputes remain unresolved. Foreign police officers can train, mentor, and advise. They can help secure installations and support law enforcement operations. What they cannot do is negotiate political compromises, rebuild trust between rival factions, or resolve disputes over legitimacy and governance. As Somalia enters another uncertain chapter, many citizens are increasingly asking whether the country needs more foreign security deployments—or a genuine political settlement capable of addressing the root causes of instability. Until that question is answered, the arrival of each new contingent may serve as a symbol not only of international commitment, but also of how elusive a lasting political solution has become. items.title: Axmed Madoobe oo u jawaabay Xasan: Wardhiigley ma aha dowladnimada Soomaaliya
items.description: Kismaayo (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Jubbaland Axmed Maxamed Islaam (Axmed Madoobe) oo maanta la hadlayay ciidamo uu tababar usoo xiray ayaa soonhadal qaaday xaaladda siyaasadeed ee dalka, isaga oo si kulul ugu jawaabay Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud oo maalmo ku celiyay in dowladdiisa aysan Madaxweyne uu aqoonsaneyn Axmed Madoobe. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo wareysi siiyay Barnaamijka Miisaan Prodkast ee Dawan ayaa intaas ku daray in Axmed Madoobe markii uu dhawaan imaanayay Muqdisho uu ku yimid xubin ka tirsan Golaha Mustaqbalka oo ay ku mideysan yihiin mucaaradka, Jubbaland iyo Puntland. Intaas kadib waxaa soo jawaabay Axmed Madoobe oo shaaca ka qaaday in aanu aqoonsi uga baahneyn dowladda dhexe, isla markaana go’aanka ay leeyihiin dadka reer Jubbaland, sida uu hadalka u dhigay. “Maalin dhawayd waxaan dhageysanayay Xasan oo leh ma aqoonsani doorashada State-ka ka dhaceyso waa mid reer Jubbaland ay aqoonsi uga baahantahay dadkeeda ayaana iska leh wax sharciyad ah oo dowladda dhexe kaga xiran ma jirto,” ayuu ku jawaabay Axmed Madoobe. Sidoo kale, wuxuu weerar afka ah ku qaaday Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud oo uu tilmaamay inuu isku koobay awoodda, wuxuuna carrabka ku dhuftay in dowladnimada Soomaaliya aysan ku ekeyn degmada Wardhiigleey oo ay ku taallo Madaxtooyada Qaranka. “Dib gogosha haloogu soo noqdo talada dhulka hala dhigo korbaan u haynayaa Soomaaliya halka ay gaarsiisay waan ogsoonahay intaas oo sano ayaanu dagaal sokeeye ku jirnay Wardhiigley ma aha dowladnimada Soomaaliya haddii uu qofka u arkaa in xaafadda uu joogaa ay u noqoneyso dowladnimada Soomaaliya oo xukunka uu yahay xaafaddaa uu joogo sax ma noqonayso,” ayuu markale yiri Axmed. Waxaa kale oo uu ugu baaqay Madaxweynaha inuu talada dhexda soo dhigo, uuna dib umba qaado wada-hadallada xalka looga gaarayo hannaanka doorashooyinka, maadaama uu dhammaaday muddo xileedka hay’adaha dowladda. “Maanta dolwaddda xilligeeda dhammaaday iyo Xasan Sheekh oo term-kii labaad maraya oo nin da’ah waxaad moodaa in wixii oo dhan uu iska indha tiray, uuna ka shaqeynayonwax taariikhda bog madow kaga tagi doono, waxaan oran lahaa war Xasanow dib u xasuuso Soomaaliya meesha ay soo martay iyo xaaladda maanta meesha ay taagan tahay,” ayuu sii raaciyey Madaxweynaha Jubbaland. Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo Jubbaland ayaa waxaa weli ka dhexeeya khilaaf xoogan oo daba dheeraaday, kaas oo saameeyay wada shaqeynta labada dhinac, kadib markii uu meesha ka baxay xiriirkii Muqdisho iyo Kismaayo. items.title: Elite Haramcad Unit Accused of Rampaging Through Baidoa
items.description: Baidoa (WDN) – In yet another episode highlighting the chronic dysfunction that continues to plague Somalia’s security institutions, reports emerging from Baidoa suggest that members of the elite Haramcad Police Unit, one of the country’s most heavily armed and specially trained forces have turned their frustrations inward after allegedly going unpaid for months. According to local sources, a group of disgruntled officers staged a mutiny-like protest that quickly escalated into scenes described by residents as disorderly and intimidating, raising fresh concerns about the consequences of deploying security forces without ensuring they receive their salaries. Witnesses reported that armed officers entered several restaurants and businesses across parts of Baidoa, creating panic among residents and business owners. While conflicting accounts remain regarding whether any actual looting occurred, the mere sight of heavily armed security personnel storming commercial establishments was enough to send a chilling message throughout the city. The incident has exposed a troubling paradox at the heart of Somalia’s security sector. For years, millions of dollars have been spent by international partners on training, equipping, and professionalizing specialized units such as Haramcad. These forces have often been showcased as symbols of a modern Somali security apparatus capable of confronting terrorism and maintaining public order. Yet critics argue that even the most sophisticated training cannot compensate for a simpler reality: soldiers and police officers who are not paid eventually become security risks themselves. Residents expressed disbelief that a unit specifically trained to combat crime and protect civilians would find itself accused of behavior that many described as resembling the very lawlessness it was created to prevent. The situation has also revived longstanding questions about the management of security-sector finances. Government officials routinely announce new security initiatives, operational successes, and donor-supported programs. However, rank-and-file officers across multiple branches of the security forces have repeatedly complained about delayed salaries, unpaid allowances, and poor living conditions. Observers note that when elite forces begin protesting over wages, the problem can no longer be dismissed as an isolated administrative oversight. “It is difficult to ask officers to uphold discipline when the system responsible for paying them appears unable to uphold its own obligations,” one local analyst told WardheerNews. Perhaps the most ironic aspect of the incident is that Haramcad officers are among the country’s most respected and extensively trained personnel. Yet, according to reports, even these highly regarded units are not immune from the frustrations caused by salary delays. The Bay Regional Police Command is expected to issue an official statement regarding the incident and determine whether disciplinary measures will be taken against those involved. Until then, many residents are left wondering how a government struggling to pay its own security forces expects those same forces to guarantee law, order, and public confidence. After all, maintaining security requires more than uniforms, weapons, and training. It also requires something far less glamorous but equally essential: paying the people entrusted with carrying them.
