items.title: Muqdisho: Haweeney uu gubay ninkeeda oo geeriyootay
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Safiyo Cali oo ahayd hooyo dhashay 11 carruur ah ayaa maanta ku geeriyootay isbitaal ku yaalla magaalada Muqdisho, kadib dhaawacyo culus oo ka soo gaaray dab la sheegay in ninkeeda uu ku gubay habeenkii Arbacada. Marxuumadda ayaa la sheegay in lagu gubay gurigeeda oo ku yaalla xaafadda Suuqa Xoolaha ee degmada Heliwaa, iyadoo falkaas uu geystay ninkeeda oo lagu magacaabo Sayid Cumar, sida ay sheegeen ehelada qoyska. Ehelada Safiyo Cali ayaa u sheegay warbaahinta in marxuumaddu saacadihii la soo dhaafay la tacaalaysay dhaawacyo halis ah oo ka soo gaaray gubashada, hase yeeshee ay ugu dambeyn maanta u geeriyootay dhaawacyadaas. Wararka ayaa intaas ku daraya in Safiyo Cali iyo Sayid Cumar ay maalmihii la soo dhaafay ka dhex taagnayd muran iyo khilaaf qoys, ka hor inta uusan dhicin falka sababay geerida Safiyo. Sidoo kale, waxaa la xaqiijiyey in eedeysanaha lagu magacaabo Sayid Cumar uu ka baxsaday magaalada Muqdisho kadib markii uu geystay falkaas, iyadoo aan weli la ogeyn halka uu ku sugan yahay. Ehelada marxuumadda ayaa sheegay inay aad uga naxeen dhacdadan, isla markaana ay doonayaan in caddaaladda la horkeeno ninka lagu eedeeyay dilka Safiyo Cali, si loogu qaado tallaabo sharci ah. Si kastaba, qoyska marxuumadda ayaa sheegay inay aasi doonaan gabadhooda, iyagoo si cad u diiday inay qaataan wax mag ama diyo ah, waxayna ku adkaysteen in waxa kaliya ee ay doonayaan ay tahay in sharciga la marsiiyo eedeysanaha loo haysto falkan naxdinta leh. The post Muqdisho: Haweeney uu gubay ninkeeda oo geeriyootay appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Mogadishu escapes another night of bloodshed as government troops pull back from opposition area
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Somalia’s capital Mogadishu was pushed to the brink of renewed confrontation on Wednesday night after the federal government deployed heavily armed security forces to a neighborhood near Mogadishu’s international airport where opposition leaders reside, triggering fears of another outbreak of violence. The deployment in the Bulo Hubey neighborhood saw federal troops surround the residences of opposition figures, restricting movement in the area. Opposition figures said the operation appeared to be aimed at launching an overnight attack on their homes, raising concerns that the situation could escalate into another deadly confrontation. The security developments were accompanied by reports circulating on social media that telecommunications services, including electricity and internet connectivity, could be disrupted after midnight. Telecommunications giant Hormuud informed customers that technical issues could affect services before later denying reports that electricity and internet access would be cut off. The company said both services would continue operating normally. Hormuud’s clarification came after the federal government withdrew its forces from the Bulo Hubey area following mounting pressure, including efforts by the acting US ambassador in Mogadishu to ease tensions. By Wednesday evening, most troops had pulled back from the neighborhood, preventing what many feared could become a repeat of last week’s deadly clashes between government forces and opposition groups. Some residents fled the area earlier in the day, fearing that the military deployment could trigger clashes and leave civilians trapped in possible crossfire. Former deputy mayor of Mogadishu Ali Yare Ali said President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud had given direct orders to security forces to kill or arrest former President Sharif Sheikh Ahmed, whose forces clashed with government troops last week in Mogadishu. The confrontation lasted for two days before intervention from Western partners helped bring an end to the fighting, with diplomats based in the Halane area working to restore calm in the capital. The latest tensions come days after Somalia’s federal government announced it had begun disarming opposition figures and conducting large-scale house-to-house search operations in Abdiasis district, an area believed to be home to many opposition supporters and figures. During the operations, the government displayed weapons to the media that it said belonged to opposition figures and were being illegally used to undermine security. Authorities later presented weapons found at an upscale hotel near Liido Beach in Mogadishu, claiming they were connected to the opposition. However, the hotel owner and opposition figures rejected the government’s claims, describing the move as a public relations campaign intended to mislead residents in the capital. The developments have deepened political tensions in Mogadishu, where concerns remain high over the possibility of further clashes between the federal government and opposition forces following last week’s violence. items.title: Somali referee banned by US to officiate European Super Cup, UEFA says
items.description: Somali referee Omar Artan, who was denied entry to the United States for the World Cup, has been named to officiate UEFA’s Super Cup, European football’s governing body announced. UEFA President Aleksander Ceferin poured praise on the Somali referee in a statement released on Thursday, a few hours before global body FIFA’s flagship World Cup kicks off. “Omar Artan is an excellent young but already experienced referee, who has proven himself at the highest competition level of the Confederation of African Football,” said Ceferin. “Football is made to connect people, and UEFA wants to show its respect to Omar and his outstanding officiating skills, which had earned him such a prestigious nomination.” UEFA said that after talks with the African confederation, it “has today appointed Somali referee Omar Artan to officiate the 2026 UEFA Super Cup” on August 12 in Salzburg, Austria, between Champions League winners Paris Saint-Germain and Europa League winners Aston Villa. Artan’s case has been one of many incidents to taint the run-up to FIFA’s World Cup. UEFA said Artan’s appointment came in the framework of an accord between UEFA and CAF to encourage cooperation. “UEFA and CAF are united by a shared commitment to developing football at all levels and promoting the core values of unity, equality and non-discrimination,” it said. CAF President Patrice Motsepe said Artan had “made Somalia and the entire people of the African continent extremely proud”. “His receipt of the CAF men’s referee of the year award 2025 and his appointment as a referee of the FIFA World Cup 2026 are a recognition of his world-class refereeing ability and the international respect that he enjoys.” His appointment to referee the Super Cup “is a great honour for Omar Artan and for African referees and is also an excellent example of football, bringing together and uniting people from Africa and Europe and worldwide”, Motsepe said. Artan was barred from entering the US on Saturday after arriving at Miami International Airport. A US State Department official told the AFP news agency that the referee was “associated with suspected members of terrorist organisations”, therefore “making the traveller ineligible for admission to the United States”. FIFA also confirmed that he would no longer be part of the World Cup. Artan’s appointment to the 52-strong roster of referees for the finals in Canada, Mexico and the US had been a huge source of pride for his compatriots. He returned to a hero’s welcome in Mogadishu on Wednesday and pledged to take part in the next World Cup in 2030. AFP.

items.title: Musharax Galmudug Liban Axmed oo $50,000 ku wareejiyay garsoore Cumar Artan
items.description: Musharax Galmudug oo $50,000 ku wareejiyay garsoore Cumar Artan Muqdisho, 11 Juun 2026 – Musharax Madaxweynaha Dowlad Goboleedka Galmudug, Liban Axmed Xasan, ayaa $50,000 oo doolar Mareykan ah ku deeqay garsooraha caanka ah ee Soomaaliyeed, Cumar Cabdulqaadir Artan, ka dib markii uu ka haray inuu ka qayb qaato Koobka Adduunka ee 2026 ka dib markii laga diiday inuu galo Maraykanka. Ku-deeqa ayaa ku soo beegantay iyadoo Artan, oo 34 jir ah, loo aqoonsaday garsoorihii ugu fiicanaa Afrika 2025-kii, uu si weyn uga xumaaday go’aanka Mareykanka. Liban Axmed Xasan, oo ah murashaxa dowladda federaalka ay taageerto, ayaa sheegay in lacagtan lagu wareejiyay iyadoo loo marayo hay’ad lacag oo sharci ah si loogu gargaaro Artan waxii laga qasaaray. Kordhinta ayaa dhalisay dareen kulul oo taageero ah saraakiisha Soomaaliyeed oo sheegay in ay muujineyso isku soo duubnida iyo caawinaada. Ku-deeqa ayaa yimid iyadoo ay jiraan hadallo sheegaya in ganacsato Soomaaliyeed oo kale ay u soo bandhigeen Artan lacag lagu qiimeeyay $100,000 si loo magdhabo khasaarah a dakhliga uu ka haray Koobka Adduunka, kaas oo lagu qiyaasay inta u dhaxaysa $50,000 ilaa $75,000 ay tahay mushaharka qiyaasta ah ee lagu siiyo garsoorayaasha. “Guul ma aha oo kaliya in lagu guuleysto tartanka, balse waxaa ka sii muhiimsan in la taageero halyeeyada soo jeediya geesinimada,” ayuu yiri Liban Axmed Xasan oo hadlay sagootinta. “Garsoore Artan waa calanka Soomaaliya, waxaana waajib nage noqotey inaan isaga taageerno muddadan adag.” Musharaxa ayaa intaas ku daray, “Sanad maanta, waxaan u aragnaa mustaqbal dhalaalaya inuu noqdo kan markhaati ka ah Soomaaliya cusub, oo aan cadaalad ku xidhannahay.” Wafdiga ku howlgalaya kaalintii Liban ayaa caddeeyey in bixinta lacagtan ay tahay mid qorshaysan oo lala jaan qaadaya isla xisaabtan ballaaran. Deeqan tan ayaa timi iyadoo uu weli sii socdo xiisadda siyaasadda ee Galmudug kadib markii Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh uu Liban Axmed u magacaabay musharixa rasmiga ah ee xisbiga JSP. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, murashaxa ayaa aad ugu dheeraaday dhaleeceynta iyo arrimo ku saabsan xag-jirnimada. Intaa kadib, Cumar Artan ayaa ku soo laabtay dalka ka dib markii laga diiday dalka Mareykanka. Waxa uu ballan qaaday inuu u tartami doono Koobka Adduunka ee 2030-kii, kaas oo la qorsheeyay in lagu qabto Spain, Portugal, iyo Morocco. Sanadkii 2024, Artan wuxuu ahaa garsoorihii ugu horeeyay ee Soomaaliyeed oo ka shaqeeya Koobka Qaramada Afrika. The post Musharax Galmudug Liban Axmed oo $50,000 ku wareejiyay garsoore Cumar Artan first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo Xarigga Ka Jaray Mashaariic Horumarineed oo laga hirgeliyay magaalada Jawhar
items.description: Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, iyo wafdi uu hoggaaminayo ayaa maanta gaaray magaalada Jawhar ee xarunta maamulka Hirshabeelle, halkaas oo uu ka Xarig jaray mashaariic horumarineed oo muhiim u ah shacabka iyo hay’adaha dowlad-goboleedka. Madaxweynaha ayaa xarigga ka jaray dhismayaal kala duwan oo muddooyinkii la soo dhaafay laga hirgeliyay magaalada Jawhar, waxaana kamid ah Mashaariicda dhismaha xarunta Madaxtooyada Hirshabeelle, dhismaha Wasaaradda Waxbarashada, Wasaaradda Maaliyadda, Guriga Martida Dowladda Hirshabeelle iyo sidoo kale waddooyin laami ah oo dhowaan laga dhisay magaalada. Intii uu ku suganyahay Jawhar, Madaxweynaha ayaa sidoo kale la filayaa inuu dhagax-dhigo mashaariic kale oo horumarineed kuwaas oo ay kamid yihiin terminal cusub oo laga hirgelinayo Garoonka Diyaaradaha ee Jawhar, xarunta Baarlamaanka Hirshabeelle iyo dhismaha Wasaaradda Amniga. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa maamulka iyo shacabka Hirshabeelle uga mahadceliyay dadaallada ay ku bixiyeen hirgelinta mashaariicdan, isagoo ku tilmaamay kuwo muhiim u ah horumarka adeegyada dowladda, kobaca dhaqaalaha iyo xoojinta dowladnimada. Madaxweynaha ayaa xusay in Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ay sii wadi doonto taageerada ay siiso dowlad-goboleedyada si loo dardargeliyo horumarka dalka, loona horumariyo adeegyada ay helaan shacabka Soomaaliyeed.

items.title: Garsoore Cumar Cartan oo dhexdhexaadin doona ciyaarta weyn ee UEFA Super Cup-ka
items.description: Xiriirka Kubadda Cagta Yurub ee UEFA ayaa si rasmi ah ugu dhawaaqay in garsooraha Soomaaliyeed ee FIFA, Omar Abdulkadir Artan, uu dhexdhexaadin doono ciyaarta weyn ee UEFA Super Cup-ka 2026, taas oo dhex mari doonta kooxaha Paris Saint-Germain iyo Aston Villa. Ciyaartan oo si weyn loo wada sugayo ayaa lagu qaban doonaa magaalada Salzburg ee dalka Austria 12-ka Agoosto 2026, Go’aanka UEFA ayaana yimid maalmo kaddib markii Cumar Cartan laga reebay tartanka Koobka Adduunka 2026 sababo la xiriira diidmo gelitaan oo uga timid Mareykanka. Magacaabistan ayaa loo arkaa mid muujinaysa kalsoonida weyn ee UEFA ku qabto tayada iyo xirfadda garsoore Cartan, kaas oo noqday mid ka mid ah garsoorayaasha ugu magaca dheer Afrika, isla markaana sannadkii 2025 loo aqoonsaday garsooraha ugu wanaagsan qaaradda Afrika. Madaxweynaha UEFA, Aleksander Čeferin, ayaa ku tilmaamay Cartan “garsoore da’yar oo heer sare ah” isla markaana sheegay in magacaabistiisu ay tahay aqoonsi loo siinayo kartidiisa iyo doorkiisa kubadda cagta caalamka. Magacaabistan ayaa noqotay guul kale oo taariikhi ah oo uu gaaray garsooraha Soomaaliyeed Cumar Cartan, iyadoo taageerayaal badan iyo masuuliyiin isboorti ay ku tilmaameen sharaf u soo hoyatay Soomaaliya.

items.title: Aadan Madoobe oo xilka la wareegay Koonfur Galbeed
items.description: Aadan Madoobe oo xilka la wareegay Koonfur Galbeed Baydhabo, 11 Juun 2026 – Munaasabad lagu xil wareejinayo Madaxweynaha cusub ee Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya, Mudane Sheekh Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe), ayaa maanta ka dhacday Xarunta Madaxtooyada ee magaalada Baydhabo, iyadoo ay goobjoog ka ahaayeen masuuliyiin ka tirsan Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, madaxda dowlad goboleedka, xildhibaanno, siyaasiyiin iyo marti sharaf kale. Xil wareejintani waxay ka dhigan tahay bilowga maamul cusub oo Koonfur Galbeed, kaas oo la filayo inuu horumariyo amniga, dib-u-dhiska, iyo adeegyada bulshada. Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed ayaa ka mid ah dowladaha ugu weyn Soomaaliya, waxaana muhiim ah in maamulka cusub uu xalliyo caqabadaha jira, oo ay ka mid yihiin abaaro, isku dhacyo deegaanka, iyo dhaqaale yari. “Waxaan ballan qaadayaa inaan u adeegi doono shacabka Koonfur Galbeed si daacad ah, isla markaana aan ka shaqeyn doono horumarinta amniga iyo dib-u-dhiska deegaannada,” ayuu yiri Madaxweyne Aadan Madoobe khudbaddiisii xil wareejinta. “Wada shaqeynta dowladda federaalka iyo hay’adaha caalamiga ayaa furaha u ah guusha.” Madaxweynaha cusub ayaa hoosta ka xarriiqay in mudnaanta koowaad ay siinayo sugidda amniga, ka hortagga argagixisada, iyo dib-u-dhiska kaabayaasha dhaqaalaha sida jidadka, biyaha, iyo isku xirka. Sidoo kale, waxa uu ku baaqay in la xoojiyo wada shaqeynta dowladaha hoose si loo gaarsiiyo adeegyada bulshada si degdeg ah. Masuuliyiinta Dowladda Federaalka ee ka qeyb galay munaasabadda ayaa hambalyo u diray Madaxweynaha cusub, iyagoo sheegay in dowladda federaalka ay diyaar u tahay inay la shaqeyso Koonfur Galbeed si loo xaqiijiyo horumar loo dhan yahay. Xildhibaanno iyo siyaasiyiin kale ayaa bogaadiyay habsami u socodka xil wareejinta, iyagoo tilmaamay inay tahay tusaale wanaagsan oo loogu taliyay dimuqraadiyadda. Munaasabadda ayaa ku soo dhammaatay jawi wanaagsan, iyadoo la filayo in Madaxweyne Aadan Madoobe uu dhowaan magacaabi doono golihiisa wasiirrada oo ka koobnaan doona shakhsiyaad xirfad leh. The post Aadan Madoobe oo xilka la wareegay Koonfur Galbeed first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Aadan Madoobe oo deg-deg ula wareegay xilka madaxweynaha K/G + Sawirro
items.description: Baydhaba (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha cusub ee Dowlad-goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya, Sheekh Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe) ayaa maanta si deg-deg ah xilka ula wareegay, kadib markii uu shalay kusoo baxay doorashadii ka dhacday Baydhabo, isaga oo helay 88 cod. Munaasabad kooban oo maanta ka dhacday xarunta Madaxtooyada Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya ayuu si rasmi ah xilka ugala wareegay hoggaamiyihii kumeel gaarka ee xilka sii hayay Mudane Jibriil Cabdirashiid Xaaji Cabdi. Xil wareejinta ayaa waxaa goob joog ka ahaa masuuliyiin ka tirsan Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Maamulka Koonfur Galbeed, xubno ka socday hay’adaha dowladda, siyaasiyiin, odayaal dhaqameed iyo marti sharaf kale. Inta ay socotay munaasabadda Mudane Jibriil Cabdirashiid Xaaji Cabdi ayaa hoggaamiyaha cusub ku wareejiyey dukumiintiyada iyo masuuliyadaha xafiiska, isaga oo ugu hambalyeeyey xilka loo doortay, una rajeeyey inuu si hufan u guto waajibaadka loo igmaday. Dhankiisa Madaxweynaha la doortay ee Koonfur Galbeed Sheekh Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe) ayaa uga mahadceliyey Hoggaamiyihii ku-meel-gaarka ahaa shaqadii iyo dadaalkii uu geliyey xilliga kala guurka, isaga oo ballanqaaday inuu sii wadi doono dadaallada lagu xoojinayo nabadda, horumarka iyo dowlad-dhiska Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed. Kala baxa doorashada Koonfur Galbeed ayaa kusoo aadayo xilli xasaasi ah, iyadoo mucaaradka ay horay u diideen qaabka loo mareeyay doorashadaas. Si kastaba, Soomaaliya ayaa haatan ku jirto marxalad adag oo ka dhalatay xiisad culus oo ku aadan sida ay Villa Somalia u wajahayso doorashooyinka heer feederaal iyo heer dowlad-goboleed oo ay diidan yihiin mucaaradka. The post Aadan Madoobe oo deg-deg ula wareegay xilka madaxweynaha K/G + Sawirro appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Disrupting Iran’s Weapons Procurement
items.description: Disrupting Iran’s Weapons Procurement Press Statement Thomas “Tommy” Pigott, Spokesperson Today, the United States is imposing sanctions on thirteen individuals and entities based in Iran, Belarus, and China, including Hong Kong, that have sought to source and purchase weapons, including man-portable air-defense systems (MANPADS), on behalf of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC). These designations follow our action on May 8, 2026 , to disrupt procurement networks that support Iran’s military programs and degrade Iran’s ability to advance its military activities in the region. Today’s action supports the implementation of United Nations (UN) sanctions and restrictive measures on Iran, reimposed as a direct result of Iran’s “significant non-performance” of its nuclear commitments. UN Security Council resolution 1929 requires UN Member States to prevent the supply, sale, or transfer of conventional weapons such as MANPADS to Iran. Consistent with the President’s National Security Memorandum 2 (NSPM-2), the United States continues to maintain maximum pressure on Iran and take actions to deny the IRGC and the government of Iran access to the resources that sustain their destabilizing activities. The United States continues to use all available tools, to expose, disrupt, and counter Iran’s destabilizing activities and to stop Iran from efforts to reconstitute its proliferation-sensitive programs. The Department of State’s action was taken pursuant to Executive Order (E.O.) 13949, which targets certain persons with respect to the conventional arms activities of Iran. The Department of the Treasury’s action was taken pursuant to E.O. 13382, which targets weapons of mass destruction (WMD) proliferators and their supporters, and E.O. 13902, which targets persons operating in Iran’s financial sector. For more information on today’s actions, please see the Department of State’s fact sheet and Department of the Treasury’s press release

items.title: Hoggaamiyaha Koonfur Galbeed, Aadan Madoobe oo xilka la wareegay (SAWIRRO)
items.description: Hoggaamiyaha cusub ee Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed, Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe) ayaa Khamiistan xilka la wareegay, ka dib munaasabad ka dhacday Magaalada Baydhabo. Munaasabadan oo lagu qabtay Xarunta Madaxtooyada Koonfur Galbeed ayuu Hoggaamiyaha cusub uu xilka uga la wareegay Jibriil Cabdirashiid Xaaji Cabdi, kaas oo illaa 1-dii bishii April ku magacawnaa Hoggaamiyaha KMG Koonfur Galbeed. “Munaasabadda xil wareejinta ayaa waxaa goobjoog ka ahaa masuuliyiin ka tirsan Dowladda Federaalka, Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed, xubno ka socday hay’adaha dowladda, siyaasiyiin, odayaal dhaqameed iyo marti sharaf kale.” Ayaa lagu yiri war lagu daabacay bogga wararka Madaxtooyada. Warka ayaa lagu sheegay in Jibriil Cabdirashiid uu Hoggaamiyaha cusub ku wareejiyay dokumentiyada iyo masuuliyadaha xafiiska, isla-markaana uu ugu hambalyeeyay xilka loo doortay. Xildhibaanada Baarlamaanka Koonfur Galbeed ayaa Arbacadii Aadan Madoobe u doortay inuu noqdo Hoggaamiyaha xiga ee Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed. Aadan Madoobe ayaa isla shalay loo dhaariyay xilka loo doortay, ka dib in ka badan afar sano oo uu ahaa Gudoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka ee Baarlamaanka Somaliya. Aadan Madoobe ayaa la sii qiyaasayay in loo dooran doono Hoggaamiyaha Koonfur Galbeed, marka aad eegto in aqlabiyadda Xildhibaanada Baarlamaanka Koonfur Galbeed ay ka tirsan yihiin Urur Siyaasadeedka JSP ee Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud uu hoggaamiyo. Gudoomiyaha Baarlamaanka Koonfur Galbeed, Mahad Maxamed Sheekh Xasan iyo Labadiisa Kuxigeen Aadan Xasan Maxamed (Osama) iyo Shamsa Maxamed Yarow ayaa sidoo ka tirsan JSP.

items.title: Daawo: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo gaaray magaalada Jowhar
items.description: Jowhar (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud iyo wafdi uu hoggaaminayo ayaa maanta gaaray magaalada Jowhar ee caasimadda dowlad-goboleedka HirShabelle, halkaas oo si weyn loogu soo dhaweeyay. Wafdiga Madaxweynaha ayaa waxaa garoonka diyaaradaha ee Maxamed Dheere kusoo dhaweeyay Madaxweynaha HirShabelle Cali Cabdullahi Xuseen (Guudlaawe), mas’uuliyiin ka tirsan goleyaasha heer federaal iyo heer dowlad-goboleedka iyo boqolaal shacab ah. Ujeedka safarka Xasan Sheekh ee caasimada Jowhar ayaa ah inuu daah-furo mashaariic horumarineed oo waa wayn, kuwaas oo ay ka mid yihiin dhismaha madaxtooyo casri ah, xarumo wasaaradeed iyo waddooyin muhiim ah oo laga hirgeliyay magaaladaasi. Sidoo kale, waxaa haatan HirShabelle ku sugan madaxdii ugu badneyd oo goobjoog noqon doono mashaariicda maanta laga daah-furayo halkaasi, iyada oo qorshuhu yahay in sidoo kale madaxdu ay dhagax dhigaan kuwa kale. Dhanka kale, Ammaanka magaalada Jowhar ayaa si weyn loo adkeeyay, iyadoo ciidamada ammaanka ay kordhiyeen howl-gallada sugidda nabad-gelyada si loo xaqiijiyo ammaan buuxa inta uu socdo safarka madaxweynaha. Inta uu madaxweynaha ku sugan yahay Jowhar, waxaa sidoo kale la filayaa inuu kulamo la yeesho mas’uuliyiinta dowlad-goboleedka HirShabelle, kuwaas oo looga hadli doono xaaladda guud ee amniga, horumarinta, adeegyada bulshada iyo sidoo kale doorashooyinka. Safarka madaxweynaha ayaa la sheegay inuu qeyb ka yahay dadaallada Dowladda Federaalka ee lagu xoojinayo xiriirka kala dhexeeya dowlad-goboleedyada, isla markaana lagu dardar-gelinayo mashaariicda horumarineed ee dalka. Si kastaba, safarka Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ee Jowhar ayaa imanaya xilli Dowladda Federaalka ay maamulka HirShabelle ka wado qabashada doorashooyinka qof iyo cod, iyadoo guddiga doorashada uu muddeeyay in 9-ka July 2026 ay qabsoomi doonto doorashada hoggaamiyaha HirShabelle. The post Daawo: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo gaaray magaalada Jowhar appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Xiisad culus oo ka soo cusboonaatay degmada Cabdicasiis iyo mucaaradka oo..
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Faah-faahinno dheeraad ah ayaa waxaa laga helayaa xiisad horleh oo markale kasoo cusboonaatay gudaha degmada Cabdicasiis ee gobolka Banaadir oo dhawaan ay ku dagaalameen dowladda iyo mucaaradka. Xiisaddan cusub ayaa salka ku hayso burburin ay ciidamada Booliska haatan ka bilaabeen Buulo-goley ee degmada Cabdicasiis, kadibna waxay isku dhaceen dadka deegaanka, taas oo keentay isku dhac sababay khasaare kala duwan. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in ciidamada ay adeegsadeen rasaas, waxaana jira khasaare leh dhimasho iyo dhaawac, sida ay soo sheegayaan dadka deegaanka. Dhinaca kale mucaaradka oo ka hadlay falkan ayaa si xooggan ugu cambaareeyay Dowladda Federaalka ee uu hoggaamiyo Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, maadaama ay weli sii waddo burburinta dhalalka. Ra’iisul wasaarihii hore ee Soomaaliya, Xasan Cali Khayre ayaa u tacsiyeeyay dhibanayaasha, wuxuuna dhanka kale eedeymo u jeediyay Xasan Sheekh. “Waxaan tacsi tiiraanyo leh u dirayaa qoysaska shacabkii birimageydada ahaa ee taliska arxanlaawaha ah ee Madaxweyne hore Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud oo ku hawllan dhulboob uu maanta ku weeraray xaafadda Goleey ee degmada Cabdicasiis. Waxaan Alle ka baryayaa in uu u naxariisto shacabkii uu taliska ku dilay weerarkan, una boogadhayo intii uu ku dhaawacay”, ayuu yiri Khayre. Sidoo kale, wuxuu intaas ku daray in aan weli la joojin burburinta dhulalka ee caasimada, welina uu socda barakicinta shacabka iyo xasuuq, sida uu hadalka u dhigay. “Waxaa amakaag iyo ayaandarro ah in taliska waqtigiisu dhammaaday oo horay u sheegay in uu joojiyay dhulboobka uu maanta ku hawllan yahay boobka dhulka dantaguud, barakacinta danyarta, iyo xasuuqa shacabka, taas oo tusaale nool u ah sida ay isu burinayaan hadalka iyo ficilka taliska Madaxweyne hore Xasan Sheekh oo caadeystay gaboodfallo iyo dambiyo ka dhan ah xuquuqda aadanaha oo wiiqaya kalsoonida shacabka, horumarka dalka iyo dowladnimada Soomaaliya,” ayuu mar kale yiri Xasan Cali Khayre. Xiisadda degmada Cabdicasiis ayaa mar kale soo cusbooneysiineyso muranada dhulalka, iyada oo dhawaan ay dowladdu sheegtay in gabi ahaanba la joojiyay duminta xaafadaha ay dagan yihiin shacabka balse boobka ayaa weli sii socda. items.title: Ciidamada Dowladda Federaalka oo gudaha ugu jira xaafadda Goley ee Degmada Cabdicasiis
items.description: Ciidamada Dowladda Federaalka ayaa maanta gudaha ugu jira xaafadda Goley ee Degmada Cabdicasiis ee Gobolka Banaadir, halkaas oo laga maqlayo rasaas ay askartu furayaan. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in ciidamadu ay xaafaddaasi ka wadaan hawlgal ay qaar ka mid ah dadka deegaanka uga saarayaan guryaha ay degan yihiin. Goobjoogeyaal ayaa sheegay in dadka deegaanka ay ka horyimaadeen in guryahooda laga saaro, taasna ay keentay in ciidamadu ay xoog u adeegsadaan. Raysal Wasaarihii hore ee dalka, Xasan Cali Khayre oo ka hadlay hawlgalka xaafadda Goley ee waqooyiga Muqdisho ayaa wax lala yaabo ku tilmaamay in Dowladda Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ay dib u soo celiso dhul boobka, iyadoo horey u sheegtay in la joojiyay. “Waxaa amakaag iyo ayaan darro ah in taliska waqtigiisu dhamaaday oo horey u sheegay in uu joojiyay dhul boobka uu maanta ku howlan yahay boobka dhulka danta guud, barakicinta danyarta iyo xasuuqa shacabka, taas oo tusaale nool u ah sida ay isu burinayaan hadalka iyo ficilka taliska Madaxweyne hore Xasan Sheekh oo caadeystay gaboodfalo iyo dambiyo ka dhan ah xuquuqda aadanaha oo wiiqaya kalsoonida shacabka, horumarka dalka iyo dowladnimada Soomaaliya.” Ayuu yiri Khayre oo warkan ku sheegay bartiisa xiriirka bulshada. Sidoo kale Madaxweynihii hore ee Somaliya, Shariif Sheekh Axmed oo isna ka faceliyay ayaa yiri “Waxaa ayaan darro weyn ah in ciidankii amniga ee loogu talagalay illaalinta nafta iyo maalka bulshada, ay hadda si arxan la’aan ah u beegsanayaan dadka rayidka ah iyagoo u isticmaalaya rasaas nool nool, gaar ahaan xaafadda Goley ee Degmada Cabdicasiis. Amarada falalkan guracan oo ay fulinayaan qayb ka mid ah ciidanka ammaanka, waxay si toos ah uga imaanayaan Madaxweynihii hore Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, waxaana bulshadda caasimadda looga baahan yahay in si wadajir ah looga hortago ficiladan ka baxsan dowladnimadda iyo illaalinta xuquuqda muwaadiniinta.” Shariif Sheekh Axmed oo digniin u diray Saraakisiha Ciidamada ayaa bartiisa Facebook ku qoray “Ugu dambayn, waxaan Saraakiisha Ciidanka uga digayaa sii socoshada gabood-falada ka dhanka ah bulshada rayidka ah ee iyagu si nabad ah codkooda ugu muujinaya dareenkooda ku aadan tacadiyadda sii kordhaya, sida boobka iyo barakicinta khasabka ah.” Dowladda Hoose ee Xamar iyo Taliska Qaybta Booliska Gobolka Banaadir ayaan weli ka hadlin hawlgalka ay ciidamada ka wadaan waqooyiga Muqdisho.

items.title: Waa kuma Cumar Cabdulkadir Artan, garsoorihii loo xushay Koobka Adduunka kana noqday halyeey Soomaaliyeed?
items.description: Garsoore Cumar Artan oo caalamka ka noqday halyeey Waakuma Cumar Artan ? Cumar Artan waxa uu ku dhashay magaalada Taalex , waqooyiga Soomaaliya. Waxbarashadiisii hoose/dhexe waxa uu ku qaatay Muqdisho , gaar ahaan iskuul gaar luqadda Ingiriisiga lagu bari jiray, ka dib markii uu hooyadii ku lumiyay da’da saddex jir . Dagaalkii sokeeye ee 1991 -kii ka dib, waxa uu u qaxay Finland, halkaas oo uu ka qaatay shahaadada koowaad ee injineernimada korontada Jaamacadda Vaasa . Waxa uu xirfad ahaan uga soo shaqeeyay shirkadda caanka ah ee Nokia , ka hor inta aanu u gurguurin Maraykanka sanadkii 2002 . Garsoore Cumar Artan, oo ah qofka ugu horreeya ee Soomaaliyeed ee loo xusho inuu garsooro koobka adduunka (World Cup) , balse uu ka hor yimid diidmo lagaga celiyay Maraykanka , ayaa caalamka looga yaqaan garsooraha ugu fiican Afrika sanadkii 2025 , isagoo soo maray jid adag oo ay ku jiraan waxbarasho sare, dhibaatooyin dalka, iyo guulo taariikhi ah. Tageerada Caalamiga iyo Soo Dhaweynta Geesinimada leh Markii laga diiday inuu galo Maraykanka , waxaa soo ifbaxay hoggaamiyeyaasha Kanada oo uu ka mid yahay Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Gobolka Britsh Columbia , David Eby , oo ku casuumay inuu Vancouver garsooro , isagoo sheegay in “lagu soo dhawayn doono laguna qaddarin doono waxa uu soo maray” . Maayarka Toronto, Olivia Chow , ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay inuu ku soo dhaweyn lahaayeen, iyadoo ku tilmaantay go’aanka Maraykanka mid aan cadaalad ahayn . Dulucda Macnaha (Nut Graf): Sheekada Cumar Artan waxay ka duwan tahay midka garsooraha caadiga ah. Waxay ka tarjumeysaa halganka Soomaaliyeed ee dib-u-soo-kabashada, iyadoo ay joogto u tahay sida uu ku yiri Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh: “Wuxuu astaan u yahay dhiirrigelinta jiilka cusub.” Markii laga reebay inuu garsooro World -ka sababo la xiriira “xiriir lagu hayo kooxo argagixiso ah,” ayaa shacabka Soomaaliyeed iyo dunida ay u soo baxeen si ay u taageeraan, isagoo looga dhigtay soo dhaweyn geesi ah markii uu ku soo laabtay Muqdisho bishan . Xulista FIFA iyo Guusha Qaaradda Cumar Artan waxaa loo qoondeeyay inuu noqdo garsoorihii ugu horreeyay ee Soomaaliyeed ee ka qeyb qaata Koobka Adduunka ee sannadkan, ka dib markii uu galay liiska 52 -ka garsoore ee ay soo xulaysay FIFA . Isaga oo 34 jir ah, Artan waxaa loo aqoonsaday inuu yahay garsooraha ugu fiican Afrika sanadkii 2025, ka dib markii uu garsooray kulanadii ugu muhiimsanaa qaaradda, oo ay ku jiraan finalka Horyaalka Champions-ka Afrika . Halyeeynimada Guriga: Si kastaba, xilliga uu ku soo laabtay Muqdisho, waxaa lagu soo dhaweeyey si heer sare ah, iyadoo dad badan ay ka buuxeen garoonka diyaaradaha, qarannimadana soo bandhigeen. Wuxuu shacabka ka yiri: “In kasta oo waxa i soo maray ay ahaayeen kuwo aan fiicnayn, ma quusanayo, waxaana ballan qaadayaa inaan ka qeyb geli doono Koobka Adunka ee dambe.” . items.title: Ciidamada Kenya oo Fashiliyay Weerar Al-Shabaab Ku Qaadday Gobolka Mandheera
items.description: Mandheera, Kenya – Ciidamada ammaanka Kenya ayaa Arbacadii fiidkii fashiliyay weerar ay dagaalyahanno looga shakisan yahay Al-Shabaab ku qaadeen saldhig ciidan oo ku yaalla gobolka Mandheera ee waqooyi-bari Kenya. Weerarka ayaa lagu beegsaday xerada ciidamada ee ku taalla deegaanka Lafey, meel u dhow xadka Soomaaliya, xilli ay saacaddu ahayd ku dhowaad 7:00 fiidnimo. Wararka amniga ayaa sheegaya in ku dhowaad 10 dagaalyahan oo hubeysan ay dhinaca waqooyi-bari kaga soo dhowaadeen xerada, iyagoo rasaas ka furay masaafo lagu qiyaasay 600 mitir. Saraakiisha ammaanka ayaa aaminsan in kooxda weerarka soo qaaday ay doonaysay inay tijaabiso awoodda difaaca saldhigga. Ciidamada ku sugnaa xerada ayaa si degdeg ah uga jawaabay weerarka, iyagoo furay rasaas culus oo ku khasabtay weeraryahannada inay dib ugu laabtaan dhulka howdka ah ee ku dhow goobta. Mas’uuliyiinta Kenya ayaa sheegay in aysan jirin askar ku dhaawacantay ama ku geeriyootay weerarka, sidoo kalena aan wax khasaare ah soo gaarin saldhigga la bartilmaameedsaday. Hay’adaha ammaanka ayaa habeenkii oo dhan heegan sare galay, iyadoo laga cabsi qabay in weerarro kale oo daba socda ay dhacaan. Gobollada Mandheera, Wajeer iyo Gaarisa ayaa muddo dheer la daalaa dhacayay weerarro amni darro oo ay fuliyaan Al-Shabaab, maadaama ay ku yaallaan xadka ay wadaagaan Kenya iyo Soomaaliya.

items.title: Cawad oo ka digay kalitalisnimo ka hanaqaada PUNTLAND
items.description: Garoowe (Caasimada Online) – Wasiirkii hore ee arrimaha dibadda Soomaaliya, Mudane Axmed Ciise Cawad ayaa ka falceliyay hadalka kasoo yeeray Madaxweyne ku xigeenka Puntland Ilyaas Lugatoor oo shaaciyay inay ku baraarugsan yihiin qorshe lid ku ah maamulkooda oo ay waddo Dowladda Federaalka, xilli haatan dhaq-dhaqaaqyo laga dareemayo deegaannada Puntland. Axmed Ciise Cawad ayaa sheegay inuu soo dhaweynayo hadalka Lugatoor ee ku aadan in la difaaco jiritaanka Puntland, lagana hortago qorshaha uu wado Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud oo ay si weyn isku hayaan Saciid Deni. “Waa ku raacsanahay Madaxweyne Ku-xigeenka inaan kulligeen ka ilaalino Puntland hardaamada iyo kalitalisnimada Xasan Shiikh Maxamuud oo hadda Soomaaliya oo dhan halis ku ah,” ayuu yiri wasiirkii hore ee arrimaha dibadda. Dhanka kale, Cawad ayaa ka digay maamul xumo dumiso Puntland iyo kalitalisnimo gudaha ah, isaga oo soo jeediyay in iyadana laga hortago. “Madaxweyne Ku-xigeenku ha nagu raaco inaan Puntland ka ilaalinno inay dumiso maamul-xumo iyo kalitalisnimo gudaha ah,” ayuu sii raaciyay. Si kastaba, Qorshahan ayaa madaxda sare ee maamulka ee Puntland kusoo baraarugtay kadib mudo sanad ah oo uu socday in ciiddamo taabacsan dowladda Soomaaliya laga qorayo deegaannada maamulkaasi. Dadka Puntland ayaa arintan u arka mid lagu cuuryaaminayo horumarka bulsho iyo dhaqdhaqaaqyada kala dhaxeeya gobolada kale ee Soomaaliya, waxayna hadalka madaxda u arkaan arin aan waxba laga qaban karin. Waxaa kale Madaxda Puntland oo ku mashquulsanaa arrimo kale waxay xiligaan kusoo baraarugeen kacdoon bulsho iyo mid lid ku ah maamulka xiligaan hoggaanka u haayo ee uu hoggaamiye Saciid Cabdu llahi Deni oo ay u arkaan siyaasi damac siyaasadeeed ka leh hoggaanka sare ee Federaalka. Xiligaan Puntland waxay wajaheysaa culeysyo siyaasadeed iyo mid dhaqaale oo ka dhashay diidmada maamulka Saciid Deni oo hoos u dhigay inay Puntland hesho kab-kii miisaaniyadeed ee Dowladda Federaalka iyo beesha caalamka ay ka heli jirtay The post Cawad oo ka digay kalitalisnimo ka hanaqaada PUNTLAND appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Taliyeyaasha SNA & Booliiska oo kormeeray TURKSOM
items.description: Taliyeyaasha ciidamada oo kormeeray Kulliyadda TURKSOM Muqdisho, 11 Juun 2026 – Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, Sarreeye Guuto Ibraahim Maxamed Maxamuud, oo uu wehlinayo Taliyaha Ciidanka Booliiska Soomaaliyeed, Sarreeye Guuto Asad Cismaan Cabdullaahi, iyo saraakiil kale, ayaa maanta kormeer shaqo ku tegay Kulliyadda Tababarrada Ciidamada ee TURKSOM, si loo dardargeliyo tababarrada iyo loo xoojiyo awoodda ciidamada qalabka sida. Kormeerkani wuxuu muhiimad weyn u leeyahay sidii loo xaqiijin lahaa in ciidamada Soomaaliyeed ay helaan tababar heer caalami ah oo ay bixiyaan khubaro Turkish ah. Kulliyadda TURKSOM waxaa lagu aasaasay iskaashi istiraatiiji oo u dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Turkiye, waxaana ay qayb ka tahay dadaallada lagu dhisayo ciidan qaran oo awood u leh difaaca dalka iyo sugidda amniga shacabka. “Waxaan kormeeray qeybaha kala duwan ee kulliyadda, waxaanan indha-indheyn ku sameynay habsami u socodka tababarrada iyo tayada diyaar-garowga ciidamada Soomaaliyeed ee halkaasi lagu carbiyo,” ayuu yiri Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, Sarreeye Guuto Ibraahim Maxamed Maxamuud. “Ujeeddadeenu waa in la dardargeliyo tababarrada iyo kor loo qaado tayada ciidamada.” Taliyaha Booliiska, Sarreeye Guuto Asad Cismaan Cabdullaahi, ayaa intaas ku daray in xoojinta tababarrada ay la xiriirto sidii loo xaqiijin lahaa in ciidamadu ay u diyaar garoobaan caqabadaha amni ee Soomaaliya wajahayso. Saraakiisha kulliyadda TURKSOM ayaa warbixin ka siiyay taliyeyaasha howlaha tababarrada iyo horumarinta aqoonta ciidamada, iyagoo sheegay in kulliyaddu heer sare gaartay xagga qalabka iyo hababka waxbarida. Taliyeyaasha ayaa ku boorriyay ardayda ciidamada ee tababarka ku jirta in ay si daacad ah ula qayb galaan, isla markaana ay u adeegaan ummaddooda si sharaf leh. Kormeerku wuxuu ku soo gabagaboobay iyadoo taliyeyaashu ay ballan qaadeen in ay sii wadi doonaan taageerada kulliyadda si loo hubiyo in ay heerkeeda caalami ahaato. The post Taliyeyaasha SNA & Booliiska oo kormeeray TURKSOM first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: HIQ oo qaaday aqoon-isweydaarsi ku saabsan IPv6
items.description: HIQ oo qaaday aqoon-isweydaarsi ku saabsan IPv6 Muqdisho, 10 Juun 2026 – Hay’adda Isgaarsiinta Qaranka (HIQ) iyo Xarunta Qaran ee IPv6, oo ay martigeliso Jaamacadda Jamhuuriya, ayaa maanta si wadajir ah u qabtay aqoon-isweydaarsi ku saabsan Internet Baratakoolka Nooca Lixaad (IPv6), kaas oo ay ka soo qayb galeen bixiyeyaasha adeegyada internet-ka, jaamacadaha, xirfadlayaasha ICT-da, iyo daneeyayaal kale, si looga wada hadlo mustaqbalka kaabeyaasha isgaarsiinta internet-ka iyo hirgelinta IPv6 ee Soomaaliya. Aqoon-isweydaarsigan ayaa muhiimad weyn u leh Soomaaliya, iyadoo baratakoolka hadda la isticmaalo (IPv4) uu ka yaraaday cinwaannada internet-ka, taas oo caqabad ku ah ballaarinta isku xirnaanta dhijitaalka ah. IPv6 wuxuu bixinayaa cinwaan tiro aan la koobi karayn, waxaanu suurtagelinayaa korriinka teknoolojiyadda mustaqbalka sida waxyaabaha isku xira (IoT), ganacsiga elektaroonigga ah, iyo adeegyada bulshada ee casriga ah. “Himiladeennu mar walba waxay ahayd in Soomaaliya aysan ka harin isbeddellada teknoolojiyadda ee dunida,” ayuu yiri Maareeyaha Guud ee HIQ, Mudane Mustafa Yaasiin Sheekh. “Maanta waxa aynu qorshaynaynaa ma aha oo keliya baahiyaha internet-ka ee maanta jira, balse sidoo kale waxa aynu ka fikiraynaa sidii jiilasha mustaqbalka ay u heli lahaayeen teknoolojiyadda casriga ah ugana faa’iidaysan lahaayeen koboca dhaqaalaha dhijitaalka ah.” Mustafa Yaasiin ayaa intaas ku daray in wixii markii hore ahaa hiigsi lagu dhisayo Xarunta Qaran ee IPv6 ay maanta noqdeen xaqiiqo hirgashay oo taageeraysa geeddi-socodkan. Guddoomiyaha Jaamacadda Jamhuuriya ee Sayniska iyo Tiknoolajiyadda (JUST), Eng. Maxamed Axmed Maxamuud, ayaa muujiyay muhiimadda ay leedahay diyaarinta jiilka cusub ee xirfadlayaasha ICT-da. “Jaamacaduhu waxay door weyn ku leeyihiin horumarinta aqoonta, cilmi-baarista iyo hal-abuurka la xiriira IPv6, iyo sidoo kale tayeynta ardayda si ay uga qayb qaataan isbeddelka dhijitaalka ah ee dalka,” ayuu yiri. Intii uu socday aqoon-isweydaarsigu, khubaro kala duwan ayaa soo bandhigay mowduucyo ay ka mid yihiin baahida loo qabo istaraatiijiyad qaran oo IPv6 ah, hirgelinta farsamada iyo geeddi-socodka kala-guurka, siyaasadaha iyo maamul-wanaagga, iyo qaab-dhismeedyada siyaasadeed ee lagama maarmaanka u ah hirgelinta guuleysata. Aqoon-isweydaarsigan ayaa noqday madal lagu xoojinayo wacyiga ku saabsan IPv6, lagu adkaynayo iskaashiga daneeyayaasha, laguna taageerayo himilooyinka isbeddelka dhijitaalka ah ee Soomaaliya. Aqoon-isweydaarsigan ayaa muhiimad weyn u leh Soomaaliya, iyadoo baratakoolka hadda la isticmaalo (IPv4) uu ka yaraaday cinwaannada internet-ka, taas oo caqabad ku ah ballaarinta isku xirnaanta dhijitaalka ah. IPv6 wuxuu bixinayaa cinwaan tiro aan la koobi karayn, waxaanu suurtagelinayaa korriinka teknoolojiyadda mustaqbalka sida waxyaabaha isku xira (IoT), ganacsiga elektaroonigga ah, iyo adeegyada bulshada ee casriga ah. “Himiladeennu mar walba waxay ahayd in Soomaaliya aysan ka harin isbeddellada teknoolojiyadda ee dunida,” ayuu yiri Maareeyaha Guud ee HIQ, Mudane Mustafa Yaasiin Sheekh. “Maanta waxa aynu qorshaynaynaa ma aha oo keliya baahiyaha internet-ka ee maanta jira, balse sidoo kale waxa aynu ka fikiraynaa sidii jiilasha mustaqbalka ay u heli lahaayeen teknoolojiyadda casriga ah ugana faa’iidaysan lahaayeen koboca dhaqaalaha dhijitaalka ah.” Mustafa Yaasiin ayaa intaas ku daray in wixii markii hore ahaa hiigsi lagu dhisayo Xarunta Qaran ee IPv6 ay maanta noqdeen xaqiiqo hirgashay oo taageeraysa geeddi-socodkan. Guddoomiyaha Jaamacadda Jamhuuriya ee Sayniska iyo Tiknoolajiyadda (JUST), Eng. Maxamed Axmed Maxamuud, ayaa muujiyay muhiimadda ay leedahay diyaarinta jiilka cusub ee xirfadlayaasha ICT-da. “Jaamacaduhu waxay door weyn ku leeyihiin horumarinta aqoonta, cilmi-baarista iyo hal-abuurka la xiriira IPv6, iyo sidoo kale tayeynta ardayda si ay uga qayb qaataan isbeddelka dhijitaalka ah ee dalka,” ayuu yiri. Intii uu socday aqoon-isweydaarsigu, khubaro kala duwan ayaa soo bandhigay mowduucyo ay ka mid yihiin baahida loo qabo istaraatiijiyad qaran oo IPv6 ah, hirgelinta farsamada iyo geeddi-socodka kala-guurka, siyaasadaha iyo maamul-wanaagga, iyo qaab-dhismeedyada siyaasadeed ee lagama maarmaanka u ah hirgelinta guuleysata. Aqoon-isweydaarsigan ayaa noqday madal lagu xoojinayo wacyiga ku saabsan IPv6, lagu adkaynayo iskaashiga daneeyayaasha, laguna taageerayo himilooyinka isbeddelka dhijitaalka ah ee Soomaaliya. items.title: Xogta duqeyn culus oo ka dhacday duleedka Baydhaba
items.description: Baydhaba (Caasimada Online) – Faah-faahinno dheeraad ah ayaa waxaa laga helayaa khasaaraha ka dhashay weerar dhanka cirka ah oo xalay ka dhacay bannaanka magaalada Baydhaba ee xarunta Gobolka Baay, kaas lagu beegsaday maleeshiyaad ka tirsan kooxda Al-Shabaab. Duqeynta oo ahayd bartilmaameed ayaa timid kadib markii dhaq-dhaqaaq laga dareemay aaga magaalada Baydhaba, kadibna diyaarado dagaal ayaa beegsaday maleeshiyaadka ka tirsan Al-Shabaab oo lagu diyaarinayay halkaasi. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in xubnaha Khawaarijta ayaa doonayay in ay soo weeraraan fariisimaha ciidamada dolwada iyo kuwa Koonfur Galbeed ee ku yaalla koonaha magaalada, balse markii la ogaaday kadib ayaa lagu duqeeyay goobta. Saraakiil ka tirsan laamaha amniga ayaa innoo sheegay in howlgalkan khasaare isugu jiro dhimasho iyo dhaawac lagu gaarsiiyay argagixisada, balse ma shaacin tirada rasmiga ah. Dhanka kale, ma jiro wax hadal ah oo kasoo baxay dhanka dowladda Soomaaliya iyo saaxibada caalamiga ah oo ku aadan duqeynta Al-Shabaab lagu beegsaday ee ka dhacday duleedka magaalada Baydhaba. Horay waxaa magaaladan weerarro uga fuliyay ciidamo taabacsan Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed oo illaa iyo hadda ku sugan agagaarka Baydhaba, halkaas oo ay ku leeyihiin fariisimo ciidan. Weerarkan ayaa kusoo aadayo xilli shalay Koonfur Galbeed ay ka dhacday doorashada maamulka OO Madaxweyne loogu doortay Mudane Sheekh Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe) oo beddalaya Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen oo hadda dibad joog ah. items.title: Wararkii ugu dambeeyey dagaalka Iran iyo Mareykanka oo xoogeystay
items.description: Tehran ( Raxanreeb Online) Mareykanka iyo Iran ayaa duqeymo isku weydaarsaday bariga dhexe maalin labaad oo xiriir ah, taasoo sii xumaynaysa xabad joojintii awalba ruxneyd ee ay labada dal ku heshiiyeen bishii April. Taliska dhexe ee Mareykanka (Centcom) ayaa sheegay in ay soo afjareen mowjado “weerar ah oo is-difaac ah” oo lagu bartilmaameedsaday xarumaha militariga, ilaalada iyo raadaarka ee koonfurta Iran. Weerarkan ayaa yimid saacado ka dib markii madaxweyne Donald Trump uu wacad ku maray in ciidamada Mareykanka ay Iran u garaaci doonaan “aad u adag”, iyo in Tehran ay qaadatay waqti aad u dheer in ay heshiis la gasho si ay si joogto ah u soo afjarto dagaalka. Iyada oo ka jawaabaysa, Iran ayaa qaaday weerarro duqaymo ah oo lagu bartilmaameedsanayo hantida millatariga Maraykanka ee dalalka gobolka. Saldhigyada ciidamada Maraykanka ee Baxrayn iyo Kuwait ayaa maalintii labaad oo xiriir ah duqeymo ay ka fulinayaan ciidamada Iran, halka ciidamada ilaalada kacaanka Iran ee IRGC ay sheegeen in ay gantaallo balaastik ah ku garaaceen xarunta taliska Mareykanka ee Urdun, sida ay sheegtay warbaahinta dowladda Iran. IRGC waxay sheegtay inay burburisay “tiro badan” oo ah diyaaradaha dagaalka Mareykanka iyo “xarumo” ka dib markii ay 12 gantaal oo ballistic ah ku dhufteen garoonka ciidanka cirka ee Muwaffaq Salti ee Urudun, inkastoo sheegashada aan si madax banaan loo xaqiijin. The post Wararkii ugu dambeeyey dagaalka Iran iyo Mareykanka oo xoogeystay appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Kiisaska Ebola ee DR Congo oo Gaaray 635 iyo Dadka Ka Bogsadayna Kor U Dhaafay 30
items.description: Dowladda Jamhuuriyadda Dimuqraadiga ah ee Congo (DRC) ayaa sheegtay in tirada kiisaska la xaqiijiyay ee cudurka Ebola ay gaartay 635, iyadoo dadaallada lagu xakameynayo faafitaanka cudurka ay weli socdaan. Wasiirka Caafimaadka DRC, Roger Kamba, ayaa Arbacadii ku sheegay qoraal uu ku daabacay baraha bulshada in cudurkan, oo uu sababay nooca Bundibugyo ee Ebola, uu weli caqabad ku yahay dalka, balse ay jiraan horumaro muuqda oo laga sameeyay dhinacyada daaweynta iyo la socodka dadka la xiriiray bukaannada. Kamba ayaa xusay in boqolkiiba dadka lala socdo ee xiriirka la lahaa bukaannada uu kor u kacay ilaa 61.1%, halka uu maalintii ka horreysay ahaa 56.4%, waxa uuna sheegay in hay’adaha caafimaadku ay si dhow ula socdaan xaaladaha ka jira dhammaan goobaha uu cudurku saameeyay. Dhanka kale, wasiirku wuxuu shaaciyay in siddeed qof oo cusub ay ka bogsadeen cudurka, kuwaas oo toddobo ka mid ah laga diiwaangeliyay deegaanka Nyankunde halka qofka kalena uu ku sugnaa Mongbwalu, oo labaduba ka tirsan gobolka Ituri ee bariga dalka. Soo kabashadan cusub ayaa tirada guud ee dadka ka bogsaday Ebola ka dhigtay 30 qof. “Qof kasta oo ka bogsada cudurka wuxuu dirayaa fariin cad oo ah in dadka ay si degdeg ah u raadsadaan daaweyn, maadaama daryeelka hore uu badbaadin karo nolosha,” ayuu yiri Kamba. Wasiirka ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in dowladda ay geysay 490 tan oo dawooyin ah goobaha uu cudurku saameeyay, iyadoo la xoojiyay awoodda shaybaarada iyo kooxaha gurmadka ee ka hawlgala gobollada Ituri, North Kivu iyo South Kivu. DR Congo ayaa si rasmi ah ugu dhawaaqday dillaaca cusub ee Ebola 15-kii May 2026. Labo maalmood kaddib, 17-kii May, ayaa hay’adda caafimaadka adduunka ee World Health Organization (WHO) ku dhawaaqday in xaaladdan ay tahay xaalad caafimaad oo degdeg ah oo walaac caalami ah dhalisay. Khubarada caafimaadka ayaa weli ka digaya halista cudurka Ebola, iyagoo ku baaqaya in la xoojiyo dadaallada ka hortagga, baaritaanka degdegga ah iyo wacyigelinta bulshada si loo yareeyo faafitaankiisa.

items.title: Doorashooyinka Galmudug oo aan waqtigooda ku qabsoomi doonin
items.description: Doorashooyinka Galmudug ayay u badan tahay inay dib-u-dhac ku imaan doonaan, sababo ku aaddan xalin la’aanta khilaafka siyaasadeed ee taagan. Dowlad Goboleedka Galmudug ayaa weli bartanka kaga jirta khilaafka siyaasadeed ee Madaxweyne Axmed Cabdi Kaariye (Qoorqoor) kala dhaxeeya Madaxweynaha Dowladda Federaalka, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ee la xiriira hannaanka maamulka iyo doorashooyinka lagu wado in laga qabto deegaanada Galmudug. Gudaha Galmudug kama jiraan wax dhaqdhaqaaq doorasho ah, iyadoo wax ka yar 10 maalmood uu ka harsan yahay waqtiga Doorashada Golaha Deegaanka ee Degmooyinka Galmudug oo qorshuhu ahaa in la qabto 20-ka bisha June. Guddiga Doorashooyinka Qaranka ayaa 3-dii bishii May muddeeyay in sidoo kale Doorashada Golaha Wakiilada ee Baarlamaanka Galmudug ay qabsoomto 2-da bisha July, halka guddigu uu Doorashada Hoggaanka Galmudug uu waqtiga lagu qabanayo ka dhigay 9-ka bishaasi July. Khilaafka Madaxweyne Qoorqoor iyo Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda ee miiska saaran ayaa dib-u-dhigaya in Doorashooyinka Galmudug ay waqtigooda ku qabsoomaan. Labada dhinac ayaa waxaa u socday wada hadalo loogu kala dab qaadayo, inkastoo uu hakad ku yimid, intii lagu jiray maalmihii munaasabadda ee Ciidda Carafo. Dhexdhexaadiyeyaasha oo ay ku jiraan Xildhibaano ka tirsan Labada Aqal ee Baarlamaanka Federaalka ayaa damacsanaa in wada hadalada dib loo bilaabo toddobaadkii hore, waxaase fowdeeyay isku dhacyadii hubeysnaa iyo xiisadihii amni ee ka soo kordhay Magaalada Muqdisho. Dadka ku dhaqan deegaanada Galmudug ayaa kuu sheegaya inaysan jirin cid sheegi karta halka looga dhaqaaqi doono isgoyskan la taagan yahay iyo goorta ay dhamaan doonaan khilaafaadka siyaasadeed ee halista ku ah horu-socodka Dowlad Goboleedka Galmudug. Dad badan oo reer Galmudug ah ayaa isku diiwaangeliyay inay codeeyaan Doorashooyinka Golaha Deegaanka iyo tan Golaha Wakiilada Galmudug ee ay tahay in laga qabto 11 magaalo oo ka kala tirsan Gobolada Galgaduud iyo Mudug. Guddiga Doorashooyinka Qaranka ayaan weli bixinta kaarka codbixinta ka bilaabin deegaanada Galmudug, maadaama uu guddigu doonayay inay ku shaqeeyaan Magaalada Dhuusamareeb oo hubanti la’aan amni ay ka jirto, taas oo aysan jirin cid si gaar ah gacanta ugu hayso, marka ay noqoto dhinacyada isku haya siyaasadda Galmudug.

Dhexdhexaadiyeyaasha oo ay ku jiraan Xildhibaano ka tirsan Labada Aqal ee Baarlamaanka Federaalka ayaa damacsanaa in wada hadalada dib loo bilaabo toddobaadkii hore, waxaase fowdeeyay isku dhacyadii hubeysnaa iyo xiisadihii amni ee ka soo kordhay Magaalada Muqdisho. Dadka ku dhaqan deegaanada Galmudug ayaa kuu sheegaya inaysan jirin cid sheegi karta halka looga dhaqaaqi doono isgoyskan la taagan yahay iyo goorta ay dhamaan doonaan khilaafaadka siyaasadeed ee halista ku ah horu-socodka Dowlad Goboleedka Galmudug. Dad badan oo reer Galmudug ah ayaa isku diiwaangeliyay inay codeeyaan Doorashooyinka Golaha Deegaanka iyo tan Golaha Wakiilada Galmudug ee ay tahay in laga qabto 11 magaalo oo ka kala tirsan Gobolada Galgaduud iyo Mudug. Guddiga Doorashooyinka Qaranka ayaan weli bixinta kaarka codbixinta ka bilaabin deegaanada Galmudug, maadaama uu guddigu doonayay inay ku shaqeeyaan Magaalada Dhuusamareeb oo hubanti la’aan amni ay ka jirto, taas oo aysan jirin cid si gaar ah gacanta ugu hayso, marka ay noqoto dhinacyada isku haya siyaasadda Galmudug.

Madaxweyne ku-xigeenka Puntland Ilyaas Cismaan Lugatoor ayaa ka dhawaajiyay amar ku socda guddoomiyayaasha gobolada iyo degmooyinka Puntland kaasoo farayay in laga mamnuucay qabashada shirarka lagu taageerayo dowladda federaalka iyo qorista ciidamada loo diiwaangelinayo Dowladda Soomaaliya. Qorshahaan ayaa Madaxda sare ee maamulka Puntland kusoo baraarugtay kadib mudo sanad ah oo uu socday in ciiddamo taabacsan dowladda Soomaaliya laga qoro deegaanada Puntland. Madaxweyne kuxigeenka oo ka hadlayay kulan ay isugu yimaadeen guddoomiyeyaasha gobolada iyo laamaha amniga Puntland ayaa ku eedeeyay dowladda federaalka in ay wado qalqal gelin amnig iyo kicin bulsho, isagoo sheegay in ay mamnuuceen in deegaanada Puntland lagu ku qaban karin isu imaatin iyo shirar lagu taageerayo dowladda federaalka. “Hala ogaado guddoomiyayaashii degmooyinka iyo gobolada sow ma joogaan, nin Xamar ka yimid Puntland shirar kuma qaban karo, maanta oo ay 28 sano tahay Puntland yeelimayno in dusheena lagu dhibaateeyo” ayuu yiri wasiir Lugatoor. Dadka Puntland ayaa arintan u arka mid lagu cuuryaaminayo horumarka bulsho iyo dhaqdhaqaaqyada kala dhaxeeya gobolada kale ee dalka Soomaaliya, waxayna hadalka madaxda u arkaan arin aan waxba laga qaban karin. Madaxda Puntland oo ku mashquulsanaa arrimo kale waxay xiligaan kusoo baraarugeen kacdoon bulsho iyo mid lid ku ah maamulka xiligaan hoggaanka u haayo ee uu hoggaamiye Saciid Cabdu llahi Deni oo ay u arkaan siyaasi damac siyaasadeeed ka leh hoggaanka sare ee Federaalka. Waxaa sidoo kale sii kordhaya dhaqdhaqaaqyada abuuraya ciidamo u habeysan qaab qabiil oo ku abaabulsan oo hadba deegaano looga dhawaaqayo. items.title: Somaliland goob saamayn weyn ku yeelan karta loolanka macdanta iyo tamarta
items.description: Warbixin caalami ah oo ay baahisay Horn Lens ayaa lagu sheegay in Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland maanta dunidu u aragto xarun istiraatiiji ah oo saamayn weyn ku yeelan karta loolanka macdanta iyo tamarta ee mustaqbalka caalamka. Warbixintu waxay tilmaantay in quwadaha waaweyn iyo guud ahaan waddamada caalamku ay hadda si weyn ugu baraarugeen kheyraadka uranium-ka ee Somaliland, kaas oo loo arko mid leh muhiimad dhaqaale iyo mid siyaasadeed oo sare. Sidoo kale, warbixintan oo Wargeyska Dawan soo xigtay waxa lagu xusay in Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland ay leedahay keyd ballaadhan oo Uranium ah, kaas oo ah khayraad dihin oo aan weli la taaban. Waxa kale oo lagu sheegay in dhulka gubanka ah ee Somaliland uu hodan ku yahay macdantan qaaliga ah ee uranium, isla markaana ay inta badan taallo meel u dhow oogada sar ee dhulka, taasoo suuragelinaysa in si sahlan loo qodi karo marka loo eego meelaah kale ee hadda laga qodo. Waxa kale oo warbixintu ay intaa ku dartay in quwadaha waaweyn ee caalamka sida Maraykanka iyo Midowga Yurub ay si weyn ugu tartamayaan helitaanka macdanta istiraatiijiga ah ee Somaliland, gaar ahaan uranium-ka oo muhiim u ah tamarta nukliyeerka iyo falceliyeyaasha nukliyeerka ee yaryar ee casriga ah (Small Modular Reactors – SMRs). Dalalkan ayaa la sheegay inay danaynayaan in ay Somaliland la galaan heshiisyo istiraatiiji ah, iyagoo tixgelinaya helitaanka sahay ammaan ah iyo degenaanshaha siyaasadeed ee Somaliland. Warbixinta ayaa si qoto-dheer u sharraxday muhiimadda khayraadka Somaliland iyo sida uu u soo jiitay xiisaha quwadaha waaweyn ee caalamka, waxaana lagu yidhi “Somaliland ayaa si isa soo taraysa u noqotay meel istiraatiiji ah oo saameyn ku leh isu dheellitirka awoodaha waaweyn ee dunida. Xiligan Keydka uranium-ka ee Somaliland oo ah khayraad dihin oo aan weli la taaban ayaa soo jiitay indhaha quwadaha caalamka. Xili sahaydii uranium-ka ee laga heli jiray Badhtamaha Aasiya iyo gobolka Saaxil ay wajahayaan caqabado siyaasadeed iyo amni.” Waxa kale oo ay intaasi raacisay “Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland oo ku taalla goog istaraatiiji ah oo isku xidha Afrika iyo Bariga Dhexe, ayaa noqotay goob kulmisay xiisaha juqraafiyadeed iyo siyaasadda caalamiga ah. Xasilloonida siyaasadeed ee Somaliland iyo goobteeda istiraatiijiga ah ayaa ka dhigay hadaf muhiim ah oo la xidhiidha tartanka tamarta adduunka. Maanta Dalal waaweyn, shirkadadaha caalamiga ah ee macdan qodista iyo khubarada cilmiga dhulka ayaa si dhow ula socda fursadaha ka jira Somaliland.” Ahmed Saleebaan

items.title: Wasaarada maalgashiga iyo Shirkad Ingiriis ah oo Kala Saxeexday Heshiis Kor loogu Qaadayo Maalgashiga Macdanta
items.description: Wasaaradda Horumarinta Maalgashiga iyo Warshadaha Somaliland ayaa shalay heshiis is-afgarad (MoU) la saxeexatay shirkadda dalka Ingiriiska laga leeyahay ee Nubian Shield Resources Ltd, kaas oo diiradda saaraya xoojinta iskaashiga dhinacyada sahaminta, horumarinta iyo maalgashiga khayraadka macdanta dalka. Heshiiska is-afgarad ee ay kala saxeexdeen Wasaaradda Horumarinta Maalgashiga iyo Warshadaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland iyo shirkadda Nubian Shield Resources Ltd waxay ka tarjumaysaa dadaallada joogtada ah ee lagu horumarinayo khayraadka dabiiciga ah iyo soo jiidashada maalgashiga shisheeye. Muddooyinkii u dambeeyey, Somaliland waxay xoogga saartay sidii ay uga faa’iidaysan lahayd khayraadkeeda dabiiciga ah iyadoo la raacayo hannaan hufan oo waafaqsan siyaasadaha qaranka iyo halbeegyada caalamiga ah. Heshiiskan cusub wuxuu qayb ka yahay qorshahaas, isaga oo horseedi kara fursado cusub oo la xidhiidha sahaminta macdanta, gudbinta aqoonta iyo tiknoolajiyadda casriga ah, iyo kobcinta jawiga maalgashiga. Sidoo kale, iskaashiyada noocan ahi waxay muhiim u yihiin abuurista shaqooyin cusub iyo dhiirrigelinta dhaqdhaqaaqa dhaqaale ee dalka. Marka maalgashi tayo leh lagu daro khayraad dabiici ah isla markaana si habboon loo maareeyo, waxaa suuragal ah in si togan looga faa’iidaysto faa’iidooyin dhaqaalaha iyo khayraadka guud ee dalka. Sidoo kale, heshiiska oo ay si rasmi ah u kala saxeexdeen Wasiirka Wasaaradda Horumarinta Maalgashiga iyo Warshadaha, Siciid Maxamed Buraale, iyo wakiilka shirkadda ee Somaliland, Cabdiqaadir Cali. wuxuu astaan u yahay himilada Somaliland ee ku wajahan horumar dhaqaale oo ku salaysan maalgashi, aqoon, iyo ka faa’iidaysi hufan oo khayraadka dabiiciga ah, iyadoo la hiigsanayo koboc waara iyo fursado dhaqaale oo ballaadhan mustaqbalka.

items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo ku wajahan magaalada…
items.description: Jowhar (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa lagu wadaa inuu safar ku tago magaalada Jowhar ee caasimadda dowlad-goboleedka HirShabelle. Wafdi hordhac ah oo ka socda Villa Somalia ayaa horey u gaaray magaalada Jowhar, kuwaas oo diyaarinaya qaban-qaabada booqashada madaxweynaha iyo sugidda amniga. Madaxweynaha ayaa la filayaa inuu si rasmi ah u daah-furo mashaariic horumarineed oo ay ka mid yihiin dhismaha waddooyin muhiim ah iyo qaar ka mid ah xarumaha dowlad-goboleedka HirShabelle. Ammaanka magaalada Jowhar ayaa si weyn loo adkeeyay, iyadoo ciidamada ammaanka ay kordhiyeen howl-gallada sugidda nabad-gelyada si loo xaqiijiyo ammaan buuxa inta uu socdo safarka madaxweynaha. Inta uu madaxweynaha ku sugan yahay Jowhar, waxaa sidoo kale la filayaa inuu kulamo la yeesho mas’uuliyiinta dowlad-goboleedka HirShabelle, kuwaas oo looga hadli doono xaaladda guud ee amniga, horumarinta, adeegyada bulshada iyo sidoo kale doorashooyinka. Safarka madaxweynaha ayaa la sheegay inuu qeyb ka yahay dadaallada Dowladda Federaalka ee lagu xoojinayo xiriirka kala dhexeeya dowlad-goboleedyada, isla markaana lagu dardar-gelinayo mashaariicda horumarineed ee dalka. Si kastaba, safarka Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ee Jowhar ayaa imanaya xilli Dowladda Federaalka ay maamulka HirShabelle ka wado qabashada doorashooyinka qof iyo cod, iyadoo guddiga doorashada uu muddeeyay in 9-ka July 2026 ay qabsoomi doonto doorashada hoggaamiyaha HirShabelle. Wafdi hordhac ah oo ka socda Villa Somalia ayaa horey u gaaray magaalada Jowhar, kuwaas oo diyaarinaya qaban-qaabada booqashada madaxweynaha iyo sugidda amniga. Madaxweynaha ayaa la filayaa inuu si rasmi ah u daah-furo mashaariic horumarineed oo ay ka mid yihiin dhismaha waddooyin muhiim ah iyo qaar ka mid ah xarumaha dowlad-goboleedka HirShabelle. Ammaanka magaalada Jowhar ayaa si weyn loo adkeeyay, iyadoo ciidamada ammaanka ay kordhiyeen howl-gallada sugidda nabad-gelyada si loo xaqiijiyo ammaan buuxa inta uu socdo safarka madaxweynaha. Inta uu madaxweynaha ku sugan yahay Jowhar, waxaa sidoo kale la filayaa inuu kulamo la yeesho mas’uuliyiinta dowlad-goboleedka HirShabelle, kuwaas oo looga hadli doono xaaladda guud ee amniga, horumarinta, adeegyada bulshada iyo sidoo kale doorashooyinka. Safarka madaxweynaha ayaa la sheegay inuu qeyb ka yahay dadaallada Dowladda Federaalka ee lagu xoojinayo xiriirka kala dhexeeya dowlad-goboleedyada, isla markaana lagu dardar-gelinayo mashaariicda horumarineed ee dalka. Si kastaba, safarka Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ee Jowhar ayaa imanaya xilli Dowladda Federaalka ay maamulka HirShabelle ka wado qabashada doorashooyinka qof iyo cod, iyadoo guddiga doorashada uu muddeeyay in 9-ka July 2026 ay qabsoomi doonto doorashada hoggaamiyaha HirShabelle. items.title: Ukraine Oo Horumarinaysa Gantaal Difaaca Cirka ah, xilli ay dagaal adag kula jirto Ruushka
items.description: Dowladda Ukraine ayaa horumarin ku wada gantaal cusub oo difaaca cirka ah oo loogu magac daray FP-7X, kaas oo loogu tala-galay inuu noqdo beddel ka jaban nidaamyada difaaca hawada ee reer Galbeedka, gaar ahaan nidaamka Patriot ee Mareykanka, xilli ay sii yaraanayaan sahayda hubka ee ay Kyiv ka hesho xulafadeeda. Shirkadda Ukraine ee Fire Point ayaa dhawaan ku guuleysatay tijaabadii ugu horreysay ee duulimaadka gantaalkan, taasoo loo arko tallaabo muhiim ah oo lagu hormarinayo mashruucan cusub. Sida ay sheegeen masuuliyiinta mashruuca, FP-7X waxaa loogu talagalay inuu ka hortago gantaallada ballistic-ga ah iyo diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ee Ruushka, isagoo qayb ka noqonaya nidaam difaac oo hawada ah oo heerar kala duwan leh. Mid ka mid ah faa’iidooyinka ugu waaweyn ee gantaalkan ayaa ah qiimihiisa oo aad uga hooseeya kan nidaamyada reer Galbeedka. Wararka ayaa tilmaamaya in hal gantaal oo FP-7X ah uu ku kacayo qiyaastii 700,000 oo doolar, halka gantaalka Patriot uu gaari karo ilaa 3.8 milyan oo doolar. Ukraine ayaa qorsheyneysa inay bilowdo soo saarista ilaa saddex gantaal maalintii laga bilaabo bisha Agoosto, iyadoo la filayo in wax-soo-saarka buuxa la gaaro sanadka 2027. FP-7X wuxuu qayb ka yahay nidaam difaac oo ballaaran oo loo yaqaan Freya, kaas oo isku dara raadaarro iyo teknoolojiyado difaac oo laga keenay dalal Yurub ah sida Jarmalka, Faransiiska, Talyaaniga iyo Norway. Gantaalkan cusub ayaa la sheegay inuu gaari karo joog dhan 25 kiiloomitir, isagoo adeegsanaya hagitaan raadaar ah inta badan safarkiisa, halka marxaladda ugu dambeysa uu ku shaqeynayo nidaam hagitaan kuleyl ku saleysan. Horumarkan ayaa muujinaya dadaallada Ukraine ay ugu jirto xoojinta awooddeeda difaaca hawada, iyadoo raadineysa xalal ka jaban oo wax ku ool ah si ay uga hortagto weerarrada cirka ee sii socda. :::

items.title: Madaxweynaha FIFA muxuu ka yiri arrinta Garsoore Cumar Cartan?
items.description: Madaxweynaha FIFA ayaa sheegay in ururkiisu uu ka xun yahay xaaladda ku dhacday garsooraha Soomaaliyeed ee FIFA, Cumar Cabduqaadir Cartan, balse wuxuu carrabka ku adkeeyay in FIFA aysan awood u lahayn inay maamusho ama wax ka beddesho go’aannada socdaalka ee dowladaha. Isagoo ka hadlayay arrintan, Madaxweynaha FIFA ayaa yiri: “Dabcan waa wax laga xumaado wixii ku dhacay Cumar, garsooraha Soomaaliyeed, waxaan isku dayeynaa inaan wada-hadalno, xalna raadino, balse annagu wax walba ma maamulno.” Wuxuu intaas ku daray in aysan macquul ahayn in FIFA ay ku amarto dowlad kasta cidda ay dalkeeda u oggolaaneyso inay gasho iyo cidda aysan u oggolaaneyn. “Ma u arki lahaydeen wax caadi ah in FIFA ay dowladda Ingiriiska ku amarto cidda dalka geli karta iyo cidda aan geli karin? Dowlad kasta waxay leedahay sharciyo u gaar ah iyo nidaamyo socdaal,” ayuu yiri Madaxweynaha FIFA. Hadalkan ayaa yimid kadib markii Dowladda Mareykanka ay sheegtay in sababta loo diiday gelitaanka garsooraha Soomaaliyeed, Cumar Cabduqaadir Cartan, ay la xiriirto waxa saraakiil Mareykan ah ku tilmaameen xiriir uu la leeyahay shaqsiyaad looga shakisan yahay inay ku lug leeyihiin arrimo amni. Garsoore Cartan, oo 34 jir ah kana mid ah garsoorayaasha ugu magaca dheer Afrika isla markaana loo aqoonsaday Garsooraha Sanadka Afrika 2025, ayaa la filayay inuu noqdo garsoorihii ugu horreeyay ee Soomaali ah ee ka qeyb gala dhexdhexaadinta ciyaaraha Koobka Adduunka. Hase yeeshee, waxaa laga celiyay Garoonka Caalamiga ah ee Miami, inkastoo uu watay baasaboorka diblomaasiga ah iyo fiisaha hal-mar-galka ah ee Mareykanka. Go’aankan ayaa yimid xilli Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump uu adkeeyay siyaasadaha socdaalka, isagoo hore u sheegay in inta lagu guda jiro tartamada waaweyn ee caalamiga ah sida Koobka Adduunka, ay muhiim tahay in “dadka saxda ah oo keliya” loo oggolaado inay dalka galaan. Saraakiisha Mareykanka ayaan weli si cad u soo bandhigin caddeymo faahfaahsan oo taageeraya eedeymaha loo jeediyay garsooraha Soomaaliyeed, arrintaas oo dhalisay dood iyo falcelin xooggan oo ka dhex taagan bahda kubadda cagta, warbaahinta caalamka iyo bulshada Soomaaliyeed. Soomaaliya ayaa ka mid ah dalalka uu saameeyay xayiraadaha socdaal ee maamulka Trump, halka kiiska Cumar Cartan uu noqday mid si weyn looga hadal hayo dunida ciyaaraha, iyadoo taageero ballaaran loo muujinayo garsooraha Soomaaliyeed ee sumcadda ku leh garsoorka kubadda cagta Afrika iyo caalamka. :::

items.title: Al-Shabaab reacts to U.S. entry denial of Somali World Cup referee Omar Artan
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Al-Qaeda-linked militant group Al-Shabaab has reacted strongly to the United States’ decision to deny entry to Somali World Cup referee Omar Artan , arguing that the incident demonstrates what it described as longstanding American hostility toward the Somali people. The controversy erupted after Omar Artan, who was expected to become the first Somali referee ever to officiate a FIFA World Cup match, was denied entry into the United States upon arrival at Miami International Airport on Monday. U.S. authorities later said the decision was based on security concerns and alleged that Artan had links to Al-Shabaab, the militant group that has waged a deadly insurgency against Somalia’s federal government for nearly two decades. American officials have not publicly released detailed evidence supporting the allegation. Despite the allegation, Somalia’s federal government publicly rallied behind the Somali referee. Upon his return to Mogadishu on Wednesday, Omar Artan received a hero’s welcome from supporters and government officials before being received at the presidential palace by President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud, who expressed solidarity with him and praised his achievements. Hours after Artan’s return to Somalia, Al-Shabaab issued a statement seeking to portray the incident as evidence of broader discrimination against Somalis by the United States. “For decades, the United States government has cloaked its relationship with the Somali people in rhetoric promising partnership and progress. However, evidence suggests that beneath this diplomatic facade lies a deep-seated animosity,” the group said in a statement issued on Wednesday. “While Washington falsely claims to support Somalia, it simultaneously fosters corrupt leaders and land-grabbers, supports blood-thirsty warlords, wages economic warfare against the country’s critical infrastructure, and manipulates Somalia’s internal politics to serve American interests rather than those of the Somali people.” The militant group further alleged that U.S. policy toward Somalia had become more hostile under President Donald Trump. “Since assuming office, the Trump administration intensified this brazen hostility against the Somali people, hurling vitriolic insults that branded them as “garbage” and tarnished their reputation,” the statement added. Al-Shabaab also claimed that the Omar Artan’s case reflected a wider pattern of discrimination against Somalis. “The case of Omar Artan serves as the latest and most damning proof that American policy extends beyond security concerns to encompass broad ethnic discrimination. Artan’s case demonstrates that U.S. decision-making is driven not by security concerns or the imperative to counter “extremism,” but rather by racial and ethnic prejudice targeting Somalis as a whole,” it said. The group further argued that the denial of entry to Artan formed part of a broader pattern of U.S. actions affecting Somalia and Somalis. The denial of entry to Artan is just one manifestation of U.S. animosity toward the Somali people, the group asserted, arguing that such hostility “manifests across multiple fronts, including the indiscriminate drone strikes that spare neither women, children or the elderly civilians in Somalia.” The statement marks the first known occasion in nearly two decades that Al-Shabaab has publicly intervened in a controversy centered on international sports and immigration. The insurgent movement has historically focused its public messaging on military operations, governance issues, foreign intervention and ideological campaigns. According to accounts surrounding the incident, Omar Artan was questioned for approximately 11 hours after arriving in Miami from Turkey before being denied entry and returned to Turkey. Reports indicate that the questioning included inquiries about Somali politics and Al-Shabaab. U.S. authorities subsequently maintained that the decision to deny entry was based on security concerns and alleged connections between Artan and Al-Shabaab. The Somali government’s decision to honor Omar Artan despite the U.S. allegations has amplified public attention surrounding the case and fueled debate across Somalia and among the Somali diaspora. Supporters have portrayed Artan as a respected international referee who was denied a historic opportunity, while U.S. authorities continue to maintain that their decision was driven by security considerations. The case has also attracted significant attention because Omar Artan stood on the verge of becoming the first Somali referee in history to officiate at a FIFA World Cup, a milestone many Somalis viewed as a source of national pride and international recognition. As debate over the Omar Artan case continues, Al-Shabaab’s intervention has added a new dimension to an already high-profile controversy that touches on immigration, security policy, Somalia-U.S. relations and national representation in global sport. The episode has rapidly evolved beyond football, emerging as one of the most closely followed developments in Somalia in recent days. Contact us: info@somaliguardian.com

items.title: Silence from Somalia’s Opposition Raises Eyebrows as South West Election Proceeds Amid Controversy
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) – In a development that has surprised ordinary Somalis and political observers alike, the opposition coalition long known for their vocal criticism of controversial elections, constitutional changes, and term-extension efforts has remained conspicuously silent as South West State selected its next president. The silence comes despite mounting concerns over the credibility and independence of an electoral process that has been heavily influenced by the Federal Government in Mogadishu. The election resulted in the victory of Speaker of Parliament Aden Mohamed Nur “Aden Madoobe,” a candidate enjoyed strong political backing and direct support from federal authorities. The apparent certainty surrounded the outcome has fueled growing debate among Somalis about whether the contest represents a genuine democratic exercise or merely the formal ratification of a predetermined political arrangement. Political analysts note that the absence opposition’s voice to share with the public of their take, is particularly striking, given their consistent opposition to electoral processes they have previously described as lacking transparency, inclusiveness, or constitutional legitimacy. “This is precisely the type of election that would normally provoke a strong reaction from the opposition,” remarked one political observer in Mogadishu who spoke with WardheerNews. “Instead, there has been near-total silence.” Questions have also been raised regarding the broader political environment in which the vote took place. Critics argue that the significant presence of federal security forces and the influence of central government institutions have created an atmosphere that falls short of the free and competitive conditions expected in a democratic election. Several presidential contenders have previously expressed concerns about the management of the electoral process, including allegations regarding voting procedures and the neutrality of institutions overseeing the contest. Opposition candidates have also questioned whether sufficient safeguards exist to guarantee the secrecy and independence of parliamentary voting. Adding to the controversy is the candidacy of Aden Madoobe himself. Some rivals have argued that his continued position as Speaker of the Federal Parliament while contesting the presidency of South West State creates the appearance of a conflict of interest, potentially undermining public confidence in the fairness of the process. Beyond South West State, the election carries significance for Somalia’s wider political landscape. Many view it as a potential model for future electoral processes in other federal member states, including Galmudug and Hirshabelle, where leadership transitions are expected in the coming months. For that reason, the stakes extend far beyond Baidoa. Many warn that the manner in which this election is conducted could shape public perceptions of future state-level elections and influence the evolving balance of power between the Federal Government and regional administrations. Yet perhaps the most remarkable aspect of the unfolding political drama is not the controversy surrounding the election itself, but the reaction—or lack thereof from Somalia’s opposition movement. For years, opposition leaders have positioned themselves as defenders of constitutional order, electoral integrity, and federalism. Their decision to refrain from publicly addressing the South West election has therefore generated widespread speculation about their political calculations and strategic priorities. Some analysts suggest that opposition leaders may be seeking to avoid becoming entangled in disputes involving individual federal member states. Others argue that continued silence risks creating the impression of selective engagement, where concerns about democratic standards are raised in some cases but overlooked in others. As voting proceeds and attention turns toward the expected outcome, one question continues to dominate political discussions in Mogadishu and beyond: Why has Somalia’s opposition chosen to remain silent on one of the country’s most closely watched and controversial state elections? The answer may have implications not only for South West State but for the future credibility of Somalia’s opposition politics as a whole. Others argue that continued silence risks creating the impression of selective engagement, where concerns about democratic standards are raised in some cases but overlooked in others. As voting proceeds and attention turns toward the expected outcome, one question continues to dominate political discussions in Mogadishu and beyond: Why has Somalia’s opposition chosen to remain silent on one of the country’s most closely watched and controversial state elections? The answer may have implications not only for South West State but for the future credibility of Somalia’s opposition politics as a whole.
